The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems

paper.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and

summary.core_problem: 传统扩散模型剪枝方法基于均匀重建误差或权重大小排序参数，未考虑语义区域重要性，高压缩比下会过度剪枝语义重要区域参数，导致感知质量下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出training-free的重要性感知剪枝框架，将空间重要性图融入剪枝目标，提升高压缩比下的生成感知质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Importance-Aware OBS Pruning；从条件信号或模型注意力提取空间重要性图，将其融入OBS剪枝目标函数，得到感知对齐的参数排序，优先保留语义重要区域参数，无需额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验在MS-COCO数据集上开展；基线为基于权重大小、均匀重建误差的传统剪枝方法；高压缩比下传统方法出现可见生成退化时，所提方法仍能一致保留主体保真度与结构正确性。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional diffusion model pruning methods rank parameters based on uniform reconstruction error or weight magnitude, ignoring semantic region importance, leading to over-pruning of parameters in semantically salient regions and degraded perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free importance-aware pruning framework that incorporates spatial importance maps into the pruning objective, improving perceptual quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Importance-Aware OBS Pruning; extracts spatial importance maps from conditioning signals or model attention; integrates them into the OBS pruning objective to obtain perception-aligned parameter rankings, prioritizing parameters in semantically salient regions without additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset; baselines include conventional pruning methods based on weight magnitude and uniform reconstruction error; the proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation.

recommendation.zh: 图像扩散的重要性感知剪枝思路可借鉴到LLM参数重要性排序，仅看§3重要性图构建与§4压缩比-质量曲线即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: The importance-aware parameter ranking idea for diffusion pruning can be borrowed for LLM parameter importance estimation; only read §3 for importance map construction and §4 for compression-quality curves, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Structured pruning is a hardware-friendly way to compress LLMs, but it is mostly validated on multiple-choice recognition tasks, while the same compressed checkpoints can collapse on the free-form generation that deployment actually requires. Two observations trace this gap. First, greedy \textsc{pass}@$1$ nearly vanishes after compression, yet \textsc{pass}@$k$ recovers substantially under repeated sampling: useful generations are demoted, not erased. Second, the recoverable regime fails mainly

summary.core_problem: 解决结构化剪枝后的 LLM 在自由生成任务上明显退化、而传统压缩评测又主要停留在选择题式识别任务的问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作重要，不在于又提出一个蒸馏变体，而在于它点破了压缩评测里的一个常见错位：压缩模型在 pass@1 上塌陷，不代表能力被抹掉，很多时候只是好答案的排序被打坏了。对做模型压缩、蒸馏和部署的人，这个判断比单纯追求压缩率更有用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ShortOPD，一种 short-to-long on-policy distillation 日程。出发点是：剪枝模型在自身 rollout 的状态分布上会进入重复后缀等坏轨道，因此应在 on-policy 状态上用原始未剪枝模型做冻结教师，提供密集 token-level 监督；但如果一开始就做长 rollout，训练预算会被低信息量的重复后缀浪费。为此，方法先检测教师确认的重复后缀并截断，先在短轨迹上恢复排序与局部生成，再逐步放长 rollout 长度。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键现象是：压缩后 greedy pass@1 几乎消失，但 repeated sampling 下 pass@k 明显回升，说明可恢复解仍在；失败模式主要是 suffix repetition。论文据此比较了常规 OPD 与 short-to-long 调度，目标应是提升自由生成质量而非仅保住选择题精度。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，但从设定看，核心 baseline 是剪枝后直接评测、离线蒸馏或长 rollout OPD。
summary.authors_note: 来自字节跳动与中科院软件所/中科院大学体系。字节近两年在压缩、推理效率和训练后恢复上持续有工程导向的工作，这篇也明显带有部署场景驱动。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the gap between structured-pruning results on recognition-style benchmarks and the severe collapse of the same pruned LLMs on free-form generation.
summary_en.importance: The value is less about a new distillation variant and more about a useful diagnosis: after pruning, generation quality may collapse because good outputs are demoted rather than erased. For researchers working on compression and deployment, that is a more actionable finding than another compression ratio table.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ShortOPD, a short-to-long on-policy distillation schedule. The key idea is that pruned models fall into their own bad on-policy states, especially repetitive suffix loops, so recovery should happen on those states with dense token-level supervision from the frozen pre-pruning teacher. But long rollouts early in recovery waste budget on low-information repetitive tails. ShortOPD detects teacher-confirmed repetitive suffixes, truncates them early, and gradually increases rollout length later.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights two empirical findings: greedy pass@1 nearly vanishes after compression, while pass@k recovers substantially under repeated sampling; and the main failure mode is suffix repetition. The method is therefore compared against direct evaluation of pruned checkpoints and likely standard OPD or offline distillation. The abstract does not expose model sizes, data scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from ByteDance and CAS-affiliated institutes. It fits the recent line of deployment-driven research on compression, recovery, and efficient serving.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里少见地把“能力丢失”和“排序错位”分开讲清楚了；只看摘要里的两个现象和方法动机就值，具体增益要等正文确认 setup 是否干净。
recommendation.en: One of the few compression papers that cleanly separates capability loss from ranking collapse; the two observations alone are worth noting, though the real value depends on how clean the recovery setup is.

institutions: Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
Chinese Information Processing Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese

paper.title: Constraint-Driven Model Optimization: An Industry Framework for Selecting Compression and Acceleration Techniques in Modern Machine Learning Systems
paper.abstract: The rapid deployment of machine learning systems across cloud, edge, and enterprise environments has brought model optimization to the forefront of systems-engineering. Despite a rich literature spanning quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), and inference-time optimization, practitioners are often left navigating these techniques through heuristics rather than principled methodology. We argue that optimization should be formulated as a constraint-

summary.core_problem: 工业界模型压缩与加速技术繁多，从业者多依赖启发式按算法类别选型，缺乏基于实际部署约束的系统化决策方法论。
summary.importance: 工程框架创新，提出五维约束驱动的模型优化选型框架，将现有技术映射到运营约束而非算法类别，为工业部署提供决策参考。
summary.technical_approach: 定义数据可用性、延迟预算、内存预算、精度容忍度、重训练预算五大约束维度，综合现有文献中的实证收益，建立约束与优化技术的映射关系，形成统一选型框架。
summary.experiments: 基于现有研究文献的实证数据进行综合梳理与映射验证，未开展新的对照实验，重点验证框架在不同部署场景下的适用性。

summary_en.core_problem: Industrial model compression and acceleration techniques are numerous, and practitioners mostly rely on heuristic selection by algorithm category, lacking a systematic decision methodology based on actual deployment constraints.
summary_en.importance: Engineering framework innovation proposing a five-dimensional constraint-driven model optimization selection framework, mapping existing techniques to operational constraints rather than algorithm categories, providing decision support for industrial deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines five constraint dimensions: data availability, latency budget, memory budget, accuracy tolerance, and retraining budget, synthesizes empirical gains from existing literature, establishes mappings between constraints and optimization techniques, and forms a unified selection framework.
summary_en.experiments: Validated via comprehensive synthesis and mapping of empirical data from existing research literature, with no new controlled experiments conducted; focus is on verifying framework applicability across different deployment scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 工业界模型压缩选型的经验框架，无新算法，做LLM推理部署的可快速过一遍约束维度。
recommendation.en: Industrial model compression selection framework with no new algorithms; LLM inference engineers can quickly review the constraint dimensions.

paper.title: Adaptive Model Compression (AMC): Saliency-Driven Resource Allocation for Ultra-Low-Power Transformer Inference
paper.abstract: Deploying large-scale transformer models on resource-constrained edge devices remains a challenge due to the high energy and memory overhead inherent in static inference, which processes simple and complex tokens with uniform intensity. To address this, we propose Adaptive Model Compression (AMC), a saliency-driven framework that dynamically allocates hardware resources based on token importance. By implementing a multi-tier architecture, our system identifies critical high-saliency information

summary.core_problem: 解决 Transformer 在低功耗边缘设备上推理时，静态计算策略对简单 token 和复杂 token 一视同仁，导致能耗和内存开销过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和硬件资源调度方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对端侧 LLM/VLM 部署中的动态精度、动态低秩、token 级资源分配有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adaptive Model Compression，使用 saliency 信号判断 token 或中间表示的重要性；高 saliency 信息走全精度路径，低 saliency 信息则更激进地降低 rank 和 bit-width。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是在推理时做多层级资源分配。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 45nm CMOS 硬件设定下，系统能耗降低 59.2%，吞吐提升 2.24 倍，准确率损失 3.6%。未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 细节和 saliency 估计开销，结论需要看正文实验设置是否公平。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the inefficiency of static Transformer inference on ultra-low-power edge devices, where easy and hard tokens receive the same compute and precision budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency and hardware-aware resource allocation method. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to dynamic precision, low-rank execution, and token-level compute allocation for edge LLM deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive Model Compression uses saliency signals to decide which information should be processed at full precision and which can tolerate aggressive rank and bit-width reduction. The main idea is a multi-tier inference path rather than a new training objective or model family.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 59.2% system-energy reduction and 2.24x throughput improvement on a 45nm CMOS hardware setup, with a 3.6% accuracy drop. Model scale, task suite, baselines, and saliency overhead are not specified in the abstract, so the claims depend heavily on the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 端侧动态压缩方向可以扫一眼，但对预训练没有直接动作；重点检查 saliency 计算开销是否被算进系统收益。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance for edge-side dynamic compression, but not a pretraining lever; check whether saliency overhead is included in the reported system gains.

paper.title: MobileWan: Closing the Quality Gap for Mobile Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion have been driven by scaling transformer-based architectures to billions of parameters, substantially improving visual fidelity and motion coherence. In contrast, existing mobile video diffusion models remain limited to relatively small parameter budgets, typically 0.4-1.8B, restricting generation quality. In this work, we show that high-quality mobile video generation does not require small models. Instead, we demonstrate that a server-scale 5B-parameter video

summary.core_problem: 在移动端内存受限条件下部署 5B 级视频 diffusion transformer，同时尽量保留服务器端视频生成质量和跨片段时序一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率与模型压缩系统工作。它对 LLM 预训练本身不直接，但 recurrent reformulation、chunk-wise generation、constant-memory attention 和结构化压缩，对长序列生成模型的部署形态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从 Wan2.2-5B 出发，使用 recurrence distillation 把视频生成改写为 chunk-wise autoregressive process，使模型在推理时以近似 RNN 的方式处理视频片段；结合 causal linear attention 做常量内存注意力计算，并通过可学习或结构化压缩降低移动端部署开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明现有移动视频 diffusion 多在 0.4B 到 1.8B 参数量，而该工作尝试部署 5B 参数视频 diffusion transformer。具体训练数据、压缩比例、移动端延迟和质量指标未在给定摘要中完整列出。
summary.authors_note: 题目信息标注为 Cohere 相关工作；Fatih Porikli 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者，Markus Nagel 在模型压缩和量化方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to deploy a 5B-parameter video diffusion transformer on memory-constrained mobile hardware while preserving generation quality and temporal coherence.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and compression systems contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its recurrent reformulation, chunk-wise generation, constant-memory attention, and structured compression are relevant to long-sequence generative deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from Wan2.2-5B, the method uses recurrence distillation to turn video generation into a chunk-wise autoregressive process. Causal linear attention gives constant-memory computation, so the model behaves like an RNN at inference time while carrying temporal state across chunks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract contrasts prior mobile video diffusion models in the 0.4B–1.8B range with a 5B video diffusion transformer. Detailed training data, compression ratios, latency, and quality metrics are not fully available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The metadata marks the work as associated with Cohere. Fatih Porikli is a well-known computer vision researcher, and Markus Nagel is known for work on model compression and quantization.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；看 recurrence distillation 和常量内存注意力设置，判断能否迁移到长上下文生成。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the recurrence distillation and constant-memory attention setup for long-context generation transfer.

paper.title: FourTune: Towards Fully 4-Bit Efficient Post-Training for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality generative modeling, while post-training is essential for adapting them to diverse downstream applications. However, post-training of large diffusion models is still challenging due to the prohibitive memory footprints and slow training speed, which existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods only partially address. To overcome these limitations, we propose FourTune, an efficient post-training framework for diffusion models b

summary.core_problem: 解决大规模 diffusion models 后训练时显存占用高、训练速度慢，以及现有 PEFT 方法不能充分降低反向传播开销的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是低比特训练工程与方法改进。它把 W4A4G4，即权重、激活、梯度均为 4-bit，推进到 diffusion 后训练场景，对低比特训练稳定性和带宽瓶颈有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FourTune，一个端到端 4-bit 后训练框架。核心是三分支混合 pipeline：在标准 LoRA 结构外加入 frozen numerical stabilizer，用来隔离量化敏感 outlier；同时采用 block-wise quantization 和定制 fused kernels，让量化反向传播更接近硬件友好实现。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖 diffusion model customization 和 reinforcement learning 等后训练场景，但给定信息未提供模型规模、训练数据、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的是论文强调 native 4-bit computation 下的稳定训练、显存下降和带宽开销降低。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Song Han、Jun-Yan Zhu、Maneesh Agrawala、Lvmin Zhang 等，团队背景覆盖模型压缩、视觉生成和可控图像生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high memory footprint and slow training speed of post-training large diffusion models, where standard PEFT methods only reduce part of the cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly low-bit training methodology and systems engineering. Pushing W4A4G4 training—4-bit weights, activations, and gradients—into diffusion post-training is useful evidence for stability and bandwidth limits in low-precision adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: FourTune is an end-to-end 4-bit post-training framework. It augments LoRA with a triple-branch hybrid pipeline and a frozen numerical stabilizer that isolates quantization-sensitive outliers. It also uses block-wise quantization and custom fused kernels to make quantized backpropagation practical on hardware.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments across diffusion customization and reinforcement-learning-style post-training, but the provided text does not include model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The reported focus is stable native 4-bit computation with reduced memory and bandwidth overhead.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Song Han, Jun-Yan Zhu, Maneesh Agrawala, and Lvmin Zhang, with prior work spanning model compression, visual generation, and controllable image synthesis.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 预训练不是主线；只需看 stabilizer 处理 outlier 的设计，判断能否迁移到低比特反传。
recommendation.en: Not central to LLM pretraining; read only the stabilizer design for outlier handling and assess whether it transfers to low-bit backprop.

paper.title: Rethinking Neural Nonlinearity as Gating
paper.abstract: Activation functions are considered an essential primitive for neural nonlinearity, i.e., they enable neural networks to serve as universal approximators. In this paper, we show that this nonlinearity can also be achieved by input-conditioned threshold gating through branches as a universal primitive. We demonstrate that standard activations -- whether piecewise-linear (ReLU, PReLU, Hardtanh) or smooth (SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, GELU) -- are in fact instances of a single Threshold Gating (TG) primiti

summary.core_problem: 重新解释神经网络非线性：标准激活函数是否可以统一看作输入条件化的阈值门控。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是架构与基础机制分析。它不直接研究 LLM 预训练，但触及 activation、softmax、门控和压缩这些基础组件，对硬件友好网络和替代激活设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Threshold Gating 作为统一 primitive，声称 ReLU、PReLU、Hardtanh、SiLU、Sigmoid、Tanh、GELU 等都可视为 TG 实例；对 softmax，作者利用等价的逐元素 Sigmoid 形式给出精确 TG 转换。还提出 Min 相关变体，用于训练和压缩。
summary.experiments: 作者在 CNN、Transformer-based model 和 RNN 上把预训练网络转换为 TG 表达，声称无需重训即可保持性能；也进行了从头训练实验，并报告在模型压缩、性能和训练时长上有收益。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes neural nonlinearity by asking whether standard activation functions can be represented as input-conditioned threshold gating.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture and foundational-analysis contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it touches activation functions, softmax, gating, and compression, which are relevant to model-component design and hardware-aware architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Threshold Gating as a unified primitive and argue that ReLU, PReLU, Hardtanh, SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, and GELU are instances of it. They also claim an exact TG conversion for softmax via an equivalent per-element Sigmoid form, and introduce a Min-related extension for training and compression.
summary_en.experiments: They convert pretrained CNNs, transformer-based models, and recurrent architectures into TG form while preserving performance without retraining. They also train models from scratch and report gains in compression, performance, and shorter training, though the abstract does not give exact model scales, datasets, or numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 activation/gating 备查即可；若完整证明和转换成本干净，值得把 Transformer 小模型复现实验跑一遍。
recommendation.en: Keep it as activation/gating reference; if the proofs and conversion costs are clean, a small Transformer replication is worth running.

paper.title: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B: Compressing Hybrid MoE LLMs
paper.abstract: We present Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B, a compressed variant of Nemotron-3-Super optimized for interactive deployment. We designed the model to maximize server throughput under high user throughput constraints. In interactive serving workloads on a single 8xB200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B achieves approximately 2x higher server throughput than Nemotron-3-Super at matched user throughput constraints. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model increases 1M-token concu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是混合 MoE 大模型在真实交互式服务中的压缩问题。难点不只是把总参数量变小，而是同时压低 active parameters、KV-cache、Mamba state、专家路由开销和解码阶段 IO 压力，并且要在不同负载形态下仍保留父模型的推理、代码、长上下文和 agentic 能力。论文把目标明确落到两个部署场景：单个 8×B200 节点上的交互式服务，以及单张 H100 上的百万 token 超长上下文并发。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏工程但对基座模型研究有直接参考价值的压缩报告。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于给出了一套面向混合 MoE 架构的部署约束驱动压缩流程。它把 Nemotron-3-Super 从 120.7B total / 12.8B active 压到 75.3B total / 9.3B active，同时在目标服务点获得约 2× server throughput，并把单 H100 上 1M-token 请求并发从 1 提到 8。对预训练研究的启发在于：模型架构的有效容量不能只用参数量衡量，长上下文服务时 KV-cache 和状态空间大小会直接改变可用架构；MoE 压缩也不能简单做均匀缩放，层间敏感性和专家使用模式需要进入压缩目标。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是两阶段流程：先做结构压缩，再做能力恢复。结构压缩使用 Iterative Puzzle。它不是一次性剪枝，而是在多个中间架构之间迭代推进：每轮先做硬件感知的结构压缩，再用短程知识蒸馏恢复表示。这样可以减少单步大幅压缩导致的表示漂移，也能让后续压缩根据已经改变的内部结构重新估计层重要性。压缩维度包括三类：一是对 MoE routed experts 做非均匀 channel pruning；二是非均匀减少 active experts；三是剪 Mamba 层的 SSM state size。这里的关键取舍是非均匀分配容量：敏感层保留更多宽度或状态，冗余层承担更多压缩，而不是按同一比例裁掉所有层。能力恢复阶段结合中长上下文知识蒸馏、面向软件工程和 agentic reasoning 的 RL post-training、FP8/NVFP4 混合精度量化，以及 Multi-Token Prediction head 用于推测解码。方法的特点是把压缩、蒸馏、RL、量化和解码头放在同一个部署目标下优化，而不是分别报告单点技巧。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两个主要部署结果。第一，在单个 8×B200 节点的交互式服务中，Puzzle-75B-A9B 在匹配用户侧吞吐约束时，相比 Nemotron-3-Super 获得约 2× server throughput；目标 operating point 是每个用户至少 100 tokens/s。作者分别考虑了 50K/2K 的 prefill-heavy 场景，以及 8K/64K 的 decode-heavy 场景，用来覆盖长文档/RAG 和长输出推理两类负载。第二，在单张 H100 的超长上下文部署中，压缩后模型把 1M-token 请求并发从父模型的 1 个提升到 8 个，主要来自参数、KV-cache 和 Mamba state 占用下降。模型规模从 120.7B total / 12.8B active 降到 75.3B total / 9.3B active。论文还和 Nemotron-3-Nano 30B total / 3.5B active 做了服务效率比较：在考虑 Nano 输出更啰嗦的情况下，Puzzle-75B-A9B + MTP 在 100 TPS 用户吞吐下可完成接近 Nano without MTP 的请求数，同时保持接近 Super 的能力。能力评测覆盖 reasoning、coding、multilingual、long-context 和 agentic benchmarks，但给出的材料中没有逐项 benchmark 数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的 Iterative Puzzle 流程、结构压缩目标和部署约束定义。重点看三处：第一，如何度量层重要性并决定非均匀专家/channel/state 压缩；第二，短程 KD 为什么插入到每轮压缩之间，而不是压完后一次性恢复；第三，吞吐曲线如何随 input/output ratio、MTP、量化和上下文长度变化。对做预训练或模型架构的人，最有价值的是它把“训练后的可压缩性”转化为架构设计信号：哪些层、专家和状态对能力敏感，哪些资源在长上下文服务中先成为瓶颈。对做 serving 的人，则应重点看 8×B200 交互吞吐和单 H100 1M-context 并发设置，因为这两组实验直接说明压缩目标为何不能只看 perplexity 或单一 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses deployment-oriented compression for hybrid MoE LLMs. The hard part is not merely reducing total parameter count. The compressed model must also reduce active parameters, KV-cache footprint, Mamba state memory, routing cost, and decode-time IO pressure while preserving reasoning, coding, long-context, multilingual, and agentic capabilities. The target settings are concrete: interactive serving on a single 8×B200 node and million-token long-context workloads on a single H100 GPU.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering-heavy but research-relevant compression study for frontier-scale base models. Its main contribution is a deployment-constrained compression recipe for hybrid MoE architectures, rather than a new language-modeling objective. Nemotron-3-Super is compressed from 120.7B total / 12.8B active parameters to 75.3B total / 9.3B active parameters. The reported gains are large at the system level: about 2× higher server throughput at the matched user-throughput operating point, and 1M-token concurrency on a single H100 increases from 1 request to 8 requests. For pretraining researchers, the important message is that usable model capacity is not well described by parameter count alone. KV-cache size, recurrent state size, and input/output length ratios can dominate the feasible architecture in production.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages: structural compression followed by capability recovery. The structural stage uses Iterative Puzzle, a sequential version of the Puzzle framework. Instead of compressing the model in one large step, it alternates hardware-aware structural compression with short knowledge-distillation recovery phases. This allows each compression step to account for representation drift and inter-layer dependencies introduced by earlier steps. The compressed dimensions include heterogeneous channel pruning of routed MoE experts, heterogeneous reduction of active experts, and pruning of the SSM state size in Mamba layers. The main design choice is non-uniform capacity allocation across depth: sensitive regions keep more capacity, while more redundant regions are compressed harder. The recovery stage combines medium- and long-context knowledge distillation, RL post-training for software-engineering and agentic reasoning tasks, mixed FP8/NVFP4 inference, and a Multi-Token Prediction head for speculative decoding. The novelty is in optimizing these components under explicit serving constraints rather than treating pruning, distillation, quantization, and decoding acceleration as independent tricks.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports two central deployment results. In interactive serving on a single 8×B200 node, Puzzle-75B-A9B reaches roughly 2× the server throughput of Nemotron-3-Super at matched user-throughput constraints, with the target operating point set at at least 100 tokens per second per user. The evaluation covers both a prefill-heavy 50K/2K input/output regime and a decode-heavy 8K/64K regime. In ultra-long-context deployment on a single H100 GPU, the compressed model raises 1M-token concurrency from 1 request to 8 requests by reducing parameter memory, KV-cache pressure, and Mamba-state footprint. The model size changes from 120.7B total / 12.8B active to 75.3B total / 9.3B active. The paper also compares against Nemotron-3-Nano with 30B total / 3.5B active parameters: after accounting for Nano’s higher generation verbosity, Puzzle-75B-A9B with MTP completes a similar number of requests per minute at 100 TPS user throughput while retaining near-Super quality. The provided material states broad preservation across reasoning, coding, multilingual, long-context, and agentic benchmarks, but does not include all per-benchmark numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the compression methodology and the deployment evaluation carefully. The key parts are the Iterative Puzzle loop, the layer- and expert-level importance signals used for heterogeneous pruning, and the throughput curves under different input/output regimes. The most useful question to track is why short KD phases are inserted between compression steps instead of recovering only after a single aggressive pruning pass. Also inspect how MTP, mixed-precision inference, and context length interact with server throughput. For base-model researchers, the paper is useful because it turns post-training compressibility into an architecture signal: it reveals which parts of a hybrid MoE model are capacity-critical and which parts mainly create serving cost.

recommendation.zh: Nvidia 关于混合 MoE 模型压缩的集大成之作，联合优化了 MoE 剪枝、Mamba 剪枝、蒸馏和 MTP，对后训练和高效推理架构设计有极高参考价值，必读其 pipeline 设计。
recommendation.en: Nvidia's comprehensive work on compressing hybrid MoE models, jointly optimizing MoE/Mamba pruning, distillation, and MTP. Highly valuable for post-training and efficient inference architecture design. Must read the pipeline design.

paper.title: Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance for Multimodal LLMs Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: While knowledge distillation (KD) is widely adopted for training lightweight models by leveraging supervision from larger teacher models, relying solely on output token distributions has proven insufficient for compressing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Since output tokens are a byproduct of the model attending to visual inputs, prior works have explored explicitly distilling attention to provide a direct supervisory signal. While promising, the precise utility of which attention sign

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是多模态大模型蒸馏里一个很具体但常被处理得过于粗糙的问题：到底应该蒸馏哪一类跨模态注意力。已有方法通常把 prompt-to-vision attention 当成主要监督信号，但作者通过系统分析发现，真正和下游性能强相关的不是“模型在读指令时怎么看图”，而是“模型在生成每个 response token 时怎么看图”。换句话说，关键监督信号发生在解码阶段，而不是输入理解阶段。进一步地，不同 response token 对视觉证据的依赖差异很大，统一地对所有 token 施加同一种 attention distillation loss 会把监督做平。
summary.importance: 这篇对纯预训练的直接影响有限，因为它主要是 MLLM 蒸馏而不是基座预训练 recipe。但它对统一多模态建模和蒸馏目标设计有一个清楚的启发：如果输出 token 是视觉 grounding 的结果，那么蒸馏不该只盯着最终 logits，也不该把所有 cross-modal attention 一视同仁，而要对生成阶段、token 级别的视觉依赖做更细粒度建模。这个结论对后续做 MLLM 压缩、teacher-student 对齐、甚至设计 native multimodal pretraining loss 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者先把跨模态注意力明确拆成两类：
- Prompt-to-Vision attention：prompt token 作为 query，看向视觉 token；
- Response-to-Vision attention：response token 作为 query，看向视觉 token。

论文的第一步不是直接提方法，而是做相关性分析，比较 student 与 teacher 在这两类 attention 上的相似度和最终任务性能的关系。结论是后者显著更关键，因此方法设计完全转向 response-to-vision。

在此基础上，作者提出 TRAG，核心是 token-level response-visual attention guidance。它不是对所有 response token 的 attention map 做统一 KL，而是根据 teacher attention 的熵自适应调整蒸馏强度。直觉上，如果 teacher 在某个 token 上的视觉注意力分布很尖锐，说明这是一个强 grounding token，比如具体物体、位置、属性词，此时 student 应更精确地对齐；如果 teacher 分布较平，说明该 token 更依赖全局场景或语言先验，比如功能词、连接词，此时不应强迫 student 去拟合一个并不稀疏的局部模式。

因此 TRAG 的关键不是“蒸馏 attention”本身，而是把 teacher attention entropy 当作 token-wise 难度和监督形态的指示器，用它调制 KL loss，在 coverage 与 precision 之间做自适应平衡。相比已有方法，它有两个明确区别：一是监督位置从 prompt phase 转到 generation phase；二是监督粒度从 sequence-level / uniform loss 转到 token-level adaptive loss。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的核心实验结论有三类。

第一类是相关性分析。作者显示，student-teacher 的 response-to-vision attention 相似度与下游性能强相关，而 prompt-to-vision attention 相似度几乎没有可用相关性。这一点是整篇工作的立论基础。

第二类是 attention pattern 分析。作者观察到 response token 的跨模态注意力方差很大：有些 token 需要尖锐、局部的视觉聚焦，有些 token 只需要弥散的场景级上下文。这直接说明统一蒸馏目标不合适，也解释了为什么过去方法收益有限。

第三类是 benchmark 对比。TRAG 在多个多模态基准上优于竞争蒸馏基线，同时在 attention fidelity 上也更好。给定当前提供的全文片段，没有看到完整的参数规模、teacher/student 组合、具体 benchmark 名称和逐项数值表，因此不能可靠复述精确数字；但从论文叙述看，作者不仅比较了最终任务分数，也比较了 attention alignment 本身，并把两者联系起来，而不是只报任务结果。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是实现细节，而是问题拆分方式。

先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，弄清作者为什么把 cross-modal attention 分成 P→V 和 R→V 两段，以及这种划分在自回归 MLLM 中为什么自然。然后重点看相关性分析和 attention entropy 统计的图表，这两部分决定了 TRAG 是否站得住：如果没有这两个观察，后面的 adaptive KL 只是一个经验技巧。

方法部分主要看 teacher attention entropy 如何进入 loss，以及它具体调节了什么。实验部分建议优先看：1）不同 attention supervision 位置的对比；2）uniform vs token-adaptive objective 的消融；3）attention fidelity 与任务性能是否同步提升。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。如果你做的是纯文本 LLM 预训练，这篇不用深读；如果你关心 multimodal distillation、统一建模或生成阶段 grounding 信号，这篇有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important question in multimodal LLM distillation: which cross-modal attention signals are actually worth distilling. Prior work mostly emphasizes prompt-to-vision attention, assuming that better visual grounding during prompt encoding should transfer to the student. The authors show that this is largely the wrong target. What correlates with downstream performance is response-to-vision attention, namely how the model attends to visual tokens while generating each response token. They also show that this signal is highly heterogeneous across tokens, so a uniform distillation objective is poorly matched to the structure of the problem.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation-model training and compression. The main lesson is that if output tokens are produced through token-wise visual grounding, then distillation should not stop at logits, and it should not treat all cross-modal attention equally. The generative phase carries the more useful supervision. That insight is useful for MLLM compression, teacher-student alignment, and potentially for designing better multimodal training objectives where grounding quality matters during decoding rather than only during input fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first formalizes two kinds of cross-modal attention in autoregressive MLLMs:
- Prompt-to-Vision (P→V): prompt tokens query visual tokens during instruction encoding.
- Response-to-Vision (R→V): response tokens query visual tokens during decoding.

Instead of proposing a loss immediately, the authors begin with an empirical characterization. They measure how teacher-student similarity in each attention type relates to downstream performance. The main finding is that R→V similarity matters, while P→V similarity contributes little.

Based on this, they propose TRAG, Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance. The method discards prompt-phase attention supervision and focuses entirely on response-phase visual attention. More importantly, it does not apply a uniform KL loss over all response tokens. The loss is modulated by the entropy of the teacher’s attention distribution for each token.

The intuition is straightforward. Some generated tokens require sharp, localized visual grounding, such as object names or attributes. Others rely on diffuse scene-level context or mostly linguistic priors, such as function words. Teacher attention entropy acts as a token-wise indicator of this distinction. Low-entropy teacher attention suggests precise grounding and should induce stronger, sharper alignment; high-entropy attention suggests broader coverage and should not force the student into an artificially peaky pattern. In that sense, TRAG is less about “distilling attention” in general and more about matching the supervision shape to the grounding role of each generated token.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, three experimental claims are clear.

First, the correlation study shows that student-teacher similarity in response-to-vision attention is strongly associated with downstream task performance, whereas prompt-to-vision similarity has negligible utility. This is the empirical basis for the whole method.

Second, the paper analyzes token-level attention variance and finds substantial heterogeneity across generated tokens. Some tokens exhibit concentrated visual focus, others broad and diffuse attention. This supports the argument that a single uniform distillation objective is mismatched.

Third, TRAG outperforms competitive distillation baselines on multiple multimodal benchmarks and also improves attention fidelity. However, the excerpt provided here does not include the full experimental tables, exact teacher-student model sizes, benchmark list, or reliable numeric deltas, so it would be unsafe to restate precise numbers. What is clear is that the paper evaluates both end-task performance and attention alignment, rather than reporting only task metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and preliminaries to understand why the P→V versus R→V split is natural in autoregressive multimodal decoders. Then focus on the correlation analysis and the entropy-based characterization of response-token attention. Those sections carry the real argument. Without them, the adaptive KL objective would look like a heuristic.

In the method section, pay attention to how teacher attention entropy enters the loss and what exactly it modulates. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: prompt-phase versus response-phase supervision, uniform versus token-adaptive distillation, and whether attention-fidelity gains track task-performance gains.

About 20 to 30 minutes is enough. If your work is centered on text-only pretraining, this is peripheral. If you care about multimodal distillation, unified modeling, or grounding during generation, it is a useful read.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了MLLM蒸馏用prompt-to-vision注意力的常规做法，注意力信号选择的结论可直接复用到内部多模态蒸馏ablation，重点看§3相关性分析
recommendation.en: Overturns the common practice of distilling prompt-to-vision attention in MLLM KD; attention signal selection conclusions can be directly reused in internal multimodal distillation ablations, focus on §3 correlation analysis

paper.title: Variable Bit-width Quantization: Learning Per-Group Precision for "Bigger-but-Smaller" Language Models
paper.abstract: Low-bit quantization shrinks language models but treats precision as a single global hyper-parameter: every weight uses the same bit-width. We introduce Variable Bit-width Quantization (VBQ), a training-time method in which each contiguous group of 64 weights learns its own resolution from {1,2,4,8} bits via a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, trained jointly by an alternating optimization that gives the precision logits a clean, task-aligned signal. VBQ discovers a consistent, strongly heterogeneous a

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是：低比特量化通常把整个模型或整层绑定到统一 bit-width，但真实模型里不同权重组对精度的敏感性差异很大，固定分配会浪费预算，也限制了“更大参数量但更小存储”的设计空间。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发不在于单个量化技巧，而在于它把 bit allocation 变成可学习对象，而不是部署阶段的手工格式选择。更重要的是，作者给出一个很强的经验结论：如果模型从训练开始就原生适应异构低比特表示，那么平均约 1.8 bit 的权重预算也能支撑比均匀 4-bit 更好的质量/容量折中。这对低成本预训练、量化感知训练、以及“参数量扩张换精度缩减”的 scaling 设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 VBQ。它把每 64 个连续权重作为一个 group，为每组学习一个离散 bit-width，候选集合是 {1,2,4,8}。bit 选择通过 Gumbel-Softmax 松弛成可微形式，与模型权重联合训练。难点在于，如果直接端到端优化，任务损失经量化器传回的梯度会远大于 bit-budget 正则，precision logits 基本不会动，最后 bit 分配停在初始化附近。

作者用了两个关键设计。第一是 gradient isolation：在计算 bit-selection 路径时，对重构权重做 detach，阻断交叉熵损失直接更新 precision logits，只让 logits 主要接收与 bit 选择相关的干净信号。第二是 alternating optimization：交替进行权重更新步和精度分配更新步，类似把“学表示”和“学资源分配”拆开。实验显示这样 precision logits 才会真正收敛到离散决策，而不是停留在软分布。

另一个重要发现是，训练出来的分配模式很快稳定，约在训练前 20% 就基本锁定。于是作者进一步把搜索结果蒸馏成固定 recipe：例如大部分 block 用统一 2-bit，首个 FFN block 保留 4-bit，LM head 按词频分层分配更高精度。也就是说，Gumbel 学习主要用于发现结构，最终部署不一定需要保留复杂的自适应机制。
summary.experiments:
核心结果有三类。第一，学到的 bit 分配高度异构，而且异构性发生在层内、甚至同类投影内部，而不只是“某些层高精度、某些层低精度”。整体上 69% 的 group 收敛到 1-bit，平均 bit-width 约 1.78。LM head 平均约 1.09 bit，但高频词相关部分会保留更高精度。

第二，作者强调 bigger-but-smaller。一个 131M 的 VBQ 模型，平均 1.82 bit、总大小 29MB，能在 perplexity 上超过 55M 的 FP16 模型，而后者大小是 109MB。更大的例子里，1.46B 参数模型用同样 recipe，在 FineWeb-Edu 上可以匹配 593M FP16 control，同时参数量约 2.5× 更大，但总存储预算约 3.7 bit/weight 级别。这里传达的信息是：在固定内存预算下，扩大参数量并原生训练到低比特，可能比训练一个更小的高精度模型更划算。

第三，recipe transfer 是成立的。自适应搜索得到的分配在早期就稳定，冻结成固定量化方案后，效果接近在线学习版。这说明论文的主要贡献不只是一个训练时技巧，也包括发现了可复用的精度分配规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法部分前半，抓住两个问题：为什么统一 bit-width 不够；为什么 precision logits 会被主任务梯度淹没。然后看训练算法图或伪代码，理解 gradient isolation 和 alternating optimization 如何配合。实验部分优先看三张结果：bit 分配直方图/分层统计、bigger-but-smaller 主表、以及 recipe freeze/transfer 结果。若只想判断是否值得跟进，20 到 30 分钟足够；若关心低比特预训练，可再细看不同模块的敏感性分析，尤其是 LM head、首层 FFN、attention output projection 的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a limitation of standard low-bit quantization: bit-width is usually fixed globally or by coarse heuristics, even though different weight groups have very different sensitivity to precision. That wastes memory budget and limits the design space for models that are larger in parameter count but smaller in storage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is not a single quantization trick, but the shift from hand-designed precision formats to learned bit allocation. More interestingly, the paper argues that if a model is trained natively under heterogeneous low-bit constraints, an average budget around 1.8 bits per weight can support a better quality-size tradeoff than uniform low-bit compression applied after the fact. That has implications for quantization-aware pretraining, memory-constrained scaling, and recipes that trade precision for parameter count.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VBQ assigns each contiguous group of 64 weights a learnable bit-width chosen from {1, 2, 4, 8}. The choice is relaxed with Gumbel-Softmax so it can be optimized jointly with the network. The core optimization problem is that task gradients flowing through the quantizer dominate the bit-budget signal by orders of magnitude, causing the precision logits to stay near initialization.

The paper addresses this with two mechanisms. First, gradient isolation: reconstructed weights are detached along the bit-selection path, preventing the main cross-entropy loss from directly overwhelming the precision logits. Second, alternating optimization: weight updates and precision updates are interleaved, so representation learning and precision allocation are optimized on cleaner timescales. Together, these changes let the bit-selection variables actually commit to discrete allocations.

A notable empirical finding is that the learned allocation stabilizes early, around the first 20% of training. The authors then distill the learned pattern into a fixed recipe, such as mostly 2-bit blocks, a higher-precision first feed-forward block, and a frequency-tiered LM head. This means the adaptive search is useful not only as a deployment method, but also as a way to discover reusable quantization structure.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways. First, the learned precision allocation is strongly heterogeneous, and the heterogeneity appears within projection types, not just across layers. About 69% of groups collapse to 1 bit, with an average precision of roughly 1.78 bits. The LM head averages around 1.09 bits, while a minority of more sensitive groups retain 4- or 8-bit precision.

Second, the paper makes a bigger-but-smaller argument. A 131M model at 1.82 bits on average, occupying 29MB, outperforms a 55M FP16 model that occupies 109MB. At a larger scale, a 1.46B model using the same recipe matches a 593M FP16 control on FineWeb-Edu while using a storage budget in the roughly 3.7 bits-per-weight regime. The practical message is that, under a fixed memory budget, training a larger model natively at low precision can be better than training a smaller high-precision model.

Third, recipe transfer works. Since the learned bit assignments stabilize early, freezing them into a fixed quantization recipe reproduces most of the adaptive method’s gains. That suggests the paper contributes both an optimization method and a structural observation about where precision matters in decoder-only LMs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, read the introduction and the first half of the method section. Focus on two questions: why uniform bit-width is too restrictive, and why precision logits fail under naive end-to-end optimization. Then inspect the training algorithm or pseudocode to understand how gradient isolation and alternating optimization interact.

In the experiments, prioritize the allocation histograms or per-module precision statistics, the main bigger-but-smaller comparison table, and the recipe-freezing results. Those are enough to judge whether the method is only a search procedure or whether it reveals a reusable low-bit training recipe. A 20 to 30 minute read is enough for triage. If low-bit pretraining is your main interest, spend extra time on the sensitivity analysis for the LM head, the first FFN block, and attention output projections.

recommendation.zh: 位宽分配的稳定规律有参考价值，只看§4的权重分组位宽分布统计即可，方法本身对超大模型的可扩展性待验证
recommendation.en: Stable bit-width allocation patterns are informative; only read §4 per-group precision statistics, method scalability to very large models remains unproven

paper.title: SAD-LoRA: Spectral Alignment for Low-Rank Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Distilling a fine-tuned teacher into a LoRA-adapted student is a standard recipe for parameter-efficient compression, but output-level KD does not explicitly control which rank-$r$ weight subspace the adapter occupies. We propose \textbf{SAD-LoRA} (\textbf{S}pectral \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{D}istillation), which selects this subspace from the data-weighted student-space reference update $\DWT\Sigx^{1/2}$ and maintains it during training via a differentiable principal-angle loss on $\colspan(B)

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 学生模型从微调教师模型蒸馏时，常规输出级 KD 不能显式控制低秩 adapter 所占权重子空间的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是低秩蒸馏和参数高效压缩的分析与训练目标改进。它不直接推进预训练，但对理解 LoRA 子空间、蒸馏信号和低秩适配器容量分配有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAD-LoRA，即 Spectral Alignment Distillation。方法先从 data-weighted student-space reference update DWTΣx^{1/2} 中选择 rank-r 子空间，再用可微 principal-angle loss 约束 LoRA 矩阵 B 的列空间在训练中保持对齐。论文还给出数据加权蒸馏误差分解：子空间错配、子空间内系数错配、不可避免的 rank residual 三部分。
summary.experiments: 在受控合成任务中，尤其是 flat teacher spectrum 设置下，SAD-LoRA 将 subspace-misalignment 项从 51% 降到接近 0，并把最终子空间对齐从 0.49 提升到 1.00。还做了 RoBERTa-large 到 RoBERTa-base 的蒸馏实验，覆盖多个下游任务；摘要未完整给出所有任务和最终提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why output-level knowledge distillation into a LoRA-adapted student does not explicitly control which rank-r weight subspace the adapter uses.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis and objective-level improvement for low-rank distillation and parameter-efficient compression. It is not directly a pretraining result, but it is relevant for understanding LoRA subspaces, distillation signals, and rank allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAD-LoRA selects the adapter subspace from the data-weighted student-space reference update DWTΣx^{1/2} and maintains it using a differentiable principal-angle loss on the column space of B. The paper also derives an exact decomposition of data-weighted distillation error into subspace misalignment, within-subspace coefficient mismatch, and irreducible rank residual.
summary_en.experiments: On controlled synthetic problems with a flat teacher spectrum, SAD-LoRA reduces the subspace-misalignment term from 51% to nearly zero and improves final subspace alignment from 0.49 to 1.00. It also evaluates RoBERTa-large to RoBERTa-base distillation across several downstream tasks, though the abstract truncation does not expose all task-level numbers.

recommendation.zh: 可只读误差分解和合成实验；它提醒 LoRA 蒸馏的失败常在子空间，不在 logits loss 本身。
recommendation.en: Read the error decomposition and synthetic setup; it usefully separates LoRA distillation failure into subspace error rather than just logit loss.

paper.title: Generic Expert Coverage for Pruning SparseMixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models contain substantial structured redundancy among routed experts, but pruning them without downstream calibration data remains challenging. Existing expert-pruning methods typically rely on a single aggregated importance score, which can bias the retained set toward experts favored by dominant calibration patterns. We propose \textbf{Generic TB-Coverage}, a coverage-aware expert pruning method that uses only generic text corpora (WikiText

summary.core_problem: 稀疏MoE大模型在无下游校准数据的场景下做专家剪枝时，现有单聚合重要度分数的排序方法会偏向主导校准模式对应的专家，丢弃那些在特定通用语料上关键但平均得分不高的专家，导致剪枝后模型泛化能力受损。
summary.importance: 提出了一种仅依赖通用文本语料的覆盖感知剪枝方法，无需下游数据和微调，为MoE预训练模型的轻量化压缩提供了更鲁棒的方案，对MoE模型的部署效率优化有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是Generic TB-Coverage方法，流程分为四步：1）在WikiText2和C4两个通用语料上，分别统计每个专家的REAP风格效用分数（结合路由权重与专家输出范数）；2）为每个语料生成独立的专家重要性排名；3）通过轮询规则从各语料排名中交替选择受保护专家，保障跨语料的能力覆盖；4）合并受保护专家集合后，移除排名最低的未受保护专家以达到目标保留比例。整个过程不需要模型微调。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B和DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base两个开源MoE模型上测试，覆盖25%、50%、75%三种专家保留比例。主指标为6个零样本基准（ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande、BoolQ）的平均准确率，辅助测试MMLU、GSM8K、Math500。该方法在所有保留比例下均优于单分数排序的剪枝基线，同时发现单种子随机剪枝基线在稀疏MoE场景下方差大、结果具有误导性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15分钟。重点关注方法部分的轮询覆盖规则设计，以及实验部分跨模型、跨保留比例的一致性结果。附录中关于随机剪枝方差的分析和不同语料下专家效用分布的对比也值得浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Expert pruning of sparse MoE language models without downstream calibration data suffers from systematic bias when using single aggregated importance scores: experts critical for specific generic corpora but with moderate average scores tend to be discarded, degrading the pruned model's generalization.
summary_en.importance: A coverage-aware pruning method that relies solely on generic text corpora and requires no fine-tuning provides a more robust approach for post-pretraining MoE compression, with practical value for optimizing MoE deployment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is Generic TB-Coverage, a four-step procedure: 1) Compute per-expert REAP-style utility scores (combining router weight and expert output norm) independently on two generic corpora, WikiText2 and C4; 2) Generate separate expert importance rankings for each corpus; 3) Select protected experts via a round-robin rule across corpus-specific rankings to ensure cross-corpus capability coverage; 4) Merge protected experts and remove the lowest-ranked unprotected ones to meet the target retention budget. No model fine-tuning is required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two open-source MoE models — Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base — at 25%, 50%, and 75% expert retention budgets. The primary metric is average accuracy across six zero-shot benchmarks (ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ), with MMLU, GSM8K, and Math500 as auxiliary tests. The method outperforms single-score ranking baselines across all retention ratios. The paper also finds that single-seed random pruning baselines have high variance and can be misleading in sparse MoE settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15 minutes. Focus on the round-robin coverage rule design in the method section, and the consistent cross-model, cross-retention-budget results in experiments. The appendix analysis of random pruning variance and per-corpus expert utility distributions is also worth browsing.

recommendation.zh: MoE剪枝无需下游数据的实用方案，规避了单重要性打分的模式偏差问题，直接看Table 2不同保留率下的零样本对比即可
recommendation.en: Practical downstream-free MoE pruning method that avoids the pattern bias of single importance scores; just check Table 2 for zero-shot comparisons across retention rates

paper.title: SAB-LVLM: Significance-Aware Binarization for Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their enormous parameter scale and cross-modal computation incur substantial memory and latency overhead, severely limiting real-world deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization offers an attractive solution by drastically reducing storage and computational costs. However, existing binarization methods neglect the varying importance of weights across different layers and modaliti

summary.core_problem: 降低大型视觉语言模型在存储、显存和推理延迟上的开销，同时尽量减少二值化带来的性能损失。
summary.importance: 这是 LVLM 压缩与高效部署论文，贡献在于把权重重要性按层和模态区分处理；对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对多模态模型的部署约束和模态敏感参数分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAB-LVLM，即 significance-aware binarization。方法基于文本和视觉输入构造 Hessian 矩阵，估计不同层、不同模态权重对任务输出的影响，再据此决定哪些权重需要更谨慎地优化或保留，以缓解统一二值化导致的关键模态权重损伤。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM backbone、参数规模、数据集、baseline 或提升数值；实验目标是相对已有二值化方法降低存储和计算成本，同时保持多模态理解性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces memory, storage, and latency costs of large vision-language models while limiting the accuracy loss caused by binarization.
summary_en.importance: This is an LVLM compression and deployment paper. Its contribution is treating weight importance as layer- and modality-dependent; it does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal model deployment and modality-sensitive parameter analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAB-LVLM introduces significance-aware binarization. It constructs Hessian matrices from textual and visual inputs to estimate the importance of weights across layers and modalities, then uses this signal to avoid damaging modality-critical parameters during binarization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the LVLM backbones, model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against existing binarization methods in the storage-compute versus multimodal-understanding trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 作为 LVLM 二值化备查即可；真正可看的点是 Hessian 重要性是否揭示了模态层间脆弱性。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an LVLM binarization reference; the only interesting signal is whether Hessian importance exposes modality-layer fragility.

paper.title: CHERRY: Compressed Hierarchical Experts with Recurrent Representational Yield
paper.abstract: We study three complementary techniques for training compute-efficient language models.   (1) Selective supervision and per-token efficiency. Selective Ground Truth Token Training (SGT) concentrates supervision on the ~15% of output tokens that carry semantic payload. Through positive gradient coupling in position-shared transformer weights -- a token-level instance of auxiliary-task transfer -- the remaining 85% of unsupervised tokens still improve substantially, giving a 4.5x per-supervised-to

summary.core_problem: 在训练和参数预算受限时，如何用更少监督、更浅网络和更紧凑表示维持语言模型学习效率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是标准 recipe 微调，而是在监督稀疏化、深度压缩和循环恢复三个方向同时动手，试图改写“每个 token 都要监督、深层堆叠不可少”的默认做法，对预训练效率研究有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一，Selective Ground Truth Token Training 只对约 15% 语义负载更高的 token 施加监督，依赖共享 Transformer 权重带来的正梯度耦合，让未监督 token 也随之改善，并给出梯度耦合系数为正时的理论保证。第二，将 48 层 1B Transformer 压缩为 6 层 227M 主干，再通过循环式表征恢复弥补深度损失。第三，采用分层专家压缩结构，在较小参数量下保留更强表示能力。整体更像是训练效率与架构压缩的组合方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露的关键结果是：只监督 15% token 时，在 step-100 的评估最优点可恢复完整序列 loss 降幅的约 67%，对应每个被监督 token 约 4.5 倍效率；梯度耦合系数平均值约 0.72，且在打乱文本后该效应消失，说明收益依赖自然语言结构。另有从 48 层 1B 压缩到 6 层 227M 的设定，但摘要未给出完整基线和下游指标，结论可信度仍需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 TeamSparta 的 AXOps Team，不是头部实验室，但题目覆盖 selective supervision、压缩和循环恢复，偏研究型工程探索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to preserve language-model learning efficiency under limited supervision, shallower depth, and compressed parameter budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is not a standard recipe tweak. It jointly challenges the default assumption that every token needs supervision and that deep stacks are indispensable, so it is relevant to pretraining-efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines three ideas. First, Selective Ground Truth Token Training supervises only about 15% of semantically loaded tokens, relying on positive gradient coupling through shared Transformer weights so that unsupervised tokens still improve; the paper also gives a theorem for the positive-coupling regime. Second, it compresses a 48-layer 1B Transformer into a 6-layer 227M backbone and uses recurrent representational recovery to compensate for lost depth. Third, it adds a compressed hierarchical expert structure to retain capacity under a smaller parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, supervising only 15% of tokens recovers about 67% of the full-sequence loss reduction at the step-100 optimum, implying roughly 4.5x efficiency per supervised token. The average gradient-coupling coefficient is around 0.72, and the effect collapses on shuffled text, suggesting dependence on natural-language structure. The 48-layer 1B to 6-layer 227M compression setup is notable, but the abstract does not provide enough baseline detail or full downstream metrics, so the strength of the claim needs checking in the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from TeamSparta's AXOps Team. This is not a major frontier lab paper, but it reads like a research-oriented engineering exploration of selective supervision, compression, and recurrent recovery.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是 selective token supervision 这部分：若 Table/Fig 证明 15% 监督真能稳定迁移到其余 token，就该立刻做内部复现；其余压缩模块先保留怀疑。
recommendation.en: Read it for the selective-token supervision claim: if the tables really show stable transfer from 15% supervised tokens to the rest, it deserves an internal ablation; stay skeptical about the rest.

paper.title: CLEAR-MoE: Shared-Basis Expert Extraction from Frozen Vision Transformers via Calibration-Driven Layer Selection
paper.abstract: We present CLEAR-MoE, a four-phase post-training pipeline that converts a frozen pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT) into a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model without updating backbone weights. The pipeline (i) scores feed-forward network (FFN) layers by sparsity, clusterability, and output sensitivity; (ii) decomposes selected layers into a shared low-rank SVD basis and per-cluster residual experts using k-means clustering; (iii) trains lightweight routers supervised by cluster labels; and (

summary.core_problem: 如何在不更新预训练ViT骨干权重的前提下，将稠密模型转换为稀疏MoE结构以提升推理效率，同时最小化精度损失。
summary.importance: 提出了四阶段后训练MoE转换pipeline，发现了post-hoc MoE转换场景下共享基权重的核心作用、路由策略弱影响的经验结论，对MoE架构设计有弱参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 流程分四步：1）按稀疏度、可聚类性、输出敏感性给FFN层打分选择转换层；2）对选中层做SVD分解得到共享低维基，对残差做k-means聚类得到残差专家；3）用聚类标签监督训练轻量路由器；4）适配CUDA稀疏后端。
summary.experiments: 在Imagenette数据集上用DeiT-Small验证，转换后MoE保留原模型99.9%精度（86.70% vs 86.73%）；消融显示不同路由策略精度差异不超过0.06个百分点，共享SVD基是精度保留的核心。

summary_en.core_problem: How to convert a frozen pretrained dense Vision Transformer into a sparse MoE model without updating backbone weights, to improve inference efficiency while minimizing accuracy loss.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a four-phase post-training MoE conversion pipeline, and finds empirical evidence that shared basis weights dominate accuracy preservation while routing strategies have negligible impact in this post-hoc setup, providing weak reference for MoE architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Four-stage pipeline: (1) score FFN layers by sparsity, clusterability, and output sensitivity to select layers for conversion; (2) decompose selected layers into shared low-rank SVD basis and per-cluster residual experts via k-means; (3) train lightweight routers supervised by cluster labels; (4) implement sparse dispatch on CUDA backends.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Imagenette with DeiT-Small, retains 99.9% of dense model accuracy (86.70% vs 86.73%); ablation shows accuracy varies by less than 0.06% across routing strategies, with shared SVD basis as the primary accuracy preservation factor.

recommendation.zh: 小CV模型上的post-hoc MoE转换实验，路由无用结论仅适用该狭窄场景，作为MoE文献备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Post-hoc MoE conversion on tiny CV models; the 'routing doesn't matter' finding only holds in this narrow setup, keep as literature reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: FlexMoE: One-for-All Nested Intra-Expert Pruning for MoE Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model ability with sparsely activated experts, making this architecture a standard recipe for modern large models. However, sparse activation does not remove the deployment burden of storing and serving all experts, and the available deployment budget can vary substantially across devices, users, and workloads. Existing MoE compression methods are still largely fixed-budget, typically optimizing one compressed endpoint at each chosen target budget.

summary.core_problem: 把一个已训练好的 MoE 语言模型压缩成多个可部署预算下的嵌套子网络，而不是为每个预算单独训练一个压缩模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理与部署压缩方法。稀疏激活降低了每次前向计算量，但没有降低存储全部专家和服务多种硬件预算的负担；FlexMoE 针对的是实际部署中预算连续变化的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先对每个 expert 的 FFN channel 做重要性排序，再让每个 expert 学习离散剪枝动作。训练时逐步增加成本压力，使一次 action-training 可以导出从高预算到低预算的一系列 action mask；这些 mask 对应嵌套在同一个 ranked base model 里的多个子网络。相对固定预算剪枝，它把多端点压缩改成一次训练、多预算导出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 名称或提升幅度。实验目标应是比较不同部署预算下的 MoE 压缩质量，并验证单次训练导出的嵌套子网络是否接近或优于固定预算压缩端点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert a pretrained MoE language model into a nested family of deployable subnetworks across different inference and storage budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side MoE compression contribution. Sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but it does not remove the need to store and serve all experts; FlexMoE targets the practical case where deployment budgets vary by device, user, or workload.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlexMoE ranks FFN channels inside each expert by importance, then trains discrete pruning actions for experts. By gradually increasing cost pressure, a single action-training run exports a sequence of masks from high to low budgets, producing reliable subnetworks nested within the same ranked base model. The main shift is from fixed-budget endpoint compression to one training run that supports many budgets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant experimental question is whether the nested subnetworks retain quality across budgets compared with separately optimized fixed-budget MoE compression methods.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和预算曲线即可；对预训练的直接反馈有限，但 MoE 部署预算连续化这个 setup 很贴近真实服务。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and budget-quality curves; it is not a pretraining paper, but the continuous-budget MoE setup is close to real serving constraints.

paper.title: Cascaded Multi-Granularity Pruning for On-Device LLM Inference in Industrial IoT
paper.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) on Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) edge devices demands extreme compression, yet existing structured pruning methods collapse at high compression ratios due to one-shot importance estimation, and their cross-architecture behavior remains unpredictable. This article presents a cascaded multi-granularity pruning framework that removes layers, attention heads, and feed-forward channels in coarse-to-fine order, with lightweight low-rank recovery between st

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在 IIoT 边缘设备上对 LLM 做极高压缩率 pruning，同时避免一次性重要性估计在高压缩下失效。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率和模型压缩方法，包含一个关于结构化剪枝可靠性的架构条件分析；但实验场景集中在 bearing fault diagnosis，通用 LLM serving 的外推需要谨慎。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 cascaded multi-granularity pruning，按粗到细顺序依次剪 layer、attention head 和 FFN channel，并在阶段之间加入轻量 low-rank recovery 以重新估计组件重要性。论文还形式化 Structural Independence Assumption，作为判断 per-component pruning criteria 是否可靠的条件；摘要称 MHA+GELU 满足该假设，而 GQA+SwiGLU 违反该假设。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 88M 到 6.25B 参数模型，在 bearing fault diagnosis 任务上测试高压缩推理。摘要称该框架扩展了可达到的压缩范围，但提供的信息未包含具体压缩率、延迟、精度损失或通用语言任务结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to prune LLMs aggressively for IIoT edge devices without the collapse often caused by one-shot importance estimation at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in inference efficiency and model compression, with an architectural condition for when structured pruning criteria are reliable. However, the evaluation is centered on bearing fault diagnosis, so extrapolation to general LLM serving should be cautious.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses cascaded multi-granularity pruning: layers, attention heads, and feed-forward channels are removed in a coarse-to-fine order, with lightweight low-rank recovery between stages to re-estimate component importance. The paper formalizes the Structural Independence Assumption as a checkable condition for the reliability of per-component pruning criteria, claiming that MHA+GELU satisfies it while GQA+SwiGLU violates it.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span models from 88M to 6.25B parameters on bearing fault diagnosis. The abstract states that the framework extends achievable compression, but does not provide exact compression ratios, latency gains, accuracy drops, or results on general language tasks.

recommendation.zh: 正文不必细读；若做剪枝，只看 SIA 对 GQA+SwiGLU 的失败解释，领域任务结果当弱证据。
recommendation.en: No need for a full read; if you work on pruning, inspect the SIA argument for GQA+SwiGLU failure and treat the domain-task evidence as weak.

paper.title: Agentic evolution of physically constrained foundation models
paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence increasingly drives automated scientific discovery, yet contemporary generalist agents lack physical grounding, frequently hallucinating hardware-incompatible designs. Here, we present a physically grounded, multi-agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant computing systems. Anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph structuring past scientific innovations, the framework extracts an "algorithmic Chain-of-Thought" to transform blind stochastic

summary.core_problem: 用 LLM 多智能体自动发现硬件约束下的模型压缩算法，解决通用智能体在物理系统设计中容易产生硬件不可实现方案、而传统自动搜索又依赖人工限定搜索空间的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身贡献有限，但对“LLM 辅助算法发现”这一方向有参考价值。其核心意义不在提出新的训练范式，而在于展示如何把历史算法知识组织成可演化记忆，让智能体在强物理约束下搜索量化/压缩策略，从而逼近甚至超过人工启发式方法。对关注模型压缩、部署优化、自动科研的研究者有借鉴意义，但不属于基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个分层多智能体发现框架。基础是 Evolutionary Knowledge Graph（EKG），从 164 个主流 LLM 压缩方法中抽取算法结构、适用场景、硬件约束和演化关系，形成机器可读的“算法记忆”。上层是多智能体协作：负责提出假设、改写历史算法路径、构造算法 CoT、再由 AI peer review 做可行性筛选，最后结合硬件反馈闭环迭代。与常见“让 LLM 直接写新算法”的做法不同，这里显式建模已有方法的演化轨迹，把随机搜索改成基于图谱路径的定向变异；同时引入带宽敏感的 Sensitivity Profile，把硬件约束变成直接反馈信号，而不是事后验证。最终系统自动演化出两种方法：面向长上下文 dense 模型的离群值感知量化 Q-Enhance，以及面向 MoE 的专家级精度分配加低秩误差补偿方法 MoE-Salient-AQ。
summary.experiments: 报告结果集中在模型压缩部署场景。Q-Enhance 针对长上下文推理中的离群值导致的精度崩塌问题，可支撑到 128k token 序列长度；MoE-Salient-AQ 在 sub-3-bit 量化区间报告比人工设计基线高 3.7%。更大规模部署实验中，235B 模型可压缩到双 A100 服务器上运行，显存需求从 438GB 降到 108GB，硬件需求降低约 75%，精度损失 0.64%；8B 模型可部署到单张消费级 GPU。论文没有提供预训练 loss、通用能力 scaling、数据效率等基座训练层面的证据，结果主要针对压缩后的推理部署表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看框架图和 EKG 的组织方式，理解它如何把“算法演化历史”变成可搜索结构。压缩方法细节可以快速浏览，关键判断是：这里的贡献本质是自动化算法设计流程，而不是提出一个改变预训练范式的新方法。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若关注 AI for Science / 自动算法发现，可重点读多智能体评审和硬件反馈闭环部分；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可直接跳读结果与方法定位。

summary_en.core_problem: Automating the discovery of hardware-aware model compression algorithms with LLM-based multi-agent systems, addressing the failure mode where generalist agents propose physically infeasible designs while classical search methods remain confined to manually specified spaces.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is relevant as a case study in LLM-assisted algorithm discovery. Its main value is in showing how prior algorithmic knowledge can be structured into an evolvable memory so that agents can search under strict hardware constraints and match or exceed hand-designed heuristics. It is of interest to researchers working on compression, deployment, and automated research workflows, rather than on foundation model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built around a layered multi-agent framework. Its backbone is an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph (EKG) constructed from 164 mainstream LLM compression methods, encoding algorithmic structure, applicability, hardware constraints, and historical relations as machine-readable memory. On top of this, multiple agents perform hypothesis generation, mutation of prior algorithmic trajectories, algorithmic chain-of-thought construction, and AI peer review for feasibility filtering. Rather than asking an LLM to invent algorithms from scratch, the framework explicitly models evolutionary paths over prior methods, converting blind stochastic search into directed structural mutation. A bandwidth-sensitive Sensitivity Profile provides direct hardware feedback instead of deferred validation. The discovered algorithms are Q-Enhance, an outlier-aware quantization scheme for long-context dense models, and MoE-Salient-AQ, which assigns precision at expert granularity and uses adaptive low-rank error compensation for MoE quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are in compression and deployment. Q-Enhance targets accuracy collapse from long-context outliers and is evaluated up to 128k tokens. MoE-Salient-AQ is reported to outperform human-designed baselines by 3.7% in the sub-3-bit regime. In large-scale deployment tests, a 235B model is compressed onto dual A100 servers, reducing memory requirements from 438 GB to 108 GB, a roughly 75% hardware reduction, with 0.64% accuracy degradation. An 8B model is deployable on a single consumer GPU. No evidence is provided on pretraining loss, scaling behavior, or data efficiency; the empirical claims are limited to post-training compression and inference deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the framework figure and the design of the EKG to understand how historical algorithmic knowledge is turned into a searchable structure. The specific compression methods can be read quickly. The main takeaway is an automated algorithm-design pipeline, not a new pretraining paradigm. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in AI for science or automated discovery should pay attention to the multi-agent review and hardware feedback loop; readers focused strictly on pretraining can skip most implementation details and only check the problem setup and headline results.

recommendation.zh: 自动进化搜出的MoE亚3比特量化策略有工程参考价值，无范式创新，仅看量化方案和部署实验结果即可
recommendation.en: The auto-evolved sub-3-bit MoE quantization schemes have practical engineering value, no paradigm novelty; only read the quantization method and deployment results.

paper.title: Neural Network Quantization by Learning Low-Loss Subspaces
paper.abstract: Neural network quantization aims to find a discrete representation of parameters that preserves the performance of a full-precision (FP) model as faithfully as possible. Enforcing discrete constraints perturbs parameters away from a well-optimized minimum, generally resulting in performance degradation. Recent studies indicate that low-loss FP solutions are not isolated, but instead belong to connected low-loss subspaces of the loss landscape, where the loss maintains nearly the same minimum val

summary.core_problem: 研究如何把全精度网络量化到离散权重，同时尽量不离开原模型附近的低损失区域。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是量化方法改进。它把 loss landscape 中的低损失连通子空间用于量化，思路比常规后训练量化的局部扰动视角更几何化；但目前摘要只显示通用神经网络/视觉实验，和 LLM 量化的直接证据不足。
summary.technical_approach: 方法学习一条量化感知的线性权重路径，使路径上保持低损失；路径中点被设计成更容易直接量化的权重配置。核心假设是：如果量化点能落在全精度模型的低损失子空间里，性能下降会更小。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和具体数值。实验声称直接量化学习到的子空间中点可以带来更好的性能保持，但无法从现有信息确认是否覆盖 Transformer、LLM 或低比特权重量化设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to quantize a full-precision neural network while keeping the quantized weights inside a nearby low-loss region.
summary_en.importance: This is a quantization-method paper. Its main contribution is to use connected low-loss subspaces in the loss landscape as a target for quantization, which is a more geometric view than ordinary local perturbation around an FP optimum. The available abstract only supports generic neural-network or vision evidence, so the connection to LLM quantization remains indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method learns a quantization-aware linear path in weight space whose loss stays low. The midpoint of the learned path is made quantization-friendly, and direct quantization of that midpoint is expected to preserve accuracy better.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or numerical results. It claims improved performance preservation after directly quantizing the learned midpoint, but there is no visible evidence for Transformer-scale or LLM low-bit quantization.

recommendation.zh: 作为 LLM 量化的弱线索即可；看方法图和低损失路径设定，不必按 LLM 结论外推。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a weak signal for LLM quantization; inspect the low-loss-path setup, but do not extrapolate the claims to LLMs.

paper.title: Distill on a Diet: Efficient Knowledge Distillation via Learnable Data Pruning
paper.abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) is widely used to obtain compact models for efficient inference in resource-constrained environments. Yet the computational overhead of the distillation process itself is often overlooked, raising the question of whether a better student model can be obtained with less data and less compute via data pruning. However, existing data pruning methods are not designed for KD: some introduce substantial overhead, such as obtaining training dynamics through retraining, while

summary.core_problem: 知识蒸馏过程本身计算开销被长期忽略，现有数据剪枝方法要么需要重训获取训练动态、要么依赖启发式规则，无法适配知识蒸馏场景的数据价值分布。
summary.importance: 提出适配知识蒸馏场景的高效可学习数据剪枝框架，可在更少数据、更低计算下获得性能更优的学生模型。
summary.technical_approach: 提出IF-Beta框架：1）验证影响函数可仅用预训练教师模型高效估计样本对蒸馏效果的贡献；2）结合可学习采样策略自动选择高价值蒸馏样本子集，无需额外重训。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露实证验证了影响函数对KD样本价值的估计有效性，未说明具体模型规模、数据集与量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The computational overhead of the knowledge distillation process itself is largely overlooked; existing data pruning methods either require retraining to obtain training dynamics or rely on heuristic rules, failing to match the data value distribution in KD scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an efficient learnable data pruning framework tailored for knowledge distillation, which can produce better student models with less data and lower compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes IF-Beta: 1) Validates that influence functions can efficiently estimate sample impact on KD performance using only the pretrained teacher model; 2) Combines a learnable sampling policy to automatically select high-value distillation sample subsets without extra retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract discloses empirical validation of influence functions as effective KD sample value estimators, but does not specify model scales, datasets, or quantitative performance gains.

recommendation.zh: 通用KD数据剪枝思路可迁移到LLM蒸馏场景，但无大模型验证，仅作思路备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: The general KD data pruning idea could transfer to LLM distillation, but no large-model validation exists; keep as literature reference, no need to read the full paper.

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Task-Specific LLM Distillation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a growing range of domains, yet their scale poses deployment challenges in applications where latency and cost constraints are critical. This paper derives empirical scaling laws for domain-specific LLM compression, quantifying how in-domain and general knowledge performance scale with dataset size, compression ratio, supervision format, and iterative pruning schedule. Using quantitative finance as our application domain, we compare

summary.core_problem: 研究任务专用 LLM 蒸馏和剪枝时，数据规模、压缩率、监督格式和剪枝日程如何共同决定领域能力与通用能力的退化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是压缩场景下的经验 scaling law。它不是基座预训练 scaling，但对理解“能力在压缩和任务专用化中如何丢失”有参考价值；金融领域设置会限制结论外推。
summary.technical_approach: 比较 logit-based 蒸馏和 LoRA-based 蒸馏，并结合迭代结构化剪枝；提出 blended chain-of-thought supervision loss，用推理轨迹上的混合监督稳定 KL 蒸馏。核心变量包括数据量、压缩比例、监督格式和剪枝 schedule。
summary.experiments: 应用域是量化金融。论文报告领域内质量会随压缩可预测下降，而通用知识 benchmark 更早崩塌；监督格式是主要调节因素，chain-of-thought 监督能恢复部分被剪枝擦除的通用能力。摘要未给出具体模型规模和完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how dataset size, compression ratio, supervision format, and pruning schedule determine the degradation of in-domain and general capabilities during task-specific LLM distillation.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an empirical scaling-law analysis for compression. It is not a foundation-model pretraining scaling law, but it offers a useful lens on how capabilities are lost under pruning and domain specialization; the quantitative-finance setting limits generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: It compares logit-based and LoRA-based distillation under iterative structured pruning, and introduces a blended chain-of-thought supervision loss to stabilize KL distillation over reasoning traces. The main axes are data size, compression ratio, supervision format, and pruning schedule.
summary_en.experiments: The application domain is quantitative finance. The paper reports predictable degradation of in-domain quality under compression, while general-knowledge benchmarks collapse earlier; supervision format is the dominant factor, and chain-of-thought supervision recovers some general knowledge erased by pruning. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes or full improvement numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为压缩 scaling 备查即可；金融域和剪枝设定太窄，重点只看监督格式如何影响通用能力掉落。
recommendation.en: Use it as a compression-scaling reference; the finance and pruning setup is narrow, so focus only on how supervision format shifts general-capability loss.

paper.title: StreamKL: Fast and Memory-Efficient KL Divergence for Boosting Attention Distillation
paper.abstract: Attention distillation, which trains one attention distribution to match another by minimizing their Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, is widely used in knowledge distillation, model compression, continual learning, and sparse-attention LLM training. However, existing approaches materialize both attention distributions before computing the KL reduction, incurring $O(N_QN_K)$ memory and IO costs that become prohibitive at long context lengths. We present StreamKL, the first fused GPU primitive fo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 attention distillation 中 KL 散度计算的长上下文瓶颈。常规做法需要先显式生成 teacher/student 两个 attention 矩阵，再做 KL reduction，额外显存和 IO 都是 O(N_Q N_K)。在 64K、128K 甚至更长上下文下，这一步会先于模型本身成为训练瓶颈；例如 64K×64K、32 个头、BF16 下，仅两个 attention 分布就需要约 512GB 显存。
summary.importance: 它对基座训练的价值主要在长上下文和稀疏注意力训练。DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5 这类稀疏注意力路线会用 attention distillation 让轻量 indexer 或 sparse attention 逼近 dense attention。若 KL 本身需要物化二次矩阵，训练长上下文稀疏模型会被系统开销卡住。StreamKL 的贡献是把 attention KL 做成类似 FlashAttention 的流式原语，让 attention distillation 可以进入更长上下文的训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是把两个 softmax 分布之间的 KL 写成可在线更新的形式。难点在于 KL 同时依赖两个分布，并包含加权 logit difference；当两个分布的 running max 和 log-sum-exp 随 tile 更新变化时，累积项需要正确重标定。StreamKL 在 forward 中按 key tile 流式扫描，把 QK tile 留在 SRAM 内完成 softmax 归一化和 KL 累积，不把 P1、P2 写回 HBM。Backward 使用保存的 log-sum-exp 向量重算 tile 级 attention probability，再计算梯度，从而避免保存 O(N_Q N_K) 中间量。工程上还提供了 split-K forward 来处理 N_Q=1 等小 query 场景，并在 Hopper 上使用 TMA 做异步 bulk copy；backward 通过融合 kernel 尽量让每个 QK tile pair 只访问一次。
summary.experiments: 论文在 NVIDIA H200 和 A100 上评测。Forward 相比 PyTorch 最高加速 18×，相比 torch.compile 和 FLA 最高约 3.7×；在 causal mask 下，最高分别达到 43×、7.0×、7.1×。Backward 在 non-causal 设置下相比 PyTorch 最高 6.5×，causal 设置下最高 14.0×。显存方面，attention distillation 的额外 HBM footprint 从 O(N_Q N_K) 降到 O(1)，使 64K+ context 能在单 GPU 上持续运行。论文特别强调，相比 chunking，StreamKL 不是在显存和延迟之间折中，而是移除二次 attention 分布的物化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看第 3 节 online KL 推导，尤其是两个 softmax running max 改变时 KL 累积量如何重缩放；第 4 节 backward recomputation，看保存哪些状态、重算哪些 tile；第 5 节 kernel 设计，看 split-K、小 query、causal mask 和 Hopper TMA 的处理。实验部分优先看长上下文下的峰值显存曲线和 causal/non-causal latency 分解。对预训练研究员来说，最值得关注的是它能否降低稀疏注意力蒸馏的工程门槛，而不只是单个 kernel 的速度数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory and IO bottleneck in attention-distillation KL. Standard implementations materialize two full attention distributions before reducing their KL divergence, which costs O(N_Q N_K) extra memory and traffic. At 64K context with 32 heads in BF16, storing the two distributions alone is about 512 GB, making long-context attention distillation impractical on a single accelerator.
summary_en.importance: The work matters for long-context foundation-model training, especially sparse-attention training. Recent sparse-attention systems often distill an indexer or sparse attention pattern from dense attention. If the KL loss itself materializes quadratic attention maps, the distillation objective becomes a system bottleneck. StreamKL turns this loss into a fused streaming primitive, making attention distillation more compatible with long-context training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: StreamKL derives an online formulation for KL divergence between two attention distributions. Unlike ordinary attention, the loss couples two independent softmaxes and a weighted logit-difference term, so the accumulated quantity must be rescaled correctly when the running maxima and log-sum-exp values of both distributions change. The forward kernel streams key tiles through on-chip SRAM and accumulates the row-wise KL without writing either attention matrix to HBM. The backward pass saves log-sum-exp vectors and recomputes attention probabilities tile by tile, avoiding quadratic intermediates. The implementation includes split-K forward kernels for small-query workloads such as autoregressive decoding, fused backward kernels that reduce redundant HBM traffic and logit recomputation, and Hopper-specific TMA-based data movement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is reported on NVIDIA H200 and A100 GPUs. In the forward pass, StreamKL reaches up to 18× speedup over PyTorch and about 3.7× over torch.compile and FLA; under causal masking, the reported maxima increase to 43×, 7.0×, and 7.1× respectively. In the backward pass, it reports up to 6.5× speedup over PyTorch for non-causal inputs and 14.0× under causal masking. The extra HBM footprint for the distillation loss is reduced from O(N_Q N_K) to O(1), enabling 64K+ context settings on a single GPU where materialization-based baselines run out of memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 25–35 minutes. Read the online KL derivation first, especially the rescaling logic when the two softmax normalizers change across tiles. Then check the backward recomputation section to understand what is stored and what is regenerated. The kernel section is worth reading for split-K handling, small-query cases, causal masking, and Hopper TMA usage.
