In the experiments, focus on peak-memory curves and latency breakdowns at long context lengths. The main training-level question is whether this primitive makes sparse-attention distillation practical at the context lengths used in real pretraining runs.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文注意力蒸馏或稀疏LLM训练的团队可参考，算子设计能直接复用，需关注反向重计算的精度与速度 trade-off
recommendation.en: Teams working on long-context attention distillation or sparse LLM training can reference this; kernel design is reusable, check the precision-speed tradeoff of backward recomputation

paper.title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: We propose Mix-QVLA, a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework for VLA models. Mix-QVLA anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token reference decision and evaluates whether quantization preserves task-relevant evidence across key VLA functional boundaries. It computes normalized gradient-weighted task-evidence maps from boundary activations and compares full-precision and quantized maps using evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion, capturing changes

summary.core_problem: 解决 Vision-Language-Action 模型后训练量化中，传统层敏感度估计不能反映任务决策证据和执行阶段变化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 推理压缩方法。它对 LLM 基座预训练不是核心，但对多模态大模型部署有一定借鉴：量化误差不只看 activation 或 weight 差异，还要看是否破坏任务相关证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mix-QVLA，一种 task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ 框架。它把量化模型的 action-token 决策锚定到全精度参考决策，计算关键 VLA 功能边界上的归一化 gradient-weighted task-evidence maps，并用 evidence-mass 与 attribution-distribution distortion 衡量证据强度和分布是否被破坏。再通过 soft-bottleneck 目标聚合为层级敏感度，并建模不同执行阶段的层重要性变化，用于 bit allocation。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 OpenVLA-style policy 上做了广泛评测，并在模型大小和 BitOps 预算下指导混合精度分配。未提供具体模型规模、任务集、量化 bit 配置、baseline 或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision-Language-Action models, where standard layer sensitivity estimates may miss task-relevant evidence and phase-dependent behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLA inference-compression method. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it offers a useful deployment idea for multimodal models: quantization should preserve decision evidence, not only minimize activation or weight error.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mix-QVLA is a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework. It anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token decision, computes normalized gradient-weighted evidence maps at key VLA functional boundaries, and measures both evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion. A soft-bottleneck objective aggregates boundary degradation into layer sensitivity, while execution-phase modeling captures time-varying layer importance for bit allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive evaluation on OpenVLA-style policies and mixed-precision allocation under model-size and BitOps budgets. It does not provide concrete model sizes, task suites, bit settings, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: VLA 量化的 attribution setup 可能可借到多模态 LLM；但任务很窄，读敏感度定义即可。
recommendation.en: The attribution-based sensitivity setup may transfer to multimodal LLM quantization, but the task is narrow; read only the sensitivity formulation.

paper.title: S4oP: Operator-level Pruning of Structured State Space Models for Resource-Constrained Devices
paper.abstract: Structured State Space Models (SSMs), including the S4 and S4D architectures, have recently emerged as powerful alternatives to attention-based models for capturing long-range dependencies in sequential data. Despite their strong empirical performance, deploying these models in time- and resource-constrained settings remains challenging due to their computational and memory demands. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental, operator-level pruning approach for S4- and S4D-based models that s

summary.core_problem: 结构化状态空间模型（S4/S4D）的推理计算与内存开销大，现有剪枝方法未针对其结构化算子做系统优化，难以部署在资源受限设备。
summary.importance: 方法创新类贡献，首次提出针对SSM的增量式算子级剪枝框架，实现效率-精度的可控权衡。
summary.technical_approach: 采用渐进式剪枝流程，交替执行结构化掩码与微调，联合监控模型精度与推理延迟，针对S4/S4D的结构化算子（状态矩阵、卷积核等）定制剪枝策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据集、基线与量化提升幅度，仅说明所提方法可显著降低SSM推理成本并保持预测性能。
summary.authors_note: Nicola Bombieri为维罗纳大学嵌入式系统与高效计算方向研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Structured State Space Models (S4/S4D) have high inference compute and memory overhead; existing pruning methods are not optimized for their structured operators, hindering deployment on resource-constrained devices.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution; first proposes an incremental operator-level pruning framework tailored to SSMs, achieving controllable efficiency-accuracy tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a progressive pruning pipeline that alternates structured masking and fine-tuning, jointly monitors model accuracy and inference latency, and customizes pruning strategies for S4/S4D's structured operators (state matrices, convolution kernels, etc.).
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, dataset, baselines, or quantitative improvement margins are disclosed in the abstract; only states that the proposed method significantly reduces SSM inference cost while preserving predictive performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Nicola Bombieri is a researcher at the University of Verona, focusing on embedded systems and efficient computing.

recommendation.zh: SSM算子级剪枝的工程实现有参考价值，做SSM边缘部署的可看§3的剪枝策略设计，其余内容无需细读。
recommendation.en: The operator-level SSM pruning implementation is referenceable for edge deployment; only §3 pruning strategy design merits attention.

paper.title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Unified Formulation and Selection Principle
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplor

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 语言模型部署时虽然每 token 只激活少量专家，但仍需存储完整专家池，导致显存占用高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 压缩和部署方法分析。它不是提出新的 MoE 架构，而是把 one-shot expert pruning 的打分准则统一到同一公式下，并给出面向不同部署目标的选择原则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个由三类因素构成的统一专家打分形式：routing frequency、gate weighting、activation strength。基于该形式，论文主张任务无关剪枝应偏向 routed-token-averaged、gate-free 的 activation-based 准则；任务特定剪枝则可以保留路由频率和 gate 权重信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MoE 模型、参数规模、数据集和数值结果。实验应围绕 one-shot expert pruning 对不同打分准则的比较，目标是在减少专家存储的同时保持任务性能；论文声称统一公式还能推导出新准则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory cost of deploying MoE language models: sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but the full expert pool still has to be stored.
summary_en.importance: This is a MoE compression and deployment analysis contribution. Rather than proposing a new MoE architecture, it unifies one-shot expert-pruning scoring rules and derives a criterion-selection principle for different deployment objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The unified formulation decomposes expert scores into routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. It argues that task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, while task-specific pruning can benefit from preserving routing-frequency and gate-weight information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify MoE model sizes, datasets, or numerical results. The experiments appear to compare one-shot expert-pruning criteria under memory reduction while preserving task performance, and the formulation is said to yield additional criteria.

recommendation.zh: 读准则统一公式和任务无关/任务特定分界即可；对 MoE serving 有用，但不会改变预训练路由设计。
recommendation.en: Read the unified scoring formula and the task-agnostic versus task-specific split; useful for MoE serving, unlikely to change pretraining router design.

paper.title: Squeeze-Release: Iterative Pruning with Exact Structural Minimization
paper.abstract: Unstructured pruning produces sparse weight tensors, but the standard implementation keeps tensor shapes unchanged so the deployed model is no smaller than before pruning. We present an exact structural rewrite, which we call minimization, that converts a masked network into a smaller dense network with the same forward function up to floating-point rounding. The Squeeze-Release cycle iterates pruning and minimization with an intermediate release step that re-enables the exact-zero positions ins

summary.core_problem: 非结构化剪枝通常只得到稀疏掩码，部署时张量形状不变，模型并不会真正变小；这篇工作要把“稀疏但不省部署成本”的剪枝结果转成等价的小型稠密网络。
summary.importance: 贡献属于模型压缩与可部署结构化重写，重点不在提出新的剪枝分数，而在给出精确的结构最小化和可迭代压缩流程。对做大模型高效部署、蒸馏前压缩、以及理解网络冗余都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步：先做常规非结构化剪枝；再做 exact structural minimization，把被掩码后的网络重写成前向函数等价的更小稠密网络；随后引入 release 步骤，把压成零的位置以小幅校准噪声重新激活，恢复可训练容量，再进入下一轮剪枝。作者还提出 CompensatedLayerNorm，使带 LayerNorm 的残差流也能进行通道缩减而尽量保持函数不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在一个 fully-connected 设定上可把可部署网络压到原始模型的 39 倍更小，但未在摘要中给出 LLM 规模、数据集或与主流压缩基线的完整对比。当前更像是压缩方法学信号，是否能迁移到 Transformer/LLM 还要看正文实验部分是否干净、是否覆盖注意力和残差主干。

summary_en.core_problem: Unstructured pruning usually yields sparse masks without changing tensor shapes, so the deployed model is not actually smaller. This work aims to convert such masked networks into functionally equivalent smaller dense networks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in deployable structural rewriting rather than a new pruning score. It is relevant to model compression, pre-deployment shrinking, and understanding structural redundancy in overparameterized networks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method alternates three steps: standard unstructured pruning; exact structural minimization that rewrites the masked network into a smaller dense network with the same forward function up to floating-point rounding; and a release step that reactivates exact-zero positions as calibrated small noise, restoring trainable capacity before the next pruning cycle. The paper also introduces CompensatedLayerNorm to enable channel reduction through LayerNorm-equipped residual streams while preserving function.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims up to 39x deployable compression on a fully connected setting, but does not specify LLM-scale models, datasets, or full baselines there. For LLM relevance, the key question is whether the method transfers cleanly to Transformers with attention and residual pathways.

recommendation.zh: 思路比结果更值得看：把 unstructured mask 精确改写成小稠密网这件事很干净；先看 minimization 和 CompensatedLayerNorm，LLM 可迁移性暂别高估。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the headline number: exact rewriting from masked sparsity to a smaller dense net is clean; read the minimization and CompensatedLayerNorm parts, but do not over-assume LLM transfer yet.

paper.title: Towards Data-free and Training-free Compression for Speech Foundation Models Using Parameter Clustering
paper.abstract: This paper presents a novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means. More fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is also explored. Experiments conducted on the LibriSpeech dataset suggest that when operating with pruning sparsity of 50% on HuBERT-large, consistent WER reductions of 27.73%/18.61% absolute (34.37%/21.91% relative) over the magnitude-based pruning were ob

summary.core_problem: 解决语音基础模型压缩依赖训练数据与微调流程、现有幅值剪枝效果不佳的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无数据无训练的压缩范式，降低语音大模型部署的资源与时间成本
summary.technical_approach: 原创方法，基于通道维度k-means聚类实现参数剪枝，进一步探索分层可变聚类数的细粒度混合稀疏剪枝策略，全程无需训练数据与参数更新
summary.experiments: 在HuBERT-large（50%稀疏度）、Whisper-large-v3（10%稀疏度）上验证，采用LibriSpeech数据集；对比幅值剪枝，HuBERT微调前test-clean/other子集WER绝对下降27.73%/18.61%，微调后下降0.19%/0.79%，Whisper对应下降2.86%/5.02%，均无显著精度损失

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation that speech foundation model compression relies on training data and fine-tuning, while existing magnitude-based pruning delivers subpar performance
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a data-free, training-free compression paradigm to reduce resource and time costs for deploying large speech models
summary_en.technical_approach: Original method using channel-wise k-means clustering for parameter pruning, with further exploration of fine-grained mixed sparsity pruning via layer-varying cluster counts; no training data or parameter updates required
summary_en.experiments: Validated on HuBERT-large (50% sparsity) and Whisper-large-v3 (10% sparsity) using LibriSpeech; vs magnitude pruning, HuBERT WER drops 27.73%/18.61% absolute on test-clean/other before fine-tuning, 0.19%/0.79% after, Whisper drops 2.86%/5.02% with no significant accuracy loss

recommendation.zh: 语音FM的无训练聚类剪枝思路可迁移到通用LLM做快速压缩验证，仅看方法部分的通道聚类策略即可
recommendation.en: The training-free clustering pruning strategy for speech FMs can be transferred to general LLMs for quick compression validation; only read the channel clustering design in the method section

paper.title: Optimal Post-Training Quantization Scales and Where to Find Them
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large language models by mapping weights to low-bit representations. The scaling factor that defines the quantization grid is typically chosen using simple, data-free heuristics. In this work, we present PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), an algorithm that leverages calibration data to compute the optimal channel-wise weight scales exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization. PiSO partitions the scale search space into finitely many i

summary.core_problem: 后训练量化（PTQ）中缩放因子通常采用简单无数据启发式（如 absmax）选择，忽略了输入激活如何在层输出处放大概率化误差；现有数据感知方法有限，且最优通道级缩放因子能否在 round-to-nearest 量化下被精确高效计算是一个未解决问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于量化校准数据效率的改进——PiSO 减少了精确定量所需的校准数据量，这对于模型压缩与部署环节和预训练的接口有参考价值；此外，scale 优化与误差校正算法的联合优化思路可迁移至其他模型压缩场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PiSO（Piecewise Scale Optimization）算法，核心洞察是量化函数 q(w;s) 关于 s 是分段常数的，因此可将实轴（s 的搜索空间）划分为有限多个区间，每个区间内误差函数有闭式最优解。通过高效增量更新遍历这些区间，可在多项式时间内得到每个通道的全局最优 scale。通过两种互补近似扩展到分组量化（其中一种可捕捉跨组交互），并提出三种策略与 GPTQ 等贪婪误差校正方法交错优化 scale 和权重网格分配。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上进行了多模型尺寸和目标位宽的综合实验。结果显示 PiSO 无论单独使用还是与 GPTQ、Qronos 结合，都在困惑度和下游零样本精度上取得持续改进；目标位宽越窄（量化越困难），改进幅度越大。PiSO 同时减少了 RTN 和与 GPTQ 结合场景下所需的校准数据量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看方法章节中 PiSO 算法的三个关键观察（通道可分性、固定网格分配的闭式最优、分段常数洞察），与 GPTQ 的结合策略，以及实验章节中的低位宽消融结果。预计阅读时间：25-35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Scaling factors in post-training quantization (PTQ) are typically chosen using simple data-free heuristics (e.g., absmax) that ignore how input activations amplify quantization errors at layer output. Existing data-aware methods are limited, and whether optimal channel-wise scales can be computed exactly and efficiently under round-to-nearest quantization remained an open question.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining research is improved calibration data efficiency for quantization — PiSO reduces the amount of calibration data needed for accurate quantization, which has implications for the model compression/deployment interface with pretraining. The joint optimization of scale and error correction also provides a transferable idea to other model compression scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PiSO (Piecewise Scale Optimization), whose key insight is that the quantization function q(w;s) is piecewise constant in s, allowing the real line (search space for s) to be partitioned into finitely many intervals where the error admits a closed-form minimizer. Sweeping these intervals with efficient incremental updates yields the globally optimal scale per channel in polynomial time. Extends to group-wise quantization via two complementary approximations (one capturing cross-group interactions), and proposes three interleaving strategies to integrate with greedy error correction methods like GPTQ.
summary_en.experiments: Comprehensive experiments on Llama and Qwen models across multiple model sizes and target weight bit-widths. PiSO yields consistent improvements in perplexity and downstream zero-shot accuracy, both standalone and when combined with GPTQ and Qronos. Benefits increase as target bit-width narrows and quantization becomes more challenging. PiSO also reduces calibration data requirements under both RTN and GPTQ-integrated settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section for PiSO's three key observations (channel separability, closed-form optimum for fixed grid assignment, piecewise constant insight), GPTQ integration strategies, and the low-bitwidth ablation results in experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: PiSO对PTQ量化给出了一个干净的闭形式解，比传统启发式有理论优势，做低bit推理的人应看§3的分区分析
recommendation.en: PiSO provides a clean closed-form solution for PTQ scale optimization with theoretical advantages over heuristics; §3 interval analysis is worth reading for low-bit inference practitioners

paper.title: SHAPE: Coalition-Aware Expert Pruning for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models achieve strong quality with low per-token compute, yet their deployment is often limited by the memory wall: the full expert pool must remain resident to support token-dependent routing. Expert pruning is a direct remedy, but prior criteria typically score experts independently and overlook that MoE inference is inherently \emph{coalitional}, where outputs arise from routed top-$k$ expert combinations. We propose \textbf{SHAPE}, a task-driven

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE LLM的专家剪枝方法独立评估专家重要性，忽略了MoE推理中top-k专家组合的联盟特性，导致剪枝后性能下降明显
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，首次将合作博弈引入MoE专家剪枝，建模专家间的协作关系，剪枝后可在相同内存预算下保留更高性能
summary.technical_approach: 提出SHAPE框架，将小校准集上的路由轨迹建模为经验合作博弈，通过基于观测到的top-k联盟的Shapley式归因，分配考虑交互的专家价值，识别对高效用协作至关重要的专家；进一步提出质量感知的全局剪枝策略，在预算约束下保留MoE拓扑结构
summary.experiments: 在多个MoE模型上测试，相比独立剪枝基线，在相同剪枝比例下性能下降更少，在相同内存约束下可获得更高的推理性能（原文摘要截断，具体数值未披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing expert pruning methods for MoE LLMs evaluate expert importance independently, ignoring the coalitional property of top-k expert combinations in MoE inference, leading to significant performance degradation after pruning
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution, first introduces cooperative game theory to MoE expert pruning, models the collaboration between experts, and retains higher performance under the same memory budget after pruning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the SHAPE framework, models routing traces on a small calibration set as an empirical cooperative game, assigns interaction-aware expert values via Shapley-style attribution over observed top-k coalitions, identifies experts essential for high-utility collaborations; further proposes a quality-aware global pruning strategy to preserve MoE topology under budget constraints
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple MoE models, has less performance degradation than independent pruning baselines under the same pruning ratio, and achieves higher inference performance under the same memory constraint (abstract truncated, specific values not disclosed)

recommendation.zh: MoE专家剪枝的联盟视角非常关键，Shapley归因的思路可直接复现用于内部MoE的专家冗余分析
recommendation.en: The coalition perspective for MoE expert pruning is critical; the Shapley attribution idea can be directly reproduced for internal MoE expert redundancy analysis.

paper.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
paper.abstract: We present SigmaScale, a method for learning auxiliary scaling matrices $S$ to aid truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) based Large Language Model (LLM) compression. Instead of deriving scaling matrices analytically, SigmaScale optimizes two sets of vectors that define diagonal row and column scaling transformations under an activation-aware compression loss. We show that learned scaling lowers the effective intrinsic rank of weight matrices, as reflected by reductions in effective-rank

summary.core_problem: 在基于截断 SVD 的 LLM 低秩压缩中，如何通过可学习缩放变换进一步降低压缩误差并提升压缩后性能。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的模型压缩工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解权重矩阵可压缩性、激活感知压缩目标以及低秩结构的可塑性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SigmaScale，在做 SVD 低秩分解前，不再使用解析式缩放矩阵，而是学习两组对角缩放向量，对权重矩阵做行/列缩放变换。训练目标是 activation-aware compression loss。论文还用 effective-rank entropy 作为分析工具，声称学习到的缩放会降低有效内在秩，并且这一变化与压缩损失相关。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上进行，与相近的 SVD 压缩方法比较，指标包括 perplexity 和 zero-shot benchmark。结论是 SigmaScale 与现有 SVD-based 方法大体相当，在部分任务上更好。摘要没有给出明确压缩倍率和稳定领先幅度，因此更像是局部改良而非明显跃迁。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Aalborg University Copenhagen、University of Genoa、CERN 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to reduce error in truncated-SVD compression of LLMs by learning scaling transformations instead of using analytically derived ones.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and compression paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Its main value for a foundation-model researcher is the perspective on weight compressibility, activation-aware objectives, and how much low-rank structure can be reshaped by simple learned transforms.
summary_en.technical_approach: SigmaScale learns two sets of diagonal row/column scaling vectors applied before truncated SVD, replacing fixed analytical scaling rules. The optimization target is an activation-aware compression loss. The paper also analyzes effective-rank entropy and argues that learned scaling lowers the effective intrinsic rank of weight matrices, which correlates with compression loss.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Qwen3-8B, compared against closely related SVD-based compression baselines using perplexity and zero-shot benchmarks. The reported outcome is competitive overall, with gains on some tasks. The abstract does not show a clear compression-ratio-versus-quality frontier or large margins, so this reads more like a careful local improvement than a major shift.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Aalborg University Copenhagen, the University of Genoa, CERN, and others.

recommendation.zh: 是个干净的 SVD 小改进，不会改变你对压缩的总体判断；若你关心低秩可塑性，只看 effective-rank 分析和压缩损失相关性即可。
recommendation.en: A clean but local SVD tweak; it will not change your overall compression prior, but the effective-rank analysis is worth a quick look if you care about low-rank plasticity.

institutions: European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN), Geneva

paper.title: Knowledge Distillation for Visual Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) image generation models are highly expressive but computationally intensive, motivating effective model compression. Knowledge distillation (KD) is a natural approach for model compression and has been widely studied in language modeling, yet its behavior in visual AR generation remains underexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of distillation strategies for AR image models. Our analysis shows that while standard distillation can yield meaningful gain

summary.core_problem: 自回归(AR)图像生成模型计算量大需要压缩，但知识蒸馏(KD)在视觉AR生成中的行为尚未被系统研究，且语言模型中发展的蒸馏方法不能直接迁移到图像。
summary.importance: 首次对视觉AR模型的蒸馏策略进行系统研究，提出VarKD框架，填补了视觉生成模型蒸馏方法论的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VarKD：在学生模型生成的样本上进行蒸馏，同时选择性应用教师监督并减少token层级歧义；针对图像长解码视界和视觉token歧义问题进行了专门设计。
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet上对多种AR骨干模型进行实验，VarKD在不同架构下一致优于标准蒸馏方法；摘要未提供具体量化提升数字。
summary.authors_note: Elia Peruzzo, Aritra Bhowmik, Guillaume Sautiere, Yuki M. Asano (University of Amsterdam), Amirhossein Habibian (Qualcomm AI Research)

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive image generators are computationally expensive and need compression, but knowledge distillation behavior in visual AR models is underexplored; KD methods developed for language models do not transfer directly to images.
summary_en.importance: First systematic study of distillation strategies for visual autoregressive models; proposes VarKD framework, filling a methodological gap in visual generative model distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: VarKD performs distillation on student-sampled outputs with selective teacher supervision and reduced token-level ambiguity, specifically designed to handle long decoding horizons and visual token ambiguity in images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ImageNet across multiple AR backbones; VarKD consistently outperforms standard distillation; exact quantitative gains not provided in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Elia Peruzzo, Aritra Bhowmik, Guillaume Sautiere, Yuki M. Asano (University of Amsterdam), Amirhossein Habibian (Qualcomm AI Research)

recommendation.zh: 视觉AR蒸馏的首次系统研究，结论"LM蒸馏不能直接迁移到图像"对跨模态蒸馏有微弱启发，仅看§3方法概述即可。
recommendation.en: First systematic KD study for visual AR models; the finding that LM distillation does not transfer to images is weakly informative for cross-modal distillation research. Read only Section 3.

paper.title: Calibration Data Trade-offs Across Capability Dimensions: Why Multi-Source Mixing Matters for High-Sparsity LLM Pruning
paper.abstract: Post-training pruning compresses large language models to high sparsity using a small unlabelled calibration set, and recent work has concluded that the choice of calibration source has only modest impact on averaged post-pruning accuracy. We ask whether this conclusion survives once calibration impact is evaluated separately across distinct capability dimensions rather than aggregated. Decomposing post-pruning capability into General, Commonsense, Code, and Math, and analysing $n{=}15$ calibrat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是高稀疏度 LLM 剪枝中的校准数据选择问题。核心结论是：如果只看平均准确率，校准数据源的影响会被低估；一旦按 General、Commonsense、Code、Math 拆开评估，单一校准源会出现明显的能力取舍，尤其在 SparseGPT 60% 稀疏度下很突出。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练研究不是直接贡献训练 recipe，但对模型压缩和部署前评估有明确启发。它说明小规模无标注校准集不是一个中性的实现细节，而会通过激活统计或 Hessian 近似改变被保留的权重结构。更重要的是，校准数据的困惑度与不同能力维度的保留率呈相反相关：高困惑度文本更利于 General，低困惑度数学或代码数据更利于 Math 和 Code。这提醒压缩评估不能只报平均分，尤其不能只用通用 benchmark 掩盖能力坍缩。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先定义多维能力保留指标，把剪枝后模型相对原模型的表现拆到 General、Commonsense、Code、Math 四类任务中。然后对 15 个校准源做信息特征分析，重点看 Objective Information Theory 中的若干指标，包括 Distortion，也就是用困惑度刻画的分布难度，以及 Aggregation，也就是 4-gram 重复带来的模式聚集。实验证明，真正稳定预测剪枝后能力保留的是 Distortion 和 Aggregation，而不是 Scope、Variety、Granularity、Mismatch 这类更宽泛的统计量。基于这个诊断，论文提出两条路径：一是 mix_balanced，在固定 128 条序列预算下，从 General、Commonsense、Code、Math 对齐语料中均匀采样；二是 IGSP，在没有能力对齐语料时，用基座模型自生成数据，并通过低 4-gram 聚集和按能力维度平衡的 PPL 区间来构造多源校准集。它和 Self-Cal、SGS 的区别在于不把自生成数据看成单一分布，而是显式按能力维度组织。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上做，剪枝方法包括 SparseGPT 和 Wanda，校准预算固定为 128 条序列。SparseGPT 60% 稀疏度下，C4 的总保留分为 40.0，最佳单源 MetaMath 为 50.0，mix_balanced 达到 58.8；相对 C4 提升 18.8 分，相对最佳单源提升 8.8 分。Code 维度上，mix_balanced 相比 C4 提升 51.9 分，说明平均分会掩盖单项能力的大幅退化。随着稀疏度升高，混合校准的收益单调放大：30% 稀疏度时提升 4.6 分，60% 时提升 18.8 分。相关性分析显示，校准困惑度与 General 保留率正相关，Spearman ρ = +0.71；与 Math 和 Code 保留率负相关，分别为 ρ = -0.53 和 -0.59，且 p < 0.05。IGSP 在 SparseGPT 60% 下相对 Self-Cal 提升 2.4 分，相对 SGS 提升 4.8 分，但仍比真实多源数据低 9.7 分，说明表层 PPL 过滤不能完全替代真实内容质量。另一个有用发现是 Wanda 在 60% 稀疏度下对校准源不敏感，各种校准方案落在 3.8 分窗口内；作者将其解释为 Wanda 主要用校准数据估计局部激活幅度，而 SparseGPT 的 Hessian 驱动更新会更强地把校准分布传播到全局权重调整中。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 §5.1 和 §5.2，理解困惑度对不同能力维度的相反相关，这是论文最有信息量的部分。然后看 §5.3 的 mix_balanced 结果，重点关注不同稀疏度下收益如何放大。§5.4 可用于理解自生成校准数据的上限，尤其是 IGSP 与 Self-Cal、SGS 的差异。§5.5 对 SparseGPT 和 Wanda 的机制差异有参考价值，适合关心剪枝算法与校准数据耦合方式的读者。方法部分可以快速扫过指标定义，不必逐项深挖 OIT 的所有指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies calibration-data selection for high-sparsity post-training pruning of LLMs. Its main point is that average benchmark accuracy hides strong capability-specific trade-offs: a single calibration source can preserve general benchmarks while severely damaging code or math, especially under SparseGPT at 60% sparsity.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to compression and deployment than to pretraining itself, but it carries a useful lesson for model researchers: the small unlabeled calibration set is not a harmless detail. It shapes activation statistics or Hessian approximations, and therefore changes which weights survive pruning. The paper also gives a concrete reason why single-source calibration is fragile. Calibration perplexity correlates positively with General retention but negatively with Math and Code retention, so optimizing one aggregate score can create hidden regressions in specialized capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors replace aggregate post-pruning accuracy with a capability-retention view over four dimensions: General, Commonsense, Code, and Math. They then profile 15 calibration sources using information metrics from Objective Information Theory. The strongest predictors are Distortion, operationalized through perplexity, and Aggregation, measured through repeated 4-gram patterns. Broader measures such as Scope, Variety, Granularity, and Mismatch are less reliable. Based on this analysis, the paper proposes two calibration constructions. The first is mix_balanced, which samples uniformly from capability-aligned pools under the same 128-sequence budget used by the baselines. The second is IGSP, a self-generation protocol that uses the base model and the evaluation taxonomy to create capability-balanced calibration data, while controlling perplexity bands and reducing repeated-pattern bias. Compared with Self-Cal and SGS, IGSP treats self-generated calibration as a multi-source design problem rather than a single generated distribution filtered by surface statistics.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use LLaMA-3.1-8B with SparseGPT and Wanda, under a fixed 128-sequence calibration budget. With SparseGPT at 60% sparsity, mix_balanced reaches a total retention score of 58.8, compared with 50.0 for the best single source, MetaMath, and 40.0 for the C4 default. The gain over C4 is 18.8 points overall, and the Code dimension alone improves by 51.9 points. The benefit of multi-source calibration increases with sparsity, from +4.6 points at 30% sparsity to +18.8 points at 60%. The correlation analysis reports Spearman ρ = +0.71 between calibration perplexity and General retention, but ρ = -0.53 for Math and ρ = -0.59 for Code, with p < 0.05. IGSP improves over Self-Cal by 2.4 points and over SGS by 4.8 points at SparseGPT 60%, while still trailing real multi-source calibration by 9.7 points. Wanda behaves differently: at 60% sparsity, all calibration variants fall within a narrow 3.8-point range, consistent with Wanda using calibration mainly as a local activation-magnitude estimator rather than as a global Hessian-driven weight-update signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: A selective read is enough. Spend most of the time on §5.1 and §5.2, where the capability trade-off and the perplexity correlations are established. Then read §5.3 for the multi-source calibration results across sparsity levels. §5.4 is useful for understanding the limits of self-generated calibration data, especially why IGSP narrows but does not close the gap to real mixed data. §5.5 is worth reading if the interaction between pruning algorithms and calibration data matters for your work. The metric definitions in the methodology section can be skimmed after the empirical tables are clear.

recommendation.zh: 只看相关性表和IGSP消融；它提醒剪枝校准集不能用平均分洗掉能力偏科。
recommendation.en: Read the correlation table and IGSP ablations; it is a useful warning that averaged pruning scores can hide capability-specific calibration damage.

paper.title: Pruning Deep Neural Networks via the Marchenko--Pastur Distribution
paper.abstract: We study a Marchenko--Pastur (MP) random-matrix approach to pruning deep neural networks with very small post-pruning fine-tuning budgets. The main practical contribution is accuracy retention under short calibration and fine-tuning schedules, rather than a long post-pruning reoptimization pipeline. The theory gives deterministic data-path certificates: if the removed component $R$ has small propagated logit effect $L_s \| R ψ_1(s) \|_\infty$, pruning decreases an elastic-net objective and prese

summary.core_problem: 神经网络剪枝在极小后剪枝微调预算下保持精度的理论保证和实际方法。
summary.importance: 基于随机矩阵理论提供剪枝的理论证书，对极小预算微调场景有实际贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 使用Marchenko-Pastur分布的随机矩阵方法，提出确定性数据路径证书：若移除分量R的传播logit效应小，则剪枝降低elastic-net目标并保留样本。推导了零预算完美剪枝、剪枝-恢复扩展和L2正则化模型的理论结果。
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet上实验，拟合MP边缘σ_+给出高概率层级预算信号。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自宾州州立大学和加州理工学院；Houman Owhadi是Caltech应用数学教授，知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Theoretical guarantees and practical methods for neural network pruning that retain accuracy under very small post-pruning fine-tuning budgets.
summary_en.importance: Provides deterministic data-path certificates based on random matrix theory — a theoretical contribution to low-budget post-pruning calibration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Random-matrix approach via the Marchenko-Pastur distribution; deterministic data-path certificates: if removed component R has small propagated logit effect, pruning decreases an elastic-net objective and preserves samples. Derives results for zero-budget perfect pruning, prune-restore extensions, and L2-regularized models.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on ImageNet; fitted MP edge σ_+ gives high-probability layerwise budget signals.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Penn State and Caltech; Houman Owhadi is a well-known professor of applied mathematics at Caltech.

recommendation.zh: 理论严谨但主要针对小模型剪枝，对LLM大规模剪枝的直接指导有限，可作为理论参考。
recommendation.en: Theoretically rigorous but targets small-model pruning; limited direct guidance for LLM-scale pruning — useful as theoretical reference only.

paper.title: Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter
paper.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient specialization of foundation models, but the proliferation of task-specific adapters fragments capabilities across many adapters, complicating reuse and deployment. We study the problem of merging $T$ LoRAs into a single rank-$r$ LoRA, thereby preserving the benefits of low-rank structure. Existing Merge-then-Compress pipelines treat the rank constraint as an afterthought: they merge adapters in the full parameter space, then compress the me

summary.core_problem: 如何将多个特定任务的 LoRA 适配器合并为一个单一的低秩（rank-r）LoRA，同时避免全参数合并导致的低秩结构破坏？
summary.importance: 方法改进。提出了一种“先压缩后合并（Compress-then-Merge, CtM）”的管道，解决了现有“先合并后压缩”方法在截断 SVD 时难以恢复有效低秩结构的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CtM 方法：在合并前强制执行 rank-r 瓶颈。首先仅使用 LoRA 权重计算共享的 r 维子空间以捕获跨适配器的公共结构，然后将每个适配器投影到共享子空间中获得 r×r 坐标，最后在这些坐标上进行合并。
summary.experiments: 相比于传统的 Merge-then-Compress 方法，CtM 能够更好地保留多个 LoRA 的能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to merge multiple task-specific LoRA adapters into a single low-rank (rank-r) LoRA while avoiding the destruction of the low-rank structure caused by full-parameter merging?
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement. Proposes a 'Compress-then-Merge' (CtM) pipeline, solving the issue of existing 'Merge-then-Compress' methods struggling to recover an effective low-rank structure during truncated SVD.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the CtM method: enforces the rank-r bottleneck before merging. It first computes shared r-dimensional subspaces using only the LoRA weights to capture cross-adapter common structure, then projects each adapter into the shared subspaces to obtain r×r coordinates, and finally merges on these coordinates.
summary_en.experiments: Compared to traditional Merge-then-Compress methods, CtM better preserves the capabilities of multiple LoRAs.

recommendation.zh: 关于多 LoRA 合并的工程优化，将 SVD 截断提前以保留低秩结构的思路很自然，属于 PEFT 领域的常规改进，对基座预训练无直接影响。
recommendation.en: An engineering optimization for multi-LoRA merging. The idea of advancing SVD truncation to preserve the low-rank structure is natural, a routine improvement in the PEFT domain with no direct impact on base pretraining.

paper.title: STARFISH: faST Accuracy Recovery in pruned networks From Internal State Healing
paper.abstract: Pruning is a process designed to reduce the number of weights in a large neural network. This can substantially speed up inference but might cause a considerable reduction in the model's accuracy, and thus it is usually followed by a healing process that regains some of the lost accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new healing method, STARFISH, that can recover (most of) the accuracy of any pruned network efficiently. The main idea of STARFISH is to optimize the pruned network to align with the

summary.core_problem: 高稀疏度剪枝后模型精度会出现大幅下降，传统精度恢复方法需要访问完整训练数据、计算成本高，现有快速恢复方案在高稀疏度场景下效果不佳。
summary.importance: 提出了无需访问原训练数据的剪枝后精度恢复方案，为大模型轻量化部署提供了更高效的压缩后处理路径，可显著降低部署成本。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是优化剪枝后模型的中间层表示与原稠密模型中间层表示的方向对齐，仅使用少量无标签校准样本即可完成恢复，适配任意剪枝方法和模型架构，不依赖现有方法常用的Hessian近似或闭式解推导。
summary.experiments: 在ViT、MobileNet等视觉Transformer架构上测试，85%权重稀疏度下可恢复原模型92%的精度；50%稀疏度下，相比现有最优恢复方法CORP最高提升31.5个百分点的精度恢复率，最高达到原稠密模型99.8%的精度保留率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的动机与核心贡献、第2章的方法概述，以及图1的不同稀疏度下性能对比，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: High sparsity pruning leads to significant accuracy degradation in neural networks. Traditional accuracy recovery methods require access to full training data and high computational cost, while existing fast recovery solutions perform poorly under high sparsity scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a post-pruning accuracy recovery pipeline that does not require access to original training data, offering a more efficient post-compression processing path for large model lightweight deployment and significantly reducing deployment overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to optimize the directional alignment of intermediate representations between the pruned network and the original dense network, using only a small set of unlabeled calibration samples. It is compatible with all pruning methods and model architectures, and does not rely on Hessian approximation or closed-form derivation commonly used in existing methods.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on ViT and MobileNet architectures. At 85% weight sparsity, it recovers 92% of the original dense model accuracy. At 50% sparsity, it outperforms the prior leading recovery method CORP by up to 31.5 percentage points in accuracy recovery, reaching 99.8% accuracy retention of the original dense model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 for motivation and core contributions, Section 2 for method overview, and Figure 1 for performance comparison across different sparsity levels. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 剪枝恢复思路可迁移至LLM低比特量化后的精度校准，只看方法核心逻辑和ViT实验结果即可
recommendation.en: The pruning recovery idea can be migrated to accuracy calibration after LLM low-bit quantization; only read the core method logic and ViT experiment results

paper.title: ConMoE: Expert-Pool Consolidation via Prototype Reassignment for MoE Compression
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation but still require storing and serving all experts, making deployment memory-intensive. Existing post-training compression methods mainly shrink this cost by pruning experts or merging their weights. We formulate post-training MoE compression as expert-pool consolidation: retaining a smaller set of pretrained experts as reusable prototypes and deterministically remapping each original expert reference to one selected prototype.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 部署里的一个很具体但常被混在一起的问题：稀疏激活降低了每 token 计算量，但并没有降低专家参数的存储和服务成本，因为整套 expert pool 仍然必须可寻址。作者把 post-training MoE 压缩重新表述为“expert-pool consolidation”：不是直接剪掉专家，或把多个专家做权重融合，而是在给定预算下保留一部分预训练专家作为 prototype，再把原始每个 expert slot 确定性地重映射到某个 prototype。这样把两个决策拆开了：一是保留哪些参数，二是原 router 看到的 expert 引用如何被表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身的直接影响有限，因为它不改变训练目标、路由学习或 MoE 扩展规律，主要是部署侧的后处理压缩方法。但它对 MoE 基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，它说明很多 expert 冗余并不需要通过再训练才能利用，单靠“保留+重映射”就能在一定压缩率下维持性能，这反过来提示预训练阶段可能存在较强的专家同质化。第二，它把“参数池”和“路由接口”解耦，这个视角对以后做可压缩 MoE、共享专家设计、局部跨层专家复用有参考价值。贡献量级更像是一个清晰的问题重述加一个稳健的 train-free 基线，而不是改变 MoE 训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个不训练的 prototype remapping 框架。作者先在单层或局部相邻层组成的 scope 内，把所有 routed experts 看成待压缩对象；给定压缩比例 rho，从原专家集合里选出一个较小的 prototype pool P，再为每个原始专家 e 指定一个映射 m(e) 到某个 prototype。压缩后的模型不改 router，不改 top-k 逻辑，也不改共享模块；只是当 router 选中原 expert slot 时，实际调用其对应 prototype。这样可以保持原有 router interface，不需要重新学习门控。

从 formulation 看，这接近一个带权代表点选择问题：每个原专家有重要性权重 w_e，每个原专家到候选 prototype 有表示代价 d(e,p)，目标是在预算约束下最小化总重映射代价。论文默认 prototype 必须来自已有 pretrained experts，而不是新合成专家；默认也不做权重更新或压缩后微调。作者把 post-hoc weight fusion 只作为诊断性分析，而不是主流程，这一点很重要，因为它让结果更能说明“纯重映射”本身的效果。

ConMoE 的设计还有两个边界条件。其一，允许 local cross-layer sharing，即相邻层在一个有限 scope 内共享 prototype，但不做全模型范围共享，原因是跨太远层的功能错配更严重。其二，预算可以在 scope 内非均匀分配，而不是每层硬性等比例压缩，这给了方法一定灵活性。论文的关键不在复杂算法，而在这个表示层面的拆分：压缩后逻辑上的 expert slot 数量不变，但物理存储的 prototype 数量减少；要真正拿到内存收益，需要 checkpoint 或 runtime 支持 prototype 共享去重。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验结论主要是定性的：在多个预训练 MoE 语言模型上，ConMoE 在匹配的 logical routed-expert budget 下，可以作为 pruning 和 merging 之外的可行替代；确定性重映射是最稳定的组成部分；更激进的跨层共享和事后权重融合则明显更依赖模型。论文还特别区分了“逻辑压缩”和“物理内存节省”：如果一个 prototype 被多个原 expert slot 复用，逻辑上只算一次，但实际节省内存要靠实现层支持。

由于提供的全文内容被截断，具体实验数字、模型规模、压缩比例下的困惑度或下游性能变化没有完整暴露，无法可靠复述。阅读时应重点核对：1）比较对象是否包含简单的 layer-wise pruning / merge baselines；2）不同 rho 下的 loss 或 benchmark 退化曲线；3）单层重映射与局部跨层共享的差异；4）prototype 选择准则和距离度量 d(e,p) 对结果的敏感性；5）是否在 Mixtral、DeepSeekMoE、Qwen-MoE、OLMoE 等不同架构上都保持一致趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，理解作者为什么坚持把“保留哪些专家”和“如何表示原 expert slot”拆开。再看方法部分里 prototype selection、reassignment cost、scope 设计这三块，判断它到底是一个新视角还是只是换名的聚类压缩。最后看实验表和消融，重点盯三件事：压缩率-性能曲线、跨层共享是否真的有益、weight fusion 为什么只适合作为诊断项。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你做 MoE serving 或可压缩架构设计，再花时间看实现假设和 logical/physical saving 的区别。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific deployment bottleneck in MoE models: sparse routing reduces per-token FLOPs, but not the storage and serving cost of the expert pool, since all experts must remain addressable. Instead of treating post-training compression as pruning or weight merging, the authors recast it as expert-pool consolidation: keep a smaller subset of pretrained experts as prototypes, then deterministically remap every original expert slot to one retained prototype. This separates two decisions that are usually entangled: which expert parameters are stored, and how the router-facing expert references are represented after compression.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is modest, since it does not change the training objective, routing dynamics, or MoE scaling behavior. Still, it is relevant to foundation-model research for two reasons. First, it suggests that a nontrivial amount of expert redundancy can be exploited without retraining, which is indirect evidence that pretrained MoE experts may be more interchangeable than their parameter count suggests. Second, the paper cleanly decouples the parameter pool from the routing interface, a useful perspective for future work on compressible MoE design, expert sharing, and local cross-layer reuse. The contribution is best viewed as a strong train-free compression framing and baseline, not as a new MoE training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ConMoE is a train-free prototype remapping framework. Within a layer or a bounded local scope of neighboring MoE layers, the routed experts are treated as the compressible object. Given a reduction ratio rho, the method selects a smaller prototype pool P from the original pretrained experts, then assigns each original expert e to a prototype m(e). The router is left unchanged: when it selects an original expert slot, execution is redirected to the assigned prototype. This preserves the original router interface and avoids relearning gating.

Formally, the setup resembles a weighted representative selection problem. Each original expert has an importance weight w_e, and each expert-prototype pair has a reassignment cost d(e,p). Under a budget on the number of retained prototypes, the goal is to minimize total weighted reassignment cost. In the default setting, prototypes must be existing pretrained experts rather than synthesized experts, and there is no post-compression finetuning. Post-hoc weight fusion is only used as a diagnostic sensitivity study, which is an important design choice because it isolates the effect of remapping itself.

Two design boundaries matter. First, the method allows local cross-layer sharing inside a bounded scope, but avoids model-wide sharing because distant layers are more likely to have incompatible expert functions. Second, the compression budget can be allocated non-uniformly across layers within a scope. The main novelty is not algorithmic complexity but the representational split: the logical set of router-visible expert slots stays intact, while the physically stored expert pool shrinks. Actual memory savings therefore depend on checkpoint or runtime support for deduplicated shared prototypes.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main empirical claims are qualitative rather than fully numeric: across multiple pretrained MoE language models, ConMoE is a viable alternative to pruning and merging under matched logical routed-expert budgets; deterministic reassignment is the most stable component; broader cross-layer sharing and post-hoc weight fusion are more model-dependent. The paper also explicitly distinguishes logical compression from physical memory reduction: if one prototype serves multiple original expert slots, it only counts once logically, but real memory savings require implementation support.

Because the supplied content is truncated, the exact model sizes, compression ratios, perplexity changes, and downstream benchmark numbers are not fully available here. When reading the paper, the key checks are: whether the baselines include simple layer-wise pruning and merge methods; how performance degrades as rho increases; whether local cross-layer sharing helps consistently; how sensitive results are to the prototype selection rule and the distance metric d(e,p); and whether the trends hold across Mixtral-, DeepSeekMoE-, Qwen-MoE-, and OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The main value is the reframing: separating expert retention from router-facing representation. Then read the method section around prototype selection, reassignment cost, and scope design to see whether this is genuinely different from clustering-style compression. Finally, inspect the main tables and ablations with three questions in mind: the compression-performance curve, whether cross-layer sharing actually helps, and why weight fusion is treated as diagnostic rather than default. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. Spend more time only if you work on MoE serving or architecture design for compressibility.

recommendation.zh: 无需训练的MoE压缩是部署友好方向，ConMoE的原型重映射思路比简单剪枝更优雅。做MoE推理优化的团队应评估此方法。
recommendation.en: Train-free MoE compression is deployment-friendly; ConMoE's prototype remapping is more elegant than simple pruning. Teams doing MoE inference optimization should evaluate this approach.

paper.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is now the dominant architecture for frontier language models, yet it requires all expert parameters to be loaded in memory, making it less preferable for memory-constrained deployment. Existing compression methods reduce the number of experts but the output remains an MoE model with the same fundamental limitation. We present the first systematic framework for converting a trained MoE into a standard fully dense architecture: experts are scored, selected, and grouped, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 模型部署里的一个结构性矛盾：MoE 每个 token 只激活少数 expert，所以活跃参数量低、训练和推理算力效率高；但部署时通常仍要把所有 expert 常驻显存，内存占用接近总参数量，而不是活跃参数量。已有压缩方法大多还是把大 MoE 压成小 MoE，问题没有根治。作者要回答的是：能不能把一个已经训练好的 MoE 系统性地转成标准 dense 架构，同时尽量保留 MoE 的能力，并且比从 dense teacher 出发做剪枝蒸馏更划算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在模型族构建和 teacher 选择，而不是新预训练范式。MoE 已经是前沿大模型的主流架构之一，但实际产品常常还要配套发布小 dense 模型。传统做法要么单独训练 dense，要么先有一个大 dense teacher 再做 dense-to-dense 压缩，成本高，也没有利用好 MoE teacher 的知识结构。这篇文章给出了一条比较完整的 MoE-to-dense 路线，并且实验表明，在相同学生规模下，直接从 MoE teacher 蒸馏出来的 dense 学生优于 dense-to-dense 剪枝蒸馏。这一点很有现实意义：如果成立，未来模型家族不一定需要同时维护一条大 dense 主线和一条大 MoE 主线，MoE 旗舰模型本身就可以成为 dense 子模型的上游来源。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步，逻辑很清楚。

第一步是 expert selection。对每层的 E 个 expert 打分，选出 top-K。这里 K 是转换时保留的 expert 数，k 是原 MoE 路由的 top-k 激活数，两者不同。作者系统比较了 7 种打分方法，结论是打分方法远比后续 grouping 更重要。论文最核心的新点是 diversity-aware scoring：不是只看某个 expert 被路由得多不多、激活强不强，而是同时考虑重要性和互补性。具体做法是构造 importance-weighted Gram matrix，用 log-determinant 做 D-optimal 选择准则，鼓励选出的 expert 既强又不冗余。文中最优方法叫 DO-ACP。

第二步是 grouping / merging / densification。若 K>k，就把选出的 expert 分成 k 组，在组内做加权平均；若 K=k，则直接保留，不做 merge。然后把得到的 k 个 expert 沿中间维拼接，形成一个标准 dense FFN。由于 MoE 的输出原本是 router 权重加权和，而 dense FFN 是直接拼接后统一下投影，作者还讨论了 down-projection scaling，用来校正输出幅值，避免转换后激活尺度失真。

第三步是 distillation。结构转换后会有能力损失，作者用 teacher MoE 对 dense 学生做知识蒸馏恢复性能。全文里一个重要设计点是，他们先用大规模网格搜索在较短蒸馏预算下找 recipe，再在更长蒸馏 token 数上验证最优配置是否仍然成立。这比只报单一 recipe 更扎实。

方法上最值得注意的判断有两个。其一，expert selection 比 grouping 更关键，说明 MoE 压缩里“选谁”比“怎么合”更决定上限。其二，最优配置往往是 pure pruning，即选出多样化 expert 后直接拼成 dense，而不是先合并再拼接。这意味着很多 MoE expert 之间并不是简单可平均的冗余副本；如果选得足够多样，merge 反而会抹掉专长。
summary.experiments:
实验设计相当完整。主实验基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，系统评估了 7 种 expert scoring、5 种 grouping、2 种 down-projection scaling，以及不同 K 取值，总共 350 个配置。然后又在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上做了验证。

最重要的结果有四个。

第一，scoring method 是主导因素。最好和最差的打分方法在平均下游准确率上相差 5.7 个百分点，而 grouping 策略的影响只有约 1 个点。这说明如果只在 merge 细节上做文章，而 selection 没做好，收益很有限。

第二，最佳 recipe 是 diversity-aware scoring 加 pure pruning。也就是用 DO-ACP 选出多样化 expert，且不做 weight averaging。相反，基于频率的打分更容易选到相似 expert，因此才会从 merging 中受益。这个结果很有解释力：merge 不是天然有用，它更多是在弥补 selection 的冗余。

第三，MoE-to-dense 明显优于 dense-to-dense pruning。在一个控制实验里，教师规模都在约 30B，学生都是约 3B，经过约 4B token 蒸馏后，MoE-to-dense 最优配置比 dense-to-dense pruning 高 6.3 个百分点，同时训练 wall-clock 快 1.6 倍。这个结果是全文最有分量的结论之一，因为它不只是证明“能转”，而是证明“从 MoE teacher 出发更合算”。

第四，作者先在约 0.3B token 蒸馏预算下筛 recipe，再在更长训练上验证优势仍然存在，说明结论不是短训偶然现象。摘要中没有展开所有 benchmark 名称和逐项分数，但从全文结构看，评测覆盖了多任务平均表现，而不是只看 perplexity。

需要补一句边界：这篇文章比较的是压缩路线，不是从头训练同规模 dense 学生的最优上限，也不是研究 MoE teacher 在预训练阶段为什么更适合蒸馏。因此它给出的更多是工程决策证据，而不是机制层面的最终解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“结论驱动”来读。

先看方法总览图和 Section 3 的转换流程，弄清楚 K 与 k 的区别，以及为什么 MoE 的 active parameter count 可以对应到 dense FFN 的中间维度。这个映射关系如果没看明白，后面的结果会显得像经验技巧。

然后重点看 expert scoring 部分。尤其是 diversity-aware 的 Gram log-det 目标，这是全文最有新意的地方。要关注它为什么能同时编码 importance 和 diversity，以及它和简单 activation frequency、router probability、weight norm 这类指标的差别。

接着看 Section 4.2 和 4.4 一类的主结果：350 个配置的比较、scoring 与 grouping 的相对影响、MoE-to-dense 对 dense-to-dense 的控制实验。这几部分决定这篇文章是否只是“又一个压缩 recipe”，还是在 teacher 选择上给出更强证据。

最后看 extended distillation 和 cross-model validation。若最优 recipe 只在短训或单模型上成立，价值会打折；作者专门补了这部分，值得确认。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。若时间更少，优先看 Figure 1、scoring 方法、主表格和 dense-to-dense 对比实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural deployment issue of MoE language models. MoEs are compute-efficient because only a few experts are active per token, but they are still memory-heavy at inference because all experts must remain resident. Prior compression work mostly turns a large MoE into a smaller MoE, which preserves the same memory limitation. The central question here is whether a trained MoE can be systematically converted into a standard dense model while retaining as much capability as possible, and whether this route is better than starting from a dense teacher and doing dense-to-dense pruning/distillation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is in model-family construction and teacher choice rather than a new pretraining paradigm. Frontier labs increasingly train MoE flagships but still release smaller dense models for deployment. Those dense models are often trained separately or distilled from a large dense teacher, which is expensive and does not exploit the MoE teacher already available. This work presents a fairly complete MoE-to-dense pipeline and shows that, at matched student size, a dense student distilled from an MoE teacher can outperform a dense student obtained through dense-to-dense pruning. If that result holds broadly, it changes a practical design choice: a flagship MoE may be sufficient as the upstream source for both sparse and dense descendants.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages.

First is expert selection. For each layer, all E experts are scored and the top-K are retained. Here k is the original router top-k, while K is the number of experts selected for conversion. The paper evaluates seven scoring methods and finds that scoring dominates the final outcome. The main technical novelty is a diversity-aware criterion: instead of selecting experts only by frequency or activation strength, it jointly rewards importance and non-redundancy. Concretely, the authors build an importance-weighted Gram matrix and use a log-determinant objective, a D-optimal selection criterion, to favor experts that are both strong and diverse. Their best variant is called DO-ACP.

Second is grouping, merging, and densification. If K > k, the selected experts are assigned to k groups and merged within each group by score-weighted averaging; if K = k, they are copied directly without merging. The resulting k experts are then concatenated along the intermediate dimension to form a standard dense FFN. Because an MoE output is originally a router-weighted sum while a dense FFN uses a single down projection after concatenation, the paper also studies down-projection scaling to preserve output magnitude after conversion.

Third is knowledge distillation from the MoE teacher to recover quality lost in the structural conversion. A useful part of the experimental design is that the authors first search over recipes under a short distillation budget, then verify whether the best recipe remains best under longer distillation. That makes the conclusions more credible than a single hand-picked configuration.

Two takeaways stand out. First, expert selection matters much more than grouping, which means the upper bound is mostly determined by which experts are kept, not by how they are merged. Second, the best configuration is often pure pruning: select diverse experts and concatenate them directly, without averaging. That suggests many experts are specialized rather than trivially mergeable; averaging can erase useful specialization if selection is already good.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental study is broad. The main sweep is on Qwen3-30B-A3B, covering 7 expert-scoring methods, 5 grouping strategies, 2 down-projection scaling choices, and multiple K values, for a total of 350 configurations. The best findings are then validated on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and GPT-OSS-20B.

Four results matter most.

First, scoring is the dominant factor. The gap between the best and worst scoring methods is 5.7 percentage points in average downstream accuracy, while grouping contributes only about 1 point. That is a strong signal that selection quality is the real bottleneck.

Second, the best recipe is diversity-aware scoring plus pure pruning. In other words, DO-ACP selects a diverse set of experts and direct concatenation works better than weight averaging. Frequency-based scoring tends to pick redundant experts, so it benefits more from merging. This is an informative result: merging is not inherently helpful; it mainly compensates for poor selection.

Third, MoE-to-dense beats dense-to-dense pruning in a controlled comparison. With roughly matched teacher size (~30B) and student size (~3B), the best MoE-to-dense configuration outperforms dense-to-dense pruning by +6.3 points after about 4B distillation tokens, while being 1.6x faster in wall-clock training time. This is one of the strongest claims in the paper because it argues not just that conversion is possible, but that the MoE teacher is a better starting point.

Fourth, the recipe selected under a short distillation budget (~0.3B tokens) remains strong under extended distillation, and the trend transfers across three model families. The provided excerpt does not include every benchmark name and score, but the evaluation is clearly broader than a single perplexity comparison.

A boundary to keep in mind: the paper compares compression pipelines, not the absolute best dense student obtainable from scratch, and it does not fully explain why MoE teachers are better distillation sources at the representation level. The evidence is strong for engineering choice, less complete for mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim should be conclusion-driven.

Start with the overview figure and the conversion pipeline in the method section. Make sure the distinction between K and k is clear, and understand why the active parameter budget of an MoE maps naturally to the intermediate width of a dense FFN. Without that mapping, the rest can look like a collection of heuristics.

Then focus on expert scoring. The diversity-aware Gram log-det objective is the most novel part of the paper. Pay attention to why it captures both importance and diversity, and how it differs from simpler signals such as routing frequency, router probability, or weight magnitude.

Next, read the main comparison sections: the 350-configuration sweep, the relative impact of scoring versus grouping, and the controlled MoE-to-dense versus dense-to-dense experiment. Those sections determine whether the paper is merely another compression recipe or a stronger statement about teacher choice.

Finally, check the extended-distillation and cross-model validation results. If the best recipe only worked under short training or on one architecture, the practical value would be much weaker.

A useful skim takes 25–35 minutes. If time is limited, prioritize the overview figure, the scoring section, the main result tables, and the dense-to-dense comparison.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法，但如果你在想 MoE 是否真学到不可压缩的专家分工，只看打分消融和 matched-budget 对比就够，能直接指导内部 MoE→dense 备份线。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care whether MoE specialization is truly irreducible, read the scoring ablations and matched-budget comparisons; they directly inform any internal MoE-to-dense fallback path.

paper.title: Extracting Small Translation Specialists from LLMs by Aggressively Pruning Experts
paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art machine translation performance, but they do so as broad generalists largely trained for many tasks and capabilities unrelated to translation. Thus, they are heavily overparameterized for this task, resulting in excessive memory and compute requirements. In this paper, we present a method for aggressively pruning experts from modern mixture-of-experts LLMs while incurring negligible degradation in translation quality. Our approach expl

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE LLM 在机器翻译场景中过度参数化的问题。通用 MoE 模型具备大量与翻译无关的能力，部署翻译服务时仍要携带完整专家集合，导致显存和计算成本过高。论文目标是在不重新训练或只做少量恢复训练的情况下，从通用 MoE LLM 中抽取小型翻译专用子网。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在 MoE 专家专门化和能力可分解性。它说明某些语言能力可以通过专家路由统计定位，并以模块化方式裁剪。这对预训练阶段的 MoE 设计有反馈意义：如果能力在专家空间中可分离，训练时的路由正则、专家容量、语言/任务混合比例可能影响后续模型切片、专用化部署和持续训练成本。论文不是通用压缩方法的完整答案，因为实验聚焦翻译，但它给出了一个清晰的诊断工具：看任务在 MoE 专家上的 routing mass 分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接：用翻译校准集运行预训练 MoE 模型，记录每层每个专家的 router 权重，并按 token 求平均得到 routing mass，作为专家对翻译任务的重要性估计。论文也比较了 REAP 这类结合专家输出 L2 norm 与路由权重的更复杂指标。随后按层分配保留专家数，删除低重要性专家。由于 MoE 的 FFN 专家是模块化组件，删除专家不需要修改注意力层，也不需要从头训练。一个关键经验是中间层可以更激进地裁剪，而对首尾层更保守，这符合语言建模中早期表征和后期生成控制更敏感的常见观察。论文还区分多语言通用裁剪和特定语言方向裁剪：前者保留更宽的翻译能力，后者压缩更强但泛化风险更高。
summary.experiments: 实验主要使用 GPT-OSS-20B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B。GPT-OSS-20B 每个 MoE 层有 32 个专家、每个 token 激活 4 个；Qwen3-30B-A3B 每层 128 个专家、激活 8 个。目标语言包括德语、日语、孟加拉语和埃及阿拉伯语，并在俄语、西班牙语、中文上测试未参与裁剪语言的泛化。校准集来自 FLoRes，评测使用 FLoRes devtest、WMT-24++ 以及若干领域数据集；主指标为 xCOMET-XL，并单独统计过度裁剪导致的生成或格式退化。结果显示，无需重训练即可裁剪约一半专家，翻译质量几乎不下降；在短时 supervised fine-tuning 恢复训练后，约 75% 压缩率下也能恢复到接近原模型的翻译水平。论文还发现简单 routing mass 已经很有效，说明 router 本身携带了较强的任务相关性信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。优先看实验设置中模型规格、语言选择和评测指标，再看 pruning methodology 中 routing mass 的定义、校准数据构造和 layer-wise allocation。实验表格里重点看三个问题：无训练裁剪到 50% 时质量下降多少；75% 压缩后恢复训练能补回多少；语言方向专用裁剪和多语言裁剪在未见语言上的差异。若关心 MoE 预训练，可以重点看专家使用分布和中间层更可裁剪这一现象，它比具体翻译分数更有迁移价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses over-parameterization of MoE LLMs for machine translation. General-purpose MoE models carry many capabilities that are not needed for translation, yet deployment still requires storing and serving the full expert set. The goal is to extract compact translation specialists from pretrained MoE LLMs with no retraining, or with only a short recovery fine-tuning stage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for foundation-model research is its evidence on expert specialization and capability separability in MoE models. Translation ability appears to occupy a subset of experts that can be identified from routing statistics. This has implications for MoE pretraining: router behavior, expert capacity, task mixture, and language mixture may determine how easily capabilities can later be sliced, specialized, or continually trained. The result is task-specific, but the diagnostic idea is broadly useful: routing mass can expose which parts of an MoE model a capability relies on.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method runs a pretrained MoE model on translation calibration data and records router weights for every expert at every layer. These weights are averaged over tokens to produce routing mass, an importance score for each expert. The paper also compares a more complex alternative, REAP, which combines router weights with the L2 norm of expert outputs. Low-importance experts are then pruned, with a layer-wise allocation strategy for how many experts to keep. Because MoE FFN experts are modular, pruning can be done without changing attention blocks or retraining the whole model. A notable design choice is to prune middle layers more aggressively while keeping early and late layers more intact. The paper studies both multilingual pruning and language-direction-specific pruning, trading generality for compression.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use GPT-OSS-20B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. GPT-OSS-20B has 32 experts per MoE layer and activates 4 per token; Qwen3-30B-A3B has 128 experts per layer and activates 8. Target languages include German, Japanese, Bengali, and Egyptian Arabic, with Russian, Spanish, and Mandarin used as unseen languages for generalization checks. Calibration uses FLoRes, while evaluation covers FLoRes devtest, WMT-24++, and several domain-specific translation datasets. The main metric is xCOMET-XL, with degenerate generation or formatting failures counted separately. The key result is that around half of the experts can be removed with negligible translation degradation and no retraining. With short supervised recovery tuning, about 75% compression can be reached while recovering translation quality close to the original model. Simple routing mass is already competitive, suggesting that the router provides a strong task-relevance signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the experimental setup to understand the model sizes, expert configurations, languages, and metrics. Then read the pruning methodology for routing mass, calibration construction, and layer-wise expert allocation. In the results, focus on three comparisons: quality loss at 50% pruning without training, recovery after 75% compression, and multilingual versus language-direction-specific pruning on unseen languages. For MoE pretraining research, the most useful material is the expert-usage analysis and the observation that middle layers are more aggressively prunable than boundary layers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它直接碰 MoE 的一个硬问题：专家到底有多可分离；先看 pruning 准则和无重训结果，若 setup 干净，内部应复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it probes a hard MoE question—how separable experts really are; start with the pruning criterion and no-retraining results, and replicate internally if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation via Teacher-Informed Mixture Priors
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation is a powerful method for model compression, enabling the efficient deployment of complex deep learning models (teachers), including large language models. However, its underlying statistical mechanisms remain unclear, and uncertainty evaluation is often overlooked, especially in real-world scenarios requiring diverse teacher expertise. To address these challenges, we introduce \textit{Multi-Teacher Bayesian Knowledge Distillation} (MT-BKD), where a distilled student model

summary.core_problem: 多教师知识蒸馏中不确定性评估缺失，且蒸馏过程的统计机制不清晰，尤其是在需要多样化教师专业知识的真实场景中。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将贝叶斯框架引入多教师知识蒸馏，通过教师信息先验和熵加权机制融合多源知识，提升泛化性与鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出多教师贝叶斯知识蒸馏（MT-BKD），在贝叶斯推理框架内让学生模型从多个教师学习；引入教师信息先验整合外部知识，并使用基于熵的加权机制自适应调整每个教师的影响。
summary.experiments: 论文未提供具体模型规模和数据集细节，主要为方法框架性阐述。
summary.authors_note: Luyang Fang 等；机构信息未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: Uncertainty evaluation is missing in multi-teacher knowledge distillation, and the statistical mechanism of the distillation process remains unclear, especially in real-world scenarios requiring diverse teacher expertise.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces Bayesian framework into multi-teacher knowledge distillation, integrating multi-source knowledge through teacher-informed priors and entropy-based weighting to improve generalization and robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Multi-Teacher Bayesian Knowledge Distillation (MT-BKD), where a student model learns from multiple teachers within a Bayesian inference framework; introduces a teacher-informed prior to integrate external knowledge, and uses an entropy-based weighting mechanism to adaptively adjust each teacher's influence.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale or dataset details provided; the paper is primarily a methodological framework presentation.
summary_en.authors_note: Luyang Fang et al.; institutional affiliation not specified.

recommendation.zh: 贝叶斯+多教师蒸馏的理论框架，缺乏大规模 LLM 实验验证，对预训练研究员价值有限，作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: A theoretical framework of Bayesian multi-teacher distillation without large-scale LLM experimental validation; limited value for pretraining researchers. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level teacher supervision. Recent selective OPD methods exploit the non-uniformity of OPD signals by prioritizing high-entropy or high-disagreement tokens. We revisit this principle and ask: which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable? Using a fixed-context diagnostic that measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, we show that raw KL disagreement is a coarse proxy for learning value. It conflates

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 on-policy distillation 里的一个细粒度问题：学生模型在自己生成的前缀上接受教师 token 分布监督，但高 teacher-student KL 并不一定意味着这个 token 位置真的能学到东西。作者要区分两类分歧：一种是教师把概率质量重新分配到学生已经认为可能的候选 token 上，更新容易被学生吸收；另一种是教师主要支持学生当前预测支撑集之外的 token，KL 很大，但局部更新效果弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响在于训练信号质量分析，尤其是蒸馏、SFT 数据选择和 RL 前后的 policy improvement。它提醒一个常见误区：token 级别的 loss 或 KL 大，不等于学习价值高。对小模型蒸馏大模型时，瓶颈不只是 token 数量，而是教师信号是否落在学生当前可表示、可调整的局部区域内。这对高效蒸馏、token budget 分配、以及训练动态诊断都有参考价值，但贡献主要在 post-train/distillation 的信号选择层面，不是新的基座预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法有两步。第一步是 fixed-context diagnostic。作者收集学生 on-policy rollout 产生的前缀，把这些前缀固定成 context bank，然后用训练前后的学生模型在同一批上下文上重新打分，计算同一上下文下 teacher-student KL 的下降量。这样可以把 token 位置自身的可学习性从 rollout 噪声、后续上下文漂移和答案级评价中分离出来。第二步是定义 token teachability。作者用学生 top-K token 集合作为局部支撑集，考察教师概率质量是否主要落在这个支撑集或其附近。如果教师纠正信号与学生当前支撑集对齐，那么高 KL 更可能转化为 KL reduction；如果教师质量主要在学生支撑集之外，高 KL 往往只是不可兼容分歧。基于这个诊断，TA-OPD 用 support-aligned teacher-student disagreement 给 token 位置打分，只在高 teachability 的位置施加 OPD loss。它和高熵选择、原始 KL 选择的区别在于：不是选“不确定”或“分歧大”的 token，而是选学生当前状态下更可能被更新吸收的 token。实现上主要依赖 OPD 中已有的教师和学生 token 概率，可以用轻量 top-K 近似，不需要 reward model 或 verifier。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3 和 Qwen2.5 系列的 teacher-student 配置，包含不同规模、推理能力和 backbone 的组合。诊断实验显示，低熵高 KL 区域并不均质；同样是 confident disagreement，support-aligned 的 token 更能预测固定上下文下的 KL 下降，而 off-support mismatch 的 token 学习收益弱。方法实验中，TA-OPD 在只保留 5% token 的设置下，经常可以匹配或超过 full-token OPD，并优于同 token budget 下的 entropy-based 和 divergence-based 选择方法。这个结果的重点不是单个 benchmark 的提升，而是说明 OPD 的有效性受 token teachability 约束，密集监督并不总是更好。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 1，对 learnable disagreement 和 incompatible disagreement 的例子建立直觉。然后看 Diagnosing Token Teachability，重点是 fixed-context token gain 的定义、为什么要固定上下文、以及 entropy-KL 平面里 Q3 区域被进一步拆开的分析。TA-OPD 的算法部分可以快速看公式和伪代码，关注 teachability score 如何用 top-K 支撑集近似。实验部分优先看 token retention ratio 的消融、和 entropy/KL selector 的对比、不同 K 值的敏感性。附录 C 和 I 如果有时间值得看，分别对应诊断协议和固定上下文收益的理论说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which token-level teacher signals are actually learnable in on-policy distillation. In OPD, the student is supervised on its own rollouts, but a large teacher-student KL at a token does not necessarily imply a useful update. The key distinction is between support-aligned disagreement, where the teacher reallocates probability mass among tokens the student already considers plausible, and off-support disagreement, where the teacher mostly prefers tokens outside the student’s current predictive support.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a sharper view of training-signal quality in distillation. It is relevant to LLM post-training, small-model distillation, and the pretrain-posttrain interface because it shows that token loss magnitude is a weak proxy for improvement. The result suggests that token budget should be spent on locally compatible supervision rather than simply dense supervision or high-KL positions. The contribution is methodological and diagnostic rather than a new foundation-model pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first introduces a fixed-context diagnostic. Student-generated on-policy prefixes are stored as a context bank. The initial and trained student are then rescored on exactly the same contexts against the same teacher distribution. For each token position, the diagnostic measures same-context teacher-student KL reduction, isolating local learnability from rollout variance and answer-level effects. The paper then formalizes token teachability using local support. The student’s top-K predictions define the tokens it currently treats as plausible. A teacher correction is more teachable when its probability mass is aligned with this support. Based on this idea, Teachability-Aware OPD scores response positions by support-aligned disagreement and applies the OPD loss only to high-teachability tokens. Unlike entropy-based or raw-KL selection, the criterion asks whether the teacher signal can be absorbed by the current student state. The method uses probabilities already available during OPD and can be approximated with top-K supports, without a reward model or verifier.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3 and Qwen2.5 teacher-student settings with variation in scale, reasoning strength, and model backbone. The diagnostic shows that the low-entropy, high-KL region is heterogeneous: support-aligned disagreements predict same-context KL reduction, while incompatible disagreements often remain hard to learn despite large KL. In training experiments, TA-OPD with only 5% retained tokens often matches or surpasses full-token OPD, and improves over entropy-based and divergence-based selectors under the same token budget. The important empirical message is that token quality can dominate token count in OPD.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with Fig. 1 and the diagnostic setup, since they contain the central idea. Then read the section defining fixed-context token gain and local support; this is where the paper separates salience from learnability. The TA-OPD algorithm can be read quickly, focusing on how the score is computed from top-K teacher and student probabilities. In the experiments, prioritize the retention-ratio ablations, comparisons with entropy and KL selectors, and sensitivity to K. The appendices on the diagnostic protocol and the smoothness/gradient-alignment argument are useful if the method is being considered for implementation.

recommendation.zh: 修正了蒸馏中“高分歧token优先训练”的常见误区，可教性指标设计精巧，做蒸馏或模型压缩的可直接复用其固定上下文诊断方法。
recommendation.en: Corrects the common misconception of prioritizing high-disagreement tokens in distillation; the teachability metric is well-designed, and its fixed-context diagnostic can be directly reused by distillation and model compression researchers.

paper.title: The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解释并改进 LLM 蒸馏中的一个现象：软标签包含完整 teacher 分布，按直觉应优于硬标签，但实验上硬标签和软标签混合训练常常更好。
summary.importance: 它对 post-train 和小模型压缩更直接，对预训练也有启发。关键点不是“更多分布信息一定更好”，而是训练目标要考虑自回归生成时的分布偏移。纯 soft KD 在 teacher prefix 上拟合得更好，但并不保证 student 在自己生成的 prefix 上稳定。这个观察也适用于预训练数据合成、teacher-generated corpus、SFT 数据蒸馏和小模型 continued pretrain：局部 next-token 拟合与序列级行为之间存在缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Bridge–Garden Decomposition，用局部风险敏感性把生成位置分成两类。Bridge 是高风险位置，下一个 token 需要比较精确；一旦选错，后续轨迹容易偏离。Garden 是低风险位置，多个候选 token 都能保持语义和连贯性。基于这个划分，作者给出 exposure bias 的上界分解，解释 hard 和 soft 的互补性：hard label 会把概率集中到 teacher 实际选择的 token，更适合 Bridge，能减少早期错误引起的级联偏移；soft label 保留 teacher 对多个合理 token 的分布，更适合 Garden，能保持多样性和分布形状。方法上，论文不只用固定比例混合，而提出一组自适应混合策略，包括 confidence-guided、entropy-guided、curriculum-guided 和 risk-guided，把不同 prefix 位置分配给不同程度的 hard/soft 监督。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 teacher–student 组合：Qwen 7B→3B、Llama 8B→1B、Gemma 4B→1B、DeepSeek-Coder 6.7B→1.3B，并扩展到更大 Qwen2.5 容量差距、Qwen2.5-Coder 和开放式生成。任务包括 commonsense、math 和 coding。核心实验证据有三点：第一，hard+soft 混合稳定优于纯 soft KD；第二，这种提升不是来自更好的 teacher matching，加入 hard 后训练拟合指标反而变差；第三，混合目标降低了 exposure bias，因此序列级生成表现更好。论文还报告其方法优于 divergence-based 和 on-policy baselines，并将训练成本降低 9.7×。这个 9.7× 主要来自避免更昂贵的 on-policy 或复杂分布匹配流程，而不是单步 loss 计算本身的微小优化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到精读之间，预计 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 2 对三件事的拆分：性能提升、训练拟合变差、exposure bias 下降。这是理解全文的入口。然后看 Bridge–Garden 理论部分，重点关注局部风险敏感性的定义、exposure bias 上界如何分解，以及 hard/soft 分别在哪类区域占优。方法部分可重点看自适应 mixing rule，而不是固定线性混合。实验部分建议看跨模型族结果、容量差距扩展实验，以及与 on-policy KD 的成本对比。若时间有限，理论直觉和 Fig. 2 比具体 benchmark 排名更有价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a puzzling behavior in LLM distillation: soft labels expose the full teacher distribution and should be more informative, yet mixing soft labels with sampled hard labels often produces better students.
summary_en.importance: The immediate relevance is model compression and post-training, but the lesson also matters for pretraining-adjacent workflows. The main point is that better next-token matching under teacher prefixes does not necessarily imply better autoregressive behavior under student-generated prefixes. This distinction applies to teacher-generated corpora, synthetic SFT data, continued pretraining with distilled data, and small-model training recipes that rely on large-model supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a Bridge–Garden Decomposition based on local risk sensitivity. Bridge positions are high-risk: the next token has to be close to exact, because a wrong choice can push the future trajectory into a bad region. Garden positions are low-risk: several alternatives can preserve meaning and coherence. This decomposition yields an exposure-bias bound with separate contributions from these regions. The explanation is then straightforward: hard-label training concentrates probability on the teacher’s sampled action and is useful in Bridges, while soft-label training preserves the teacher’s distribution over alternatives and is useful in Gardens. The proposed methods therefore adapt the hard/soft mixture by prefix context, using confidence-, entropy-, curriculum-, and risk-guided strategies rather than a single global mixing weight.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover several teacher–student pairs and model families, including Qwen 7B to 3B, Llama 8B to 1B, Gemma 4B to 1B, and DeepSeek-Coder 6.7B to 1.3B, with additional tests on larger Qwen2.5 capacity gaps, Qwen2.5-Coder, and open-ended generation. Evaluation spans commonsense reasoning, math, and coding. The key empirical findings are: mixed hard/soft supervision consistently outperforms pure soft KD; the gain is not explained by closer teacher matching, since adding hard labels can worsen the training-fit metric; and the mixed objective reduces exposure bias, which improves sequence-level behavior. The paper also reports better results than divergence-based and on-policy baselines, with a 9.7× reduction in training cost, mainly by avoiding more expensive on-policy or heavy distribution-matching procedures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-to-careful reading is recommended, roughly 30–45 minutes. Start with the introduction and Fig. 2, which separate final performance, teacher matching during training, and exposure bias. Then read the Bridge–Garden theory section, especially the definition of local risk sensitivity and the exposure-bias decomposition. In the method section, focus on the adaptive mixing rules rather than the fixed linear combination. In the experiments, prioritize cross-family teacher–student results, capacity-gap extensions, and the cost comparison against on-policy KD. If time is limited, the theoretical intuition and Fig. 2 are more informative than individual benchmark numbers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制实验；若 exposure bias 证据干净，应把 hard/soft 混合纳入内部蒸馏消融。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism experiments; if the exposure-bias evidence is clean, hard/soft mixing deserves an internal distillation ablation.

paper.title: MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex multimodal tasks, but their large parameter sizes make deployment expensive. Structured pruning offers a natural solution; however, existing methods fail to preserve CoT reasoning accuracy in VLMs. We identify two key reasons: (1) CoT consistency depends on sparse transition points (pivot tokens) in the generation trajectory, while existing pruning methods are CoT-agnostic; and (2) pruning method

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 结构化剪枝后多模态 CoT 推理能力下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态模型压缩方法。它关注推理部署成本，并把 CoT 轨迹中的关键 token 与跨模态激活差异纳入剪枝准则；对基座预训练启发有限，但对评估压缩是否破坏 reasoning path 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MuCRASP，Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning。方法识别生成轨迹中的 sparse transition points，即 pivot tokens，认为这些位置对 CoT 一致性重要；同时建模视觉和文本模态的 activation distribution 差异，在全局参数预算下结合跨模态对齐与层敏感性来决定剪枝结构。
summary.experiments: 在四个 VLM 和三个 reasoning benchmarks 上评估。摘要称 MuCRASP 在不同剪枝强度下更好保留推理质量，但未给出具体模型名称、参数规模、剪枝比例和数值提升。
