summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses degradation of multimodal CoT reasoning after structured pruning of VLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal model-compression contribution. It focuses on deployment cost and asks whether pruning preserves reasoning trajectories and cross-modal alignment; its value for base pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuCRASP identifies sparse transition points, or pivot tokens, in the generation trajectory that are important for CoT consistency. It also accounts for different activation distributions across visual and textual modalities, combining cross-modal alignment and layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four VLMs across three reasoning benchmarks. The abstract claims better preservation of reasoning quality under increasing compression, but does not provide model names, parameter sizes, pruning ratios, or numerical margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur.

recommendation.zh: 压缩论文里较少显式看 CoT 断点；可记住 pivot-token 诊断，不必细读剪枝算法。
recommendation.en: Compression papers rarely inspect CoT breakpoints explicitly; keep the pivot-token diagnostic, but the pruning algorithm can be skimmed.

paper.title: X-Token: Projection-Guided Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation allows a student model to learn from teachers with incompatible vocabularies. Prior work operates on hidden states or logits; the latter is preferred as a drop-in replacement requiring no auxiliary components. Logit-based methods either use only the correct-token probability, missing the full 'dark knowledge' in the teacher's distribution, or operate on the full output distribution, relying on strict token partitioning and/or unprincipled heuristic ranking.

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是跨 tokenizer 知识蒸馏中的“词表不兼容”问题。标准 KD 在每个位置对 teacher 与 student 的 next-token 分布做 KL，需要共享 tokenizer；这会把 student 绑定到同一 tokenizer 家族，限制了使用 Qwen、Phi、Llama 等异构 teacher 的能力。已有 logit-based 方法虽然部署成本低，但要么只用正确 token 概率，丢掉 teacher 分布里的暗知识；要么把词表切成 common/uncommon 两部分，依赖严格字符串匹配和 rank-based 对齐，导致两类问题：关键 token 落入 unmatched subset 后被错误压低，例如多位数字；以及等价 token 或 teacher 多 token 分解无法被利用，例如 student 的一个词对应 teacher 的多个子词。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把跨 tokenizer KD 从启发式 rank matching 推向了可审计、可扩展的词表投影。对基座预训练和持续预训练有直接意义：第一，student 可以保持自己的 tokenizer，不必为了吃到更强 teacher 的信号而换词表；第二，可以做跨家族 multi-teacher KD，把不同 teacher 的推理、代码、多语能力合成到同一个训练信号里；第三，方法仍然是 logit-level loss，避免 representation alignment 那类额外模块和额外 forward 的成本，更接近大规模 continual pretraining 可用的形态。贡献量级主要体现在失败模式修复，而不是单纯小幅调参：在 Qwen3-4B teacher 场景，P-KL 对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82，GSM8K 从 2.56 提到 15.54，说明 numerals 这类 critical token 的处理不是边角问题。
summary.technical_approach: X-Token 有三步。第一步是 span alignment。不同 tokenizer 会把同一段文本切成不同长度的 token 序列，因此不能直接逐位置做 KD。论文用确定性的动态规划对齐，把 student token span 与 teacher token span 分组成解码后文本一致的 chunk。随后用 chain-rule merge，把一个 chunk 内的自回归 token 概率相乘，得到 chunk-level distribution。这样 KD 的单位从单 token 位置变成文本一致的 span。第二步是构造稀疏 projection matrix W，尺寸为 |V_S| × |V_T|，把 student 词表上的概率映射到 teacher 词表空间。W 不是简单 string equality，而是使用 canonicalized string matching 和 multi-token decoding rules，把大小写、空格、规范化形式以及 teacher 多 token 分解带来的等价关系纳入匹配。这个矩阵可以固定，也可以在 KD 中进一步 refine。第三步是两个互补 loss。P-KL 去掉 common/uncommon partition，在投影后的完整分布上做 KL，适合关键 token 大量落在严格 common set 之外的情形，例如跨 tokenizer 数字切分差异。H-KL 则保留一种更保守的高置信映射，用 W 下的 top-ranked mapping 放宽匹配，适合覆盖率已经较好、但严格字符串匹配仍漏掉等价项的情形。论文给出一个实用的 coverage audit：先检查 numerals 等任务关键 token 在 common set 与 projection 下的覆盖情况，再决定用 P-KL 还是 H-KL。multi-teacher 扩展把多个异构 teacher 的 projected loss 加权合并；实验中简单静态权重优于自适应权重，提示 teacher 互补性和稳定权重比复杂调度更重要。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 Llama-3.2-1B 这类固定 tokenizer 的 student，蒸馏来自 Phi-4-mini、Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 等 teacher 的信号。核心结果有三组。第一，Qwen3-4B teacher 下，P-KL 相对 GOLD 平均提升 +3.82；GSM8K 从 2.56 提升到 15.54，接近 6 倍。这与论文诊断一致：Qwen 对多位数字的切分和 Llama 的 packed numeral 不一致，GOLD 的 common/uncommon 切分会把关键数字 token 放到弱监督甚至错误监督区域。第二，Phi-4-mini teacher 下，H-KL 带来稳定的约 +0.5 平均提升，说明当 critical token 覆盖没有严重破损时，更保守的高质量映射比 full-distribution 投影更稳。第三，multi-teacher KD 中，Phi-4-mini + Llama-3.2-3B 比单 teacher KD 高 +1.3；teacher 组合是否互补比 teacher 数量更重要。消融层面，值得关注的是 projection 覆盖率、W 是否 refine、P-KL 与 H-KL 的选择，以及 static weighting 与 adaptive weighting 的比较。论文的数字还显示，跨 tokenizer KD 的主要风险不是 KL 形式本身，而是错误匹配产生的系统性梯度偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 GOLD/ULD 失败模式的拆解，尤其是 uncommon-token failure 和 over-conservative matching。这两点直接决定方法设计。Method 部分重点看 span alignment、chain-rule merge、projection matrix W 的构造规则，以及 P-KL/H-KL 的公式。这里要关注一个细节：它不是把 token 对齐问题简化成字符串相等，而是先把文本 span 对齐，再把词表概率投影到同一空间。实验部分建议优先看三类表和图：不同 teacher 下 P-KL/H-KL/GOLD 的对比；numeral 或其他 critical token 的 coverage audit；multi-teacher 权重策略的消融。深挖点包括：W refine 是否会引入不稳定或过拟合；P-KL 在大词表 teacher 上的计算成本；coverage audit 能否扩展到代码 token、Unicode、多语形态变化；chunk-level distribution 的 chain-rule merge 在长 span 上是否会出现数值和校准问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation when teacher and student models use incompatible vocabularies. Standard logit KD assumes a shared next-token support, which effectively locks a student into teachers from the same tokenizer family. Existing logit-based cross-tokenizer methods either retain only the probability of the gold token or split the vocabulary into string-matched common tokens and an unmatched remainder. This creates two concrete failure modes: important tokens can fall into the unmatched set and receive noisy or suppressive gradients, as in multi-digit numerals under Qwen-to-Llama distillation; and useful equivalences are missed when one tokenizer represents a string as one token while another represents it as multiple tokens.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to continual pretraining and model upgrading. It lets a fixed-tokenizer student consume distributional supervision from stronger or specialized teachers without changing the student tokenizer or adding representation-alignment modules. This matters for multi-teacher distillation across model families, where teachers may differ in reasoning, code, and multilingual strengths. The main contribution is not a small loss tweak, but a more principled interface between mismatched vocabularies. The reported gains are also tied to a real pretraining concern: tokenization artifacts can create systematic training bias. With Qwen3-4B as teacher, P-KL improves over GOLD by +3.82 on average, including GSM8K moving from 2.56 to 15.54.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Token has three components. First, it aligns student and teacher token sequences into text-consistent spans. Because different tokenizers produce different sequence lengths, per-position KD is ill-defined. The method uses deterministic dynamic-programming alignment to form paired chunks that decode to the same underlying text. Within each chunk, token probabilities are merged using the autoregressive chain rule to obtain chunk-level distributions. Second, it builds a sparse projection matrix W of shape |V_S| by |V_T|, mapping student-vocabulary probabilities into the teacher vocabulary space. The projection is constructed with canonicalized string matching and multi-token decoding rules, rather than exact string equality alone, and it can optionally be refined during KD. Third, it introduces two loss variants. P-KL removes the common/uncommon partition and aligns full projected distributions, which is useful when critical tokens are poorly covered by strict common-token matching. H-KL uses top-ranked mappings under W and is better suited to cases where the common coverage is already reasonably good but exact matching is too conservative. A coverage audit over categories such as numerals guides the choice between P-KL and H-KL. The multi-teacher extension combines projected KD losses from heterogeneous teachers, with static weighting reported to be more reliable than adaptive weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments study fixed-tokenizer students such as Llama-3.2-1B distilled from teachers including Phi-4-mini, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B. Three results are central. Under Qwen3-4B supervision, P-KL outperforms GOLD by +3.82 on average, and GSM8K rises from 2.56 to 15.54. This matches the diagnosed numeral-tokenization failure: Qwen and Llama segment multi-digit numbers differently, and partition-based KD gives poor gradients to the tokens that determine math accuracy. Under Phi-4-mini supervision, H-KL gives a consistent gain of about +0.5, suggesting that a more conservative high-quality mapping is preferable when critical-token coverage is not badly broken. In multi-teacher KD, Phi-4-mini plus Llama-3.2-3B improves by +1.3 over single-teacher KD. The ablations to inspect are projection coverage, fixed versus refined W, P-KL versus H-KL selection, and static versus adaptive teacher weighting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the failure analysis in the introduction carefully. The two useful concepts are uncommon-token failure and over-conservative matching; they explain why previous full-distribution logit KD can harm exactly the tokens that matter for downstream accuracy. In the method, focus on span alignment, chain-rule merging, construction of the projection matrix W, and the definitions of P-KL and H-KL. The key design choice is that X-Token aligns text spans first and then projects distributions, instead of relying on exact token-string equality. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing GOLD, P-KL, and H-KL across teachers; the coverage audit for numerals or other critical categories; and the multi-teacher weighting ablation. Open questions worth checking are the compute cost of full projected distributions, numerical stability for long chunks, whether W refinement can drift, and how the same audit would behave for code tokens, Unicode-heavy text, and multilingual morphology.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA团队提出的跨tokenizer蒸馏方法，指出了Llama→Qwen蒸馏中数字token被压制的具体问题，对模型迁移和tokenizer兼容性研究有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA team's cross-tokenizer distillation method identifies concrete issues with numeric token suppression in Llama→Qwen distillation, directly relevant for model transfer and tokenizer compatibility research.

paper.title: Consistently Informative Soft-Label Temperature for Knowledge Distillation
paper.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a high-capacity teacher to a compact student by matching their predictive distributions, with temperature scaling serving as a central mechanism for smoothing teacher predictions and exposing informative "dark knowledge" beyond the hard label. However, the standard fixed-temperature design is inherently sample-agnostic. Since samples differ in logit scale and learning difficulty, a single global temperature produces teacher soft labels with hi

summary.core_problem: 解决知识蒸馏中固定全局 temperature 对所有样本一视同仁，导致教师软标签信息量不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 这是模型压缩中的方法改进。它指出固定 temperature 会让部分样本过尖锐、部分样本过平滑，并进一步质疑教师和学生共享同一 temperature 的默认设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CIST，为教师和学生分别分配 sample-wise adaptive temperature。教师侧目标是让软标签保持一致的信息量，学生侧则避免强行对齐教师和学生的 logit scale，适应容量差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。可确认的是论文围绕 KD 预测分布和 temperature scaling 做实验验证，但是否覆盖 LLM 蒸馏无法从给定信息确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Rochester Institute of Technology 和 Oakland University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that a fixed global temperature in knowledge distillation produces inconsistently informative soft labels across samples.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but plausible model-compression contribution. It argues that fixed temperature can make some teacher distributions too sharp and others over-smoothed, and questions the default of sharing the same temperature between teacher and student.
summary_en.technical_approach: CIST assigns separate sample-wise adaptive temperatures to the teacher and the student. The teacher-side temperature aims to maintain consistent soft-label informativeness, while the student-side temperature avoids rigid logit-scale matching under capacity mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, or improvement numbers. It indicates empirical validation around KD distributions and temperature scaling, but LLM distillation coverage is not confirmed from the provided information.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Rochester Institute of Technology and Oakland University.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义即可；若没有 LLM 蒸馏实验，它更像分类 KD 的温度调参论文，迁移价值有限。
recommendation.en: Skim the method definition only; without LLM distillation experiments, this is mostly a classification-KD temperature paper with limited transfer.

paper.title: Block-Sphere Vector Quantization
paper.abstract: Vector quantization is a fundamental primitive for scalable machine learning systems, enabling memory-efficient storage, fast retrieval, and compressed inference. Recent rotation-based quantizers such as EDEN, RabitQ, and TurboQuant have introduced strong guarantees and empirical performance, but the surrounding comparisons have been difficult to interpret because they rely on different distortion criteria, probability regimes, and implementation assumptions. As our first contribution, we provid

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是旋转式向量量化里一个长期有些混乱的问题：EDEN、RabitQ、TurboQuant 这些方法都在讲“随机旋转后再量化”很有效，但它们优化的失真目标、理论保证形式、解码规则和实现假设并不一致，导致比较常常失真。作者先统一回答“这些方法到底谁在什么意义下更好”，再进一步提出一个新的 block-level 球面量化器 BlockQuant，试图在期望 MSE 和期望内积误差上同时优于现有旋转量化方法。对 LLM 相关场景，论文主要落点在 embedding 压缩和 KV-cache 量化，而不是训练本身。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，因为它不涉及训练目标、数据或模型架构。但它对长上下文推理和记忆带宽问题有现实意义，尤其是 KV-cache 压缩。更重要的是，这篇论文把“随机旋转后的向量近似服从球面对称分布”这一直觉做成了统一理论框架，并把 codebook 设计和 dequantization rule 的作用拆开分析。这个拆分很有价值：很多量化论文把两者混在一起比较，结论容易不稳。若后续有人做训练期隐藏状态分布整形、cache-aware pretraining 或 retrieval embedding 压缩，这里的分析框架可以直接借用。贡献量级上，属于理论梳理加一个结构清晰的新量化器。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分两部分。

第一部分是统一理论比较。作者把 EDEN、RabitQ、TurboQuant 放到同一个随机量化框架下，从三个标准比较：重建 MSE、期望内积失真、以及高概率 bit-complexity 保证。结论不是谁全面占优，而是各有偏向：EDEN 和 TurboQuant 在 MSE 上更强，EDEN 对期望内积误差也有优势，RabitQ 则在高概率控制上更好。这里一个关键观察是，很多差异并不只来自 codebook 本身，还来自解码器如何利用 side information 或归一化结构。论文把“量化码本”和“反量化规则”分开讨论，这一点比单纯报实验分数更有信息量。

第二部分是提出 Block-Sphere Quantization，也叫 BlockQuant。它延续 rotation-based quantization 的基本套路：先对高维向量做随机旋转，使其更接近各向同性；但不同于 EDEN/TurboQuant 只看单坐标边缘分布，BlockQuant 把坐标分成小 block，用随机旋转后单位球面诱导出的精确 block marginal distribution 来设计 centroid。可以把它理解为一种不依赖数据学习的、基于球面几何先验的 block quantizer。它和 product quantization 有相似之处，都是分块处理；但 PQ 通常从数据中学习码本，而 BlockQuant 的码本来自已知分布，因此理论上更容易分析，也不需要训练码本。

作者还给出 lower-bound 分析，修正了该问题设定下的 Shannon lower bound，并说明当 block size 增大时，BlockQuant 会逐渐逼近理想球面量化极限。这个结论很关键，因为它解释了为什么从 coordinate-wise 走向 small-block quantization 是合理方向：不是经验上更好，而是更接近目标分布的几何结构。

从实现角度看，BlockQuant 需要在每个小 block 上做近邻 centroid 搜索。论文声称可以通过高效近似最近中心搜索把运行时控制在与现有方法相近的水平，因此不是纯理论构造。
summary.experiments:
实验分为三层。

第一层是失真指标验证。作者在真实 embedding 数据上比较 BlockQuant、EDEN、RabitQ、TurboQuant 的 reconstruction error 和 inner-product distortion，结论是 BlockQuant 在这两个期望型指标上都更低。这和理论分析是一致的。

第二层是理论与经验的对照。论文应该展示不同 bit-width、不同 block size 下的误差变化，并验证 block size 增大时性能向理想球面量化下界靠近。这里值得特别看的是小 bit 宽下常数项是否真的改善，而不只是渐近阶更好。

第三层是 LLM 相关应用，主要是长上下文 KV-cache 量化。作者声称在保持相近运行时的前提下，BlockQuant 带来更低的 cache 量化误差，并转化为更好的实际推理质量。给出的全文片段没有具体数字，因此不能编造精确提升幅度；但阅读时应重点核对：使用的是哪类模型、cache 量化位宽是多少、对 perplexity 或长上下文任务分数的影响有多大，以及与现有 rotation-based cache quantizer 的差距是否稳定。

如果论文附带了 ablation，最值得看的通常是：block size p 的选择、近似最近中心搜索带来的精度-速度折中、随机旋转是否需要固定种子或多次采样、以及不同向量分布偏离球面对称假设时方法是否退化。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇论文的阅读顺序很重要。

先看统一理论比较那一部分，尤其是总表和定义。要先弄清楚作者比较的是哪三种标准：MSE、expected inner-product distortion、high-probability bit complexity。很多读者容易把这些保证混成一个“谁更好”的结论，但论文恰恰是在反对这种混读。

然后看 BlockQuant 的构造。重点不是公式细节，而是理解为什么随机旋转后，按 block 使用球面诱导边缘分布会比逐坐标量化更合理。这里如果能把它和 product quantization、lattice quantization、以及 TurboQuant 的 coordinate-wise 设计放在一起理解，收获会更大。

接着看 lower bound 和 block size 分析。这部分决定了方法是不是只有经验优势，还是确实更接近理论极限。

实验部分建议优先看 distortion 曲线和 KV-cache 应用表，而不是 embedding 任务的零散结果。因为对 LLM 研究员来说，真正相关的是 cache 压缩是否有稳定收益，以及这种收益是否值得额外近邻搜索开销。

泛读大约 30 分钟可以抓住主结论；若要真正吃透理论比较和下界推导，预计需要 1 到 1.5 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a persistent source of confusion in rotation-based vector quantization. Methods such as EDEN, RabitQ, and TurboQuant are often discussed together, but they optimize different distortion criteria, provide different types of guarantees, and rely on different decoding assumptions. As a result, comparisons are often not apples-to-apples. The paper first builds a unified theoretical comparison of these methods, then proposes a new quantizer, Block-Sphere Quantization (BlockQuant), aimed at improving expected MSE and expected inner-product distortion. For LLM-related use cases, the practical target is mainly embedding compression and KV-cache quantization rather than model training.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, since the work is not about objectives, data, scaling, or architecture. Its practical relevance is stronger on the inference side, especially for long-context KV-cache compression. The more durable contribution is conceptual: it separates the role of the codebook from the role of the dequantization rule, and it formalizes the intuition that a randomly rotated high-dimensional vector is well modeled by spherical structure. That framing is useful beyond this paper. It could inform future work on cache-aware model design, hidden-state shaping during training, or compression of retrieval embeddings. In scope, this is best viewed as a careful theory-plus-method paper rather than a major shift in foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main technical components.

The first is a unified theoretical comparison of EDEN, RabitQ, and TurboQuant. The authors place them in a common randomized quantization framework and compare them under three criteria: reconstruction MSE, expected inner-product distortion, and high-probability bit-complexity guarantees. The conclusion is deliberately nuanced: no method dominates across all criteria. EDEN and TurboQuant are favorable for MSE, EDEN is also strong for expected inner-product distortion, while RabitQ offers the strongest high-probability control. A particularly useful aspect of the analysis is that it disentangles the contribution of the codebook from that of the dequantization rule. Many empirical comparisons blur these two factors, which makes the conclusions hard to interpret.

The second component is Block-Sphere Quantization, or BlockQuant. Like prior rotation-based quantizers, it starts with a random rotation so that the vector becomes closer to isotropic. The key difference is that EDEN and TurboQuant quantize coordinate-wise using one-dimensional marginals, whereas BlockQuant groups coordinates into small blocks and uses the exact block marginal distribution induced by the unit sphere to define centroids. In spirit, this resembles product quantization because it works blockwise, but there is a crucial distinction: the codebook is not learned from data. Instead, it is derived analytically from the known spherical distribution after random rotation. That makes the method easier to analyze and removes the need for codebook training.

The paper also provides lower-bound analysis. It revisits the Shannon lower bound for this setting, corrects it for the problem at hand, and argues that as the block size increases, BlockQuant approaches the ideal spherical quantization limit. This is an important point: the move from coordinate-wise quantization to small-block quantization is not presented as a heuristic tweak, but as a geometrically principled step toward the right asymptotic object.

On the implementation side, BlockQuant requires nearest-centroid search within each block. The paper claims that efficient approximate search keeps runtime comparable to prior methods, so the proposal is intended to be practical rather than purely theoretical.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments appear to operate at three levels.

First, the paper evaluates distortion metrics directly. On real embedding datasets, BlockQuant is reported to achieve lower reconstruction error and lower inner-product distortion than EDEN, RabitQ, and TurboQuant. That matches the expectation-based theory.

Second, the paper likely studies how performance changes with bit-width and block size, and whether larger blocks move the method closer to the ideal spherical quantization bound. This part matters because it tests whether the gains are only asymptotic or already visible in the low-bit regime that matters in practice.

Third, the paper includes an LLM-facing application: KV-cache quantization for long-context inference. The claim is that BlockQuant improves cache quantization quality while keeping runtime in the same ballpark through approximate nearest-centroid search. The provided excerpt does not include exact numbers, so the right way to read the paper is to verify the concrete setup: which models are used, what cache bit-width is tested, how perplexity or long-context task quality changes, and whether the gains over prior rotation-based quantizers are stable.

If there are ablations, the most informative ones are likely block size selection, the accuracy-speed tradeoff from approximate search, sensitivity to the random rotation, and robustness when the vector distribution deviates from the spherical assumption.
summary_en.reading_guide:
The reading order matters here.

Start with the unified comparison section, especially the summary table and the formal definitions of the three criteria: MSE, expected inner-product distortion, and high-probability bit complexity. The paper is valuable precisely because it refuses to collapse these into a single notion of “better.”

Then read the BlockQuant construction. The main goal is not to memorize formulas, but to understand why blockwise spherical marginals are a better fit than coordinate-wise marginals after random rotation. It helps to compare this mentally with product quantization, lattice-style quantization, and TurboQuant’s coordinate-wise design.

Next, read the lower-bound section and the analysis of block size. That part tells you whether the method has a principled advantage or only an empirical one.

In the experiments, prioritize the distortion curves and the KV-cache application tables. For an LLM researcher, the key question is whether the cache-compression gains are stable enough to justify the extra nearest-centroid search.

A quick read takes around 30 minutes. A careful read of the theory and lower-bound arguments will likely take 1 to 1.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: 向量量化的理论与方法进展，只看§3的量化器统一对比框架即可，对低比特量化选型有参考价值
recommendation.en: Theoretical and methodological progress in vector quantization, only read §3's unified quantizer comparison framework, which has reference value for low-bit quantization selection

paper.title: A Geometric Analysis of Sign-Magnitude Asymmetry in a ReLU + RMSNorm Block under Ternary Quantization
paper.abstract: Pre-norm Transformers with RMSNorm tolerate ternary {-1,0,+1} weight quantization with surprisingly small loss (Ma et al., 2024). We give a geometric explanation via sign-magnitude decomposition of weight perturbations. In a two-layer ReLU + RMSNorm model with i.i.d. Gaussian weights, sign-flips produce $π/(π-2) \approx 2.75$ times more transverse output energy than sign-preserving magnitude perturbations of equal Frobenius norm, as the flip rate $p \to 0$ (Theorem 3). The mechanism: ReLU create

summary.core_problem: 现有工作发现带RMSNorm的Pre-norm Transformer可以在仅保留权重符号与稀疏性的三值量化下保持极小的性能损失，但缺少严谨的理论解释：为什么符号信息在该架构中比权值幅度承载了更多的功能信息。
summary.importance: 为低比特量化Transformer的鲁棒性提供了几何视角的理论基础，明确了ReLU与RMSNorm组合对符号/幅度扰动的不对称响应机制，为BitNet等超低比特预训练架构的设计与优化提供了可量化的理论指导。
summary.technical_approach: 将权重量化误差分解为符号翻转与幅度扰动两类，基于两层ReLU+RMSNorm的简化模型，通过Fréchet导数分析RMSNorm的横向投影特性，结合ReLU造成的隐藏空间方向不对称性，推导两类扰动对输出能量的影响差异；进一步引入离群特征的杠杆效应理论，修正简化假设与真实模型的差距；量化了三值量化误差的角对齐度与径向特性。
summary.experiments: 理论推导得到在独立同分布高斯权重假设下，符号翻转带来的横向输出能量是同等Frobenius范数的幅度扰动的π/(π-2)≈2.75倍；三值量化后的输出与原始输出的角对齐度cos²收敛到2/π≈0.637；真实LLM中离群特征的存在导致符号扰动的实际影响达到理论基线的约10倍，与n×经验α²均值的7-10倍范围一致；ReLU对三值误差的径向/横向分解近似透明，前后量化误差差异小于0.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第3-4章的不对称性定理推导与三值量化误差分析，附录E-F的离群特征杠杆效应验证是连接理论与真实模型的核心部分；无需深入所有证明细节，重点关注ReLU+RMSNorm的几何响应机制与2.75倍、10倍两个关键量化常数的适用条件；预计阅读时间45-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing work shows that pre-norm Transformers with RMSNorm suffer minimal performance degradation under ternary quantization that only preserves weight signs and sparsity, but lacks a rigorous theoretical explanation for why sign information carries more functional information than weight magnitude in this architecture.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a geometry-based theoretical foundation for the robustness of low-bit quantized Transformers, clarifies the asymmetric response mechanism of the ReLU + RMSNorm combination to sign and magnitude perturbations, and delivers quantifiable theoretical guidance for the design and optimization of ultra-low-bit pretraining architectures such as BitNet.
summary_en.technical_approach: Weight quantization error is decomposed into sign-flip and magnitude perturbation categories. Based on a simplified two-layer ReLU + RMSNorm model, the transverse projection property of RMSNorm is analyzed via Fréchet derivatives, combined with the hidden-space directional asymmetry introduced by ReLU to derive the difference in output energy impact between the two perturbation types. The leverage effect of outlier features is further introduced to bridge the gap between simplified assumptions and real models, and the angular alignment and radial properties of ternary quantization error are quantified.
summary_en.experiments: Theoretical derivation shows that under the i.i.d. Gaussian weight assumption, sign-flips produce π/(π-2)≈2.75 times more transverse output energy than magnitude perturbations of equal Frobenius norm; the angular alignment cos² between ternary-quantized output and original output converges to 2/π≈0.637; the actual impact of sign perturbations in real LLMs reaches ~10× the theoretical baseline due to outlier features, consistent with the 7–10× range of n× empirical mean α²; ReLU is approximately transparent to the radial/transverse decomposition of ternary error, with a difference of less than 0.4% between pre- and post-ReLU quantization error.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the asymmetry theorem derivation and ternary quantization error analysis in Sections 3–4. The outlier feature leverage verification in Appendices E–F is the core part connecting theory to real models. There is no need to delve into all proof details; focus on the geometric response mechanism of ReLU + RMSNorm and the applicable conditions of the two key quantitative constants 2.75× and 10×. Estimated reading time: 45–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 三元量化的理论分析扎实，可用于指导低比特量化方案设计，仅看核心定理和实验结论即可
recommendation.en: Solid theoretical analysis of ternary quantization, can guide low-bit quantization scheme design, only read core theorems and experimental conclusions

paper.title: LIFT and PLACE: A Simple, Stable, and Effective Knowledge Distillation Framework for Lightweight Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We demonstrate that in knowledge distillation for diffusion models, the teacher network's highly complex denoising process - stemming from its substantially larger capacity - poses a significant challenge for the student model to faithfully mimic. To address this problem, we propose a coarse-to-fine distillation framework with LInear FiTtingbased distillation (LIFT) and Piecewise Local Adaptive Coefficient Estimation (PLACE). First, LIFT decomposes the objective into a "coarse" alignment and a "

summary.core_problem: 大 teacher diffusion model 的去噪轨迹过于复杂，小 student 直接模仿时容易出现容量不匹配和局部误差放大。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是扩散模型蒸馏方法，目标是获得轻量生成模型。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对大模型到小模型的目标分解、teacher signal 难度控制有可迁移的训练信号设计参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LIFT and PLACE。LIFT 将蒸馏目标拆成 coarse alignment 和 fine refinement，先让 student 学较容易的线性拟合式粗对齐，再进入更难的细粒度修正。PLACE 进一步按误差把输出区域分组，估计局部自适应系数，对空间非均匀误差给出不同指导强度。方法属于对 diffusion KD 训练目标和课程顺序的改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法在 image-space 和 latent-space diffusion、U-Net 和 DiT backbone、无条件和条件生成、多种数据集上有效，并可扩展到 flow-based 模型如 MMDiT/SD3。摘要没有给出参数量、训练数据、baseline 名单或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: A large teacher diffusion model has a complex denoising process, making direct imitation difficult for a smaller student.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a distillation framework for lightweight diffusion models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the idea of decomposing teacher signals by difficulty is transferable to model compression and training-target design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes LIFT and PLACE. LIFT decomposes distillation into coarse alignment followed by fine refinement, so the student first learns an easier linear-fitting objective before harder local corrections. PLACE groups outputs by error and estimates local adaptive coefficients, providing different guidance strengths for spatially non-uniform errors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims effectiveness across image-space and latent-space diffusion, U-Net and DiT backbones, unconditional and conditional generation, multiple datasets, and flow-based models such as MMDiT/SD3. It does not provide parameter counts, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 不用细读；若做蒸馏，只看 LIFT 的 coarse-to-fine 目标拆分，PLACE 更像工程补丁。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply; if you work on distillation, inspect LIFT’s coarse-to-fine target decomposition, while PLACE looks more like an engineering patch.

paper.title: IO-SVD: Input-Output Whitened SVD for Adaptive-Rank LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models deliver strong performance across language and reasoning tasks, but their storage and compute costs remain major barriers to deployment in resource-constrained and latency-sensitive settings. SVD-based post-training compression offers a hardware-agnostic way to reduce model size and improve inference efficiency through low-rank factorization. However, existing methods often rely on input-only whitening spaces, homogeneous rank allocation, or loss-agnostic allocation heurist

summary.core_problem: 现有基于SVD的训练后大模型压缩方法存在白化空间单一、秩分配不合理、计算开销高的问题，高压缩率下难以保留模型性能。
summary.importance: 提供了无需重新训练的低开销后训练压缩方案，将预测分布KL散度引入SVD设计的思路可为大模型部署压缩提供参考，无需改动预训练流程即可实现高效压缩，同时支持LLM和VLM两类模型。
summary.technical_approach: IO-SVD是训练后SVD压缩方法，从原始与压缩模型预测分布的KL散度二阶展开推导双侧白化空间，采用贪心的损失感知异构秩分配策略，支持损失感知的混合SVD-8比特量化压缩，计算开销远低于梯度优化的秩分配方法。
summary.experiments: 在最大13B参数的LLM和VLM家族上验证有效，高压缩率下性能保留优于现有SVD压缩方法，混合压缩进一步降低精度损失，在不同部署硬件下均有稳定效率提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法部分的双侧白化空间推导、损失感知秩分配策略设计，以及附录的KL二阶展开数学推导，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing SVD-based post-training LLM compression methods suffer from input-only whitening, unreasonable rank allocation, and high computational overhead, leading to severe performance degradation under aggressive compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-overhead post-training compression scheme without retraining, and the idea of introducing predictive KL divergence into SVD design can serve as reference for LLM and VLM deployment compression, with no modifications to pretraining pipelines required.
summary_en.technical_approach: IO-SVD is a post-training SVD compression method. It derives a double-sided whitening space from the second-order expansion of the KL divergence between the original and compressed model’s predictive distributions, adopts a greedy loss-aware heterogeneous rank allocation strategy, and supports loss-aware hybrid SVD-8bit quantization compression, with much lower computational overhead than gradient-based rank allocation methods.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across LLM and VLM families with up to 13B parameters. It outperforms existing SVD compression methods in performance retention under high compression ratios, and hybrid compression further reduces accuracy loss, with stable efficiency improvements across different deployment hardware settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Method section for the derivation of double-sided whitening space and loss-aware rank allocation strategy, as well as the appendix for mathematical derivation of second-order KL expansion. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SVD压缩方向的增量改进，KL感知双边白化的思路有参考价值。做LLM压缩的团队可看§3的IO-SVD核心推导，其余人浏览摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in SVD-based compression; the KL-aware double-sided whitening idea is worth noting. Teams working on LLM compression should read §3 for the core derivation; others can skim the abstract.

paper.title: Characterizing Learning in Deep Neural Networks using Tractable Algorithmic Complexity Analysis
paper.abstract: Training large-scale deep neural networks (DNNs) is resource-intensive, making model compression a practical necessity. The widely accepted ''learning as compression'' hypothesis posits that training induces structure in network weights, which enables compression. Measuring this structure through Kolmogorov-Chaitin-Solomonoff (KCS) complexity is appealing, but existing estimators based on the Coding Theorem Method (CTM) and the Block Decomposition Method (BDM) are limited to small binary objects

summary.core_problem: 现有KCS算法复杂度估计方法仅支持小规模二值对象，无法扩展到现代大规模DNN，难以量化训练过程中权重的结构变化
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了可扩展到大规模DNN的算法复杂度估计方法，为DNN学习过程分析提供了新工具
summary.technical_approach: 提出量化块分解方法QuBD，先将网络权重量化到有限字母表，再通过聚合每个位平面的CTM估计值计算KCS复杂度，理论上证明比二值化方法的估计间隙更紧
summary.experiments: 理论验证了QuBD估计的紧度优势，并用该方法研究了DNN训练过程中算法复杂度的变化规律
summary.authors_note: 哥本哈根大学、开罗美国大学团队，代码开源

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KCS algorithmic complexity estimation methods only support small binary objects, cannot scale to modern large-scale DNNs, and cannot quantify structural changes in weights during training
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposes a scalable algorithmic complexity estimation method for large-scale DNNs, providing a new tool for DNN learning process analysis
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Quantized Block Decomposition (QuBD), first quantizes network weights to a finite alphabet, then estimates KCS complexity by aggregating per-bit-plane CTM estimates, theoretically proves tighter estimation gap than binarization-based methods
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically verifies the tightness advantage of QuBD estimation, and uses this method to study the variation law of algorithmic complexity during DNN training
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Copenhagen, The American University in Cairo, code open-sourced

recommendation.zh: 提供了可扩展的DNN权重算法复杂度测量方法，仅作为训练动态分析的参考工具，无需细读正文
recommendation.en: Provides a scalable method for estimating algorithmic complexity of DNN weights; serves as reference tool for training dynamics analysis, no need to read full text

institutions: The American University in Cairo, Egypt

paper.title: HeatKV: Head-tuned KV-cache Compression for Visual Autoregressive Modeling
paper.abstract: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models have recently demonstrated impressive image generation quality while maintaining low latency. However, they suffer from severe KV-cache memory constraints, often requiring gigabytes of memory per generated image. We introduce HeatKV, a novel compression method that adapts cache allocation in each head based on its attention to previously generated scales. Using a small offline calibration set, the attention heads are ranked according to their attention scores o

summary.core_problem: 视觉自回归(VAR)模型生成图像时KV缓存内存占用过高，单张生成需数GB内存的问题
summary.importance: 工程创新，提出细粒度头级KV缓存压缩方法
summary.technical_approach: 通过小规模离线校准集按注意力头对先前生成尺度的注意力得分排序，构造适配给定内存预算的静态剪枝策略
summary.experiments: 在Infinity-2B模型上，相比现有方法KV缓存压缩比提升2倍，同时保持图像保真度、prompt对齐度和人类感知得分相当
summary.authors_note: 瑞典隆德大学，无公开知名作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models suffer from extremely high KV-cache memory consumption, requiring gigabytes of memory per generated image
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation, proposes a fine-grained head-level KV-cache compression method
summary_en.technical_approach: Ranks attention heads based on their attention scores over prior generated scales using a small offline calibration set, then constructs a static pruning schedule tailored to given memory budget
summary_en.experiments: On Infinity-2B model, achieves 2x higher KV-cache compression ratio than existing methods, while maintaining comparable image fidelity, prompt alignment and human perception score
summary_en.authors_note: Lund University, Sweden, no publicly known notable authors

recommendation.zh: 纯VAR模型推理侧优化工作，做视觉大模型部署的研究员可参考，预训练研究员无需精读
recommendation.en: Pure inference optimization for VAR models, only researchers working on visual LLM deployment need to reference it, pretrain researchers do not need intensive reading

paper.title: Towards Resource-Efficient LLMs: End-to-End Energy Accounting of Distillation Pipelines
paper.abstract: The rise in deployment of large language models has driven a surge in GPU demand and datacenter scaling, raising concerns about electricity use, grid stress, and the impacts of modern AI workloads. Distillation is often promoted as one of the most effective paths to obtain cheaper, more efficient models, yet these claims rarely account for the full end-to-end energy and resource costs, including crucial teacher-side workloads such as data generation, logit caching, and evaluation. We present a c

summary.core_problem: 评估蒸馏是否真的节省资源时，不能只看学生模型训练和推理成本，还要计入教师模型生成数据、logit caching、评测等完整流水线能耗。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程测量与资源核算框架。它挑战了“蒸馏天然更省”的粗粒度叙事，对模型压缩、合成数据 SFT 和大规模部署成本评估有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出端到端 energy accounting framework，对蒸馏流水线各阶段进行 GPU device power consumption 的分阶段记录。比较两类常见蒸馏：logit-based knowledge distillation 和 synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning，并构造 energy-quality Pareto frontiers。
summary.experiments: 实验分离记录教师侧、学生侧、缓存、评测等阶段的经验能耗和排放。摘要未给出模型规模、GPU 类型、数据量、质量指标和 Pareto 数值，但明确覆盖经典 logit 蒸馏与合成数据 SFT 两条路线。
summary.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni 长期参与 AI 能耗、碳排和模型环境影响测量相关工作；论文信息未提供明确机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that claims about distillation efficiency must include the full pipeline cost, not just student training or inference, because teacher generation, logit caching, and evaluation can dominate the budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering measurement and resource-accounting framework. It questions the coarse claim that distillation is automatically resource-efficient and is relevant to compression, synthetic-data SFT, and deployment cost analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose an end-to-end energy accounting framework that logs GPU device power stage by stage across distillation pipelines. They compare logit-based knowledge distillation with synthetic-data supervised fine-tuning and build energy-quality Pareto frontiers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments empirically separate energy use and emissions across teacher-side work, student-side training, caching, and evaluation. The abstract does not provide model sizes, GPU types, dataset sizes, quality metrics, or exact Pareto numbers, but it covers both classic logit distillation and synthetic-data SFT.
summary_en.authors_note: Sasha Luccioni is known for work on AI energy use, carbon accounting, and environmental impact measurement. The provided paper metadata does not list a specific institution.

recommendation.zh: 结论不会改预训练方法，但会约束蒸馏项目立项；只看能耗分解表和 Pareto 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining methods, but it should constrain distillation project planning; read the stage-wise energy tables and Pareto curves.

paper.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), processing a massive number of visual tokens incurs prohibitive computational overhead. While recent training-aware pruning methods attempt to selectively discard redundant tokens, they largely rely on continuous-gradient relaxations. However, visual token pruning is inherently a discrete, non-convex combinatorial problem; consequently, these continuous approximations frequently trap the optimization in sub-optimal local minima, especially under aggressive compr

summary.core_problem: GRIP-VLM 解决 VLM 视觉 token 过多导致推理开销高的问题，重点是训练一个能在不同预算下动态选择保留 token 的 pruning 策略。论文认为视觉 token pruning 是离散子集选择问题，用 Gumbel-Softmax 或可微 top-k 这类连续松弛方法容易在高压缩率下落入差的局部解。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近高效 VLM 推理研究，不属于预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发在于：高分辨率图像和视频会把视觉 token 数从早期约 576 推到上万级，统一多模态模型的训练和推理都会受这个瓶颈限制。论文把 token selection 看成非平滑决策问题，并用 RL 处理 hard samples，这对设计可学习的视觉 token routing、动态计算和多模态 MoE 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM 是两阶段动态 pruning 框架。系统层面，它在 Transformer 层中加入轻量 scoring module，可用于视觉编码器阶段，也可用于 LLM decoder 阶段，并且可以和启发式 pruning 方法叠加。token 层面，它设计 budget-aware scorer，让打分器显式感知当前压缩预算；训练时用 curriculum learning，从接近无损的预算逐步过渡到高压缩预算，以减少直接训练高压缩策略的不稳定。优化层面，先用 supervised distillation 得到一个稳定初始策略，再用 GRPO 风格的 reinforcement learning 在离散选择空间中探索。这个设计针对的是连续松弛的局限：当正确性随 keep ratio 呈现非单调波动时，平滑 surrogate 很难找到好的 token 子集。
summary.experiments: 论文在 6 个多模态 benchmark 上报告结果，并以 192 个视觉 token 预算作为关键比较点。GRIP-VLM 在该预算下整体表现优于启发式和监督学习 pruning 基线。在等精度约束下，推理速度比竞争方法快 15%。论文还把样本按 pruning 难度分成 LV1、LV2、LV3：LV1 对 pruning 稳定，启发式方法已足够；LV2 随 keep ratio 大致单调退化，监督学习有明显收益；LV3 呈现非单调振荡，RL 收益最大。在 hard samples 上，GRIP-VLM 相比已有 pruning baseline 平均成功率提升 33%，在部分 LV3 设置中比启发式和监督学习方法高最多约 20 个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Motivation 里对 pruning landscape heterogeneity 的实验设计，尤其是用 keep ratio 扫描正确/错误交替次数来定义 LV1–LV3。这部分比方法命名更有信息量。然后看 budget-aware scorer、curriculum learning、SFT-anchored RL/GRPO 的训练流程。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体 benchmark 细节，关注它如何把视觉 token 裁剪建模为离散策略优化，以及 hard samples 为什么需要探索而不只是可微打分。

summary_en.core_problem: GRIP-VLM targets the inference cost caused by excessive visual tokens in VLMs. The core claim is that visual token pruning is a discrete subset-selection problem. Continuous relaxations such as Gumbel-Softmax or differentiable top-k can be fragile, especially when the compression budget is tight.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an efficient VLM inference paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the scaling pressure of visual tokens: modern VLMs may process hundreds to tens of thousands of visual tokens for high-resolution images or video. The paper’s framing of token selection as a non-smooth decision problem is useful for thinking about dynamic visual token routing, adaptive compute, and multimodal sparse computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM uses a two-stage dynamic pruning framework. It inserts lightweight scoring modules into Transformer layers and supports pruning in both the visual encoder and LLM decoder stages. The scorer is budget-aware: it conditions token importance on the current token budget, which lets one model operate across different compression levels. Training starts with curriculum learning, moving from mild pruning to aggressive pruning, and uses supervised distillation to create a stable initial policy. It then applies GRPO-style reinforcement learning to explore discrete pruning decisions. This is intended to handle cases where correctness is not a smooth monotonic function of the keep ratio.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on six multimodal benchmarks, with 192 visual tokens as a key budget setting. GRIP-VLM outperforms heuristic and supervised pruning baselines at that budget. Under an equal-accuracy constraint, it gives 15% faster inference than competing methods. The paper also analyzes pruning difficulty by sweeping keep ratios and counting correct/incorrect transitions. Easy samples are stable under pruning, medium samples degrade roughly monotonically, and hard samples show oscillatory behavior. On hard samples, GRIP-VLM improves success rate by 33% on average over existing pruning baselines, and in some LV3 cases gains up to about 20 points over heuristic and supervised methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. The most useful part is the motivation section on heterogeneous pruning landscapes, especially the LV1–LV3 definition based on keep-ratio sweeps. Then read the budget-aware scorer, curriculum training, and SFT-anchored GRPO procedure. For pretraining-oriented readers, benchmark details are less important than the modeling choice: treating visual token reduction as discrete policy optimization rather than differentiable scoring alone.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和高压缩 ablation；把 GRPO 用在离散 token pruning 上是有味道的，但别把它误读成预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Read the method and aggressive-compression ablations; using GRPO for discrete token pruning is interesting, but do not read it as a pretraining result.

institutions: Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Efficient LLM-based Advertising via Model Compression and Parallel Verification
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable potential in advertising scenarios such as ad creative generation and targeted advertising. However, deploying LLMs in real-time advertising systems poses significant challenges due to their high inference latency and computational cost. In this paper, we propose an Efficient Generative Targeting framework that integrates adaptive group quantization, layer-adaptive hierarchical sparsification, and prefix-tree parallel verification to accelerate

summary.core_problem: 降低 LLM 在实时广告生成和定向广告系统中的推理延迟与计算成本，同时尽量保持生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程集成。论文把量化、稀疏化和并行验证组合成面向业务部署的 Efficient Generative Targeting 框架；通用方法有一定参考价值，但实验场景强绑定广告业务，对基座研究的信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含 adaptive group quantization、layer-adaptive hierarchical sparsification 和 prefix-tree parallel verification。前两者压缩模型计算和存储，第三者利用前缀树结构对候选生成进行并行验证，以减少实时服务中的串行等待。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在两个真实广告场景上进行了实验，并取得显著加速且质量下降可接受；但未给出模型参数量、量化 bit 数、稀疏率、延迟提升倍数、质量指标或通用 LLM serving 基线。需要谨慎看待其外推性。
summary.authors_note: 百度北京团队，论文主要服务商业广告部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce inference latency and compute cost for LLMs used in real-time advertising generation and targeting while preserving generation quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an engineering integration. It combines quantization, sparsification, and parallel verification into an Efficient Generative Targeting framework. The individual techniques may be useful, but the evidence is tied to advertising workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework uses adaptive group quantization, layer-adaptive hierarchical sparsification, and prefix-tree parallel verification. The first two reduce model compute and memory cost, while the prefix-tree verifier parallelizes candidate checking to reduce serial latency in production serving.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on two real-world advertising scenarios with significant speedup and acceptable quality degradation. It does not specify model sizes, quantization bits, sparsity levels, latency gains, quality metrics, or comparisons with general LLM serving baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Baidu Beijing and is primarily motivated by commercial advertising deployment.

recommendation.zh: 作为压缩方案组合案例知道即可；广告 workload 太窄，除非你做线上 serving，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a compression-stack case study; the ad workload is narrow, so skip the body unless you work on production serving.

paper.title: SimCT: Recovering Lost Supervision for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a standard tool for transferring teacher behavior to a smaller student, but it implicitly assumes that teacher and student predictions are comparable token by token, an assumption that fails whenever the two models tokenize the same text differently. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, exact shared-token matching silently discards a large fraction of the teacher signal at precisely the positions where vocabularies disagree. We propose \textbf{\underline{Sim}ple \under

summary.core_problem: 现有同策略蒸馏（OPD）默认师生模型使用相同分词器，当二者分词器异构时，仅匹配共现token的监督方式会丢失大量教师模型的监督信号；现有跨分词器OPD方法要么引入额外计算开销、额外训练参数，要么降低监督粒度，造成性能损失。
summary.importance: 验证了仅通过扩展监督空间即可低成本恢复跨分词器蒸馏丢失的信号，不需要复杂的对齐模块，为不同模型家族之间的知识蒸馏、大模型轻量化部署提供了更简洁的方案，也为持续预训练中的跨模型知识迁移提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SimCT方法，不修改OPD原有的反向KL损失函数，仅扩展监督空间：除了师生分词器的共享token外，加入两个分词器都能表示的最短多token连续文本作为最小对齐单元，在这个统一空间上计算常规OPD损失；不需要额外参数、学习投影或最优传输计算，监督空间直接基于两个现有分词器构造。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成基准上测试3个不同模型家族，相比SFT平均相对提升6.0%，稳定优于代表性跨分词器OPD基线；消融实验显示增加分词器不匹配文本的监督占比可提升性能，粗化最小对齐单元会丢失KL监督信号，降低下游任务收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction的跨分词器OPD问题分析部分、Methodology的最小对齐单元构造逻辑，以及实验的消融分析部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy distillation (OPD) for LLMs assumes identical tokenizers between teacher and student models. Under heterogeneous tokenizers, matching only shared tokens discards most teacher supervision signals, and existing cross-tokenizer OPD methods incur extra computation, additional trainable parameters, or coarser supervision granularity, leading to performance loss.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that supervision space expansion can recover lost cross-tokenizer distillation signals without complex alignment modules, providing a low-cost solution for knowledge distillation across different model families and lightweight LLM deployment, also offering reference for cross-model knowledge transfer in continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SimCT, which keeps the standard reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged, expands the supervision space to include both shared tokens and minimal aligned units, which are the shortest multi-token continuations representable by both tokenizers. No additional parameters, learned projections or optimal transport computation are required, as the supervision space is constructed directly from the two existing tokenizers.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks across 3 model families. Achieves 6.0% average relative gain over SFT, outperforms representative cross-tokenizer OPD baselines consistently. Ablations show that increasing recovered supervision from tokenizer-mismatched text improves performance, while coarsening minimal aligned units reduces downstream gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, the construction logic of minimal aligned units in Methodology, and ablation studies in Experiments. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做跨tokenizer蒸馏的团队可直接复现该方法，异构模型迁移适配场景实用性强
recommendation.en: Teams working on cross-tokenizer distillation can directly reproduce this method, which has strong practicability in heterogeneous model migration scenarios

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Chain-based Distillation for Effective Initialization of Variable-Sized Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but remain costly to deploy in resource-constrained settings. Training small language models (SLMs) from scratch is computationally expensive, while conventional knowledge distillation requires repeated access to large teachers for different target sizes, leading to poor scalability. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{Chain-based Distillation (CBD)}, a scalable paradigm for efficiently initializing variable-sized language models. A

summary.core_problem: 不同尺寸小语言模型通常需要分别从大教师蒸馏或从头训练，导致初始化成本高、教师推理重复、尺寸扩展不灵活。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和小模型初始化方法。它不属于预训练范式创新，但对小模型族训练、teacher budget 复用、不同 vocab/架构间迁移有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Chain-based Distillation。先构造少量 intermediate anchors，通过逐步蒸馏形成从源 LLM 到小模型的知识链；目标尺寸模型通过相邻 anchors 的参数插值初始化，不必每个尺寸都重新访问大教师；对跨架构和跨词表设置，引入 bridge distillation 做过渡。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法能高效初始化 variable-sized language models，并减少重复大教师推理。具体源模型规模、anchor 数量、目标模型尺寸、训练 token 数、baseline 和提升幅度未在给定摘要中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Variable-size small language models are expensive to initialize because each target size often requires either training from scratch or running a large teacher again for distillation.
summary_en.importance: This is a model-compression and efficient-training contribution. It is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it is relevant for building model families under a fixed teacher-inference budget and for transferring across architectures or vocabularies.
summary_en.technical_approach: CBD builds a sparse chain of distilled anchor models and initializes intermediate target sizes by parameter interpolation between adjacent anchors. Bridge distillation is introduced for cross-architecture and cross-vocabulary transfer, reducing repeated large-teacher calls.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims effective initialization for variable-sized language models and lower reliance on repeated teacher inference. The provided abstract does not include source-teacher scale, anchor count, target sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 方法像模型族生产线优化；看参数插值是否真能省 teacher compute，预训练 insight 不多。
recommendation.en: This is more model-family factory optimization than pretraining science; check whether interpolation really saves teacher compute.

paper.title: Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is an effective approach for deploying large language models (LLMs) under memory and latency constraints. Most existing PTQ methods determine quantization parameters by minimizing a layer-wise reconstruction error on a predetermined calibration dataset, usually optimized via either scale search or Gram-based methods. However, from the perspective of generalization risk, existing calibration objectives of PTQ based only on empirical reconstruction error on limited

summary.core_problem: 现有训练后量化方法仅在有限校准集上最小化层重构误差，易导致量化权重偏离原权重、泛化风险上升、下游性能退化
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的显著性感知正则化量化校准框架，优化训练后量化的校准目标
summary.technical_approach: 在标准训练后量化目标中加入显著性感知正则项，约束校准过程中量化权重与原始权重的距离，降低泛化风险
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据及对比基准效果，仅公开方法框架
summary.authors_note: 来自中科大、UCL、北大、丹麦技术大学、帝国理工等机构，无公开知名大模型领域研究员信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training quantization methods only minimize layer reconstruction error on limited calibration datasets, easily leading to deviation of quantized weights from original weights, increased generalization risk and degraded downstream performance
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a unified saliency-aware regularized quantization calibration framework to optimize the calibration objective of post-training quantization
summary_en.technical_approach: Add a saliency-aware regularization term to the standard PTQ objective, constrain the distance between quantized weights and original weights during calibration to reduce generalization risk
summary_en.experiments: Specific model parameters, training data and baseline performance are not disclosed in the abstract, only the method framework is released
summary_en.authors_note: From USTC, UCL, Peking University, Technical University of Denmark, Imperial College London, etc., no publicly well-known LLM researchers are identified

recommendation.zh: 纯推理优化增量工作，仅作量化方向文献备查，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental inference optimization work, only for literature reference on quantization, no need to read full text
