paper.title: Budgeted LoRA: Distillation as Structured Compute Allocation for Efficient Inference
paper.abstract: We study distillation for large language models under explicit compute constraints, with the goal of producing student models that are not only cheaper to train, but structurally efficient at inference time. While prior approaches to parameter-efficient distillation, such as LoRA, reduce adaptation cost, they leave the dense backbone unchanged and therefore fail to deliver meaningful inference savings. We propose Budgeted LoRA, a distillation framework that treats model compression as a structur

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效蒸馏只降低适配成本、但保留 dense backbone 导致推理成本几乎不降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和推理效率方法。它把蒸馏重新表述为结构化 compute allocation，而不是固定学生架构或简单插 LoRA，对“训练便宜”和“推理便宜”的区别讲得比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Budgeted LoRA，在全局计算预算下分配 dense 计算和低秩路径容量。核心组件包括 module-level dense retention coefficients、自适应 low-rank allocation，以及训练后压缩步骤；压缩时选择性移除、近似或保留 dense 组件，以得到不同计算预算下的学生模型族。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是在显式计算约束下获得结构上更省推理的学生模型，但截断信息未给出具体模型规模、任务、baseline、压缩率或性能提升数值。因此实验可信度需要读正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ADAPT Centre 和 Dublin City University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LoRA-style distillation: it reduces adaptation cost but usually leaves the dense backbone intact, so inference cost barely changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and compression contribution. Its useful framing is to treat distillation as structured compute allocation, separating cheap training from genuinely cheaper inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Budgeted LoRA introduces a global compute budget and allocates capacity across dense and low-rank paths. It uses module-level dense retention coefficients, adaptive low-rank allocation, and a post-training compression stage that removes, approximates, or preserves dense components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states the goal and method but does not expose model sizes, tasks, baselines, compression ratios, or quality-speed trade-offs in the provided excerpt. The empirical strength has to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the ADAPT Centre and Dublin City University.

recommendation.zh: 想做推理压缩可看方法定义；缺少实验细节前，先把它当 LoRA 稀疏化思路而不是可靠 recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth a methods skim for compression work; until the curves are visible, treat it as a LoRA-structured sparsification idea, not a recipe.

paper.title: SpecKV: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Compression-Aware Gamma Selection
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a small draft model to propose candidate tokens that a larger target model verifies. A critical hyperparameter in this process is the speculation length~$γ$, which determines how many tokens the draft model proposes per step. Nearly all existing systems use a fixed~$γ$ (typically~4), yet empirical evidence suggests that the optimal value varies across task types and, crucially, depends on the compression level applied

summary.core_problem: 现有推测解码系统普遍采用固定的推测长度γ，未考虑任务差异与目标模型压缩水平对最优γ的影响，导致推理效率损失
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量级自适应γ选择机制，首次将模型压缩程度纳入推测长度的决策信号，无需额外开销即可提升推测解码效率
summary.technical_approach: 设计SpecKV自适应控制器，每步从草稿模型中提取接受率、熵、置信度等信号，动态匹配当前压缩水平与任务的最优γ值
summary.experiments: 覆盖4类任务、4种候选γ、3种模型压缩精度（FP16/INT8/NF4），采集5112条step级观测数据，验证动态γ相比固定γ可提升15%-22%的推理吞吐量
summary.authors_note: 肯塔基大学团队，无公开知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speculative decoding systems generally use fixed speculation length γ, ignoring the impact of task differences and target model compression levels on optimal γ, leading to inference efficiency loss
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a lightweight adaptive γ selection mechanism, incorporates model compression level into the decision signal of speculation length for the first time, improves speculative decoding efficiency without extra overhead
summary_en.technical_approach: Design SpecKV adaptive controller, extract signals including acceptance rate, entropy, confidence from the draft model per step, dynamically match the optimal γ for current compression level and task
summary_en.experiments: Cover 4 task categories, 4 candidate γ values, 3 model compression precisions (FP16/INT8/NF4), collect 5112 step-level observation records, verify that dynamic γ improves inference throughput by 15%-22% compared with fixed γ
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Kentucky, no publicly well-known large model researchers

recommendation.zh: 推测解码方向的小增量改进，仅作为背景文献备查，无需阅读全文
recommendation.en: Small incremental improvement in speculative decoding, only for background literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Budget Constraints as Riemannian Manifolds
paper.abstract: Assigning one of K options to each of N groups under a total cost budget is a recurring problem in machine learning, appearing in mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection. The objective (model loss) depends jointly on all assignments and does not decompose across groups, which prevents combinatorial solvers from optimizing the true objective directly and limits them to proxy objectives. Evolutionary search evaluates the actual loss but lacks gradient information, w

summary.core_problem: 解决带总预算约束的离散配置优化问题，例如混合精度量化、非均匀剪枝和专家选择中，如何在满足预算的同时直接优化真实模型损失。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型压缩和资源分配中的优化方法。它不是预训练论文，但对量化、剪枝、MoE expert allocation 等效率问题有方法参考，特别是把硬预算约束放进可微优化几何中。
summary.technical_approach: 作者观察到在 softmax relaxation 下，预算约束在 logit space 中形成一个几何结构简单的 Riemannian manifold：法向量有闭式形式，沿 cost vector 平移 logits 会单调改变期望成本，因此可用 binary-search retraction 回到预算面，vector transport 也只需一次内积。基于此构建满足预算的流形优化方法，避免 penalty tuning 和 proxy objective。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验结果。任务动机覆盖 mixed-precision quantization、non-uniform pruning 和 expert selection，但未说明具体模型规模、压缩率、baseline 或实际 loss/accuracy 改善。
summary.authors_note: Dan Alistarh 是分布式优化、稀疏训练和模型压缩方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies discrete assignment under a total budget, as seen in mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection, while optimizing the true model loss.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimization method for model compression and resource allocation. It is not a pretraining paper, but it may be useful for quantization, pruning, and MoE allocation problems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under a softmax relaxation, the authors view the budget constraint as a simple Riemannian manifold in logit space: the normal vector has a closed form, shifting logits along the cost vector changes expected cost monotonically, retraction can be done by binary search, and vector transport reduces to one inner product. This avoids penalty tuning and proxy-only combinatorial solvers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed results. The motivating settings include mixed-precision quantization, non-uniform pruning, and expert selection, but model sizes, compression targets, baselines, and numerical gains are not specified.
summary_en.authors_note: Dan Alistarh is known for work on distributed optimization, sparse training, and model compression.

recommendation.zh: 把预算约束做成 manifold 是干净的优化视角；先看几何推导，是否打过强 LLM 压缩还不清楚。
recommendation.en: The manifold view of budget constraints is clean; read the geometry first, but it is unclear whether it beats strong LLM compression baselines.

paper.title: Rethinking Layer Redundancy in Large Language Models: Calibration Objectives and Search for Depth Pruning
paper.abstract: Depth pruning improves the inference efficiency of large language models by removing Transformer blocks. Prior work has focused on importance criteria and search algorithms, often treating layer redundancy as an inherent structural property of pretrained networks. In contrast, we adopt a \emph{functional perspective}, where redundancy is jointly influenced by the model and the evaluation objective, suggesting that a universal ranking may not be sufficient. Through an empirical study across three

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论深度剪枝中的一个基础假设：Transformer 层冗余是否是预训练模型自身的固定结构属性。作者给出的答案是否定的。层是否可删，取决于模型、校准数据和校准目标三者的组合。用语言建模 perplexity 找到的冗余层，未必适合保留下游推理能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型压缩研究的启发在于，它把“层重要性”从静态 ranking 问题改写为目标条件化的子集选择问题。这会影响模型发布前的压缩流程：如果压缩后的模型要服务推理、问答或工具调用，只用 C4 perplexity 做校准可能选错层。贡献不在新剪枝算法，而在清楚地分离了校准目标和搜索算法两个因素，并证明前者往往更关键。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把深度剪枝形式化为从 N 个 Transformer block 中选择 k 个删除层的组合优化问题。目标是最小化删除这些层后在校准集上的损失退化。这个形式化强调两点。第一，多层删除不是单层删除效果的简单相加，因为删除前面层会改变后续层看到的 hidden-state 分布，导致重构误差传播。第二，最优删除集合是 θ、loss、data 的函数，不是模型参数 θ 单独决定的属性。实验上，作者固定模型和数据，分别改变校准目标与搜索算法。校准目标包括 C4 上的 negative log-likelihood/perplexity，以及面向 commonsense reasoning 的 task likelihood margin。搜索算法共 7 种，用来观察在同一目标下是否会收敛到相似剪枝模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源 LLM 家族、2 类校准目标和 7 种搜索算法。典型模型层数约为 32 到 40，剪枝预算 k 包括 7、9、11；对应组合空间约为 10^7 到 10^9，不能穷举。主要发现有三点。第一，perplexity 目标下，被删除层常集中在中后段的连续区域；task likelihood margin 下，删除层更分散，并且不同搜索算法之间差异更大。第二，perplexity 排名和下游 commonsense accuracy 排名经常不一致，Spearman 相关从 -0.78 到接近 0，多数设置为负相关。第三，在固定校准目标后，不同搜索算法的结果相对接近，平均 accuracy 差异约 1 到 3 个百分点。这说明在该实验范围内，校准目标比具体搜索算法更影响剪枝结果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看第 2 节的 subset selection 形式化，它解释了为什么 top-k 单层重要性排序不可靠。然后看实验中的 pruning pattern 图，比较 perplexity 和 task likelihood margin 下的删层分布。最后看 perplexity rank 与 downstream accuracy rank 的相关性结果，这是全文最有信息量的证据。无需细读 7 个搜索算法的实现细节，除非正在做剪枝系统或压缩评测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether redundant Transformer layers are an intrinsic property of a pretrained LLM. Its answer is no. A layer can look redundant under language-modeling perplexity while still being useful for downstream reasoning. Redundancy should therefore be treated as conditional on the model, calibration data, and evaluation objective.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological rather than algorithmic. It warns against using a universal layer-importance ranking for depth pruning. For compressed LLM releases, especially models expected to retain reasoning or task accuracy, C4 perplexity alone may be a poor calibration objective. The paper makes a useful distinction between the search procedure and the calibration loss, and shows that the latter can dominate the pruning outcome.
summary_en.technical_approach: Depth pruning is formulated as subset selection over Transformer blocks. Given N layers and a pruning budget k, the goal is to remove a subset that minimizes loss degradation on a calibration set. This framing matters because multi-layer removal is non-additive: deleting one layer changes the hidden-state distribution consumed by all later layers, so single-layer scores do not reliably predict the effect of deleting a set of layers. The authors then vary two axes independently: the calibration objective and the search algorithm. The objectives are language-modeling negative log-likelihood/perplexity on C4 and a task likelihood margin for commonsense reasoning. Seven search algorithms are compared under the same objectives to test whether algorithm choice or objective choice explains pruning behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans three open LLM families, two calibration objectives, and seven search algorithms. The models have roughly 32 to 40 layers, with pruning budgets such as 7, 9, and 11 layers; the resulting search spaces range from about 10^7 to 10^9 candidates. Three empirical patterns stand out. Under perplexity, removed layers tend to form contiguous mid-to-late blocks. Under task likelihood margin, removals are more distributed and more algorithm-dependent. Perplexity rankings and downstream accuracy rankings are often misaligned, with Spearman correlations ranging from -0.78 to near zero and mostly negative. Within a fixed objective, different search algorithms usually produce similar performance, with average accuracy gaps around 1 to 3 percentage points.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. The subset-selection formulation is the key section because it explains why independent layer ranking is a fragile assumption. The pruning-pattern figures are the fastest way to see the objective dependence. The rank-correlation analysis between perplexity and downstream accuracy is the main result to inspect carefully. The individual search algorithms can be read lightly unless depth-pruning implementation is the target.

recommendation.zh: 推翻层冗余是模型固有属性的认知，做剪枝实验时优先对齐评估目标而非选择复杂搜索算法
recommendation.en: Overturns the perception that layer redundancy is an inherent model property, prioritize aligning evaluation objectives over selecting complex search algorithms when doing pruning experiments

paper.title: S-SONDO: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation for General Audio Foundation Models
paper.abstract: General audio foundation models have recently achieved remarkable progress, enabling strong performance across diverse tasks. However, state-of-the-art models remain extremely large, often with hundreds of millions of parameters, leading to high inference costs and limited deployability on edge devices. Knowledge distillation is a proven strategy for model compression, but prior work in audio has mostly focused on supervised settings, relying on class logits, intermediate features, or architectu

summary.core_problem: 现有通用音频基座模型参数量大推理成本高，此前音频领域知识蒸馏方法依赖监督信号、模型logits或层级对齐，无法适配仅输出embedding的自监督音频模型
summary.importance: 首个仅用输出embedding实现通用音频模型蒸馏的框架，架构无关，适用范围广
summary.technical_approach: 提出S-SONDO自监督蒸馏框架，无需logits或层级对齐，仅基于教师模型输出的embedding完成蒸馏
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置，仅说明在多类音频任务上验证了方法有效性

summary_en.core_problem: Large general audio foundation models have high inference costs, existing audio knowledge distillation methods rely on supervised signals, logits or layer alignment, which do not work for embedding-only self-supervised audio models
summary_en.importance: First architecture-agnostic distillation framework for general audio models that only uses output embeddings
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose S-SONDO self-supervised distillation framework, no logits or layer alignment required, only uses teacher model output embeddings for distillation
summary_en.experiments: Full experiment setup not disclosed in abstract, only states effectiveness is verified on multiple audio tasks

recommendation.zh: 音频基座压缩的增量工作，仅作为文献备查，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental work on audio foundation model compression, only for literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Structural Pruning of Large Vision Language Models: A Comprehensive Study on Pruning Dynamics, Recovery, and Data Efficiency
paper.abstract: While Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities, their substantial computational and memory requirements pose deployment challenges on resource-constrained edge devices. Current parameter reduction techniques primarily involve training LVLMs from small language models, but these methods offer limited flexibility and remain computationally intensive. We study a complementary route: compressing existing LVLMs by applying structured pruning to the language model backb

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何从小语言模型重新训练一个轻量 LVLM，而是另一路径：能否直接对现有 LVLM 的语言骨干做结构化剪枝，再用较轻量的恢复训练把性能拉回来。核心问题有三层。第一，LVLM 上哪些结构化剪枝方式更合适：删整层，还是缩宽度。第二，剪枝后性能下降主要来自语言能力受损，还是视觉-语言对齐被破坏。第三，在恢复阶段，SFT、logit distillation、hidden-state distillation 以及数据规模之间，哪种组合最划算。
summary.importance: 对纯预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为它主要是压缩与恢复训练研究，不是新的基座建模范式。但它对多模态基座的训练后阶段有实用启发，尤其是两个方面。其一，文章把 LVLM 剪枝后的退化拆成“alignment 先坏”还是“language backbone 也坏”，这对理解多模态模型的脆弱部位有帮助。其二，它给出一个比较系统的经验结论：轻中度压缩时，问题往往先出在 projector / multimodal alignment，而不是整个语言模型都失效；因此恢复训练不一定要全量重训。这对做多模态 continual pretrain、mid-train 压缩、边缘部署版本蒸馏的人有参考价值。贡献类型主要是系统性 empirical study，而不是新 pruning 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
作者选了三类代表性 LVLM：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。共同点是都由 vision encoder、multimodal projector 和 language backbone 组成，因此可以把压缩重点放在参数占比最大的语言骨干上。文章研究两种结构化剪枝范式。

第一种是 layerwise pruning，直接删除整个 transformer blocks。它继承了 LLM 剪层工作的思路，假设部分层存在冗余。优点是结构简单，硬件友好；缺点是对表示路径的破坏比较粗暴，尤其可能伤到跨模态信息在深层的整合。

第二种是 widthwise pruning，缩减每层内部宽度，包括 attention heads 和 MLP neurons。它不是删掉整层计算路径，而是在保留层级深度的前提下压缩每层容量。作者把这一路径视为更细粒度的结构化压缩，因此理论上更有机会保住多模态对齐链路。

剪枝之后，作者比较多种恢复策略。基础恢复是 supervised finetuning。其上再叠加两类蒸馏：logit distillation 和 hidden-state distillation（L2）。从文章给出的结论看，hidden-state distillation 比只蒸 logits 更稳定，因为 LVLM 剪枝后的问题不只是输出分布偏了，还包括中间表示和视觉-语言对齐被扰动。作者还专门分析了低压缩比与高压缩比下的 degradation dynamics：低压缩时主要是 multimodal alignment 受损，因此只调 projector 就能恢复不少；高压缩时语言 backbone 本身也明显退化，这时必须做更充分的全模型恢复。

另一个值得注意的设计是数据效率分析。作者把 calibration dataset size 和 recovery training data size 都做了系统扫描，试图回答“要不要拿回原始大规模多模态数据重训”这个实际问题。文章给出的答案偏务实：校准数据可以很少，恢复训练也不一定需要全量原始数据。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文可确认的实验主线有几部分。

1）模型与评测范围。作者在三类 LVLM family 上做实验：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。评测不只看通用 VQA，还加入了更能暴露推理与结构理解退化的 benchmark，如 AI2D、MathVista、DocVQA。这个设计是合理的，因为剪枝后最容易先掉的往往不是简单感知，而是需要长链路整合的复杂推理。

2）剪枝范式比较。文章的主结论是：在低资源恢复设定下，widthwise pruning 普遍优于 layerwise pruning。原因不是单纯“参数保留更多”，而是 layerwise 删除会更明显破坏深层推理路径与跨模态融合，因此在 reasoning-heavy benchmark 上掉点更严重。作者特别指出，layerwise pruning 对复杂推理任务的伤害大于 widthwise pruning，这一点比只看平均分更有解释力。

3）退化机理分析。作者把性能下降拆成 modality alignment degradation 与 language capability degradation。结论是：低压缩比时，主要损伤发生在视觉-语言对齐，语言骨干相对还在；高压缩比时，两者都会明显受损。这直接导出恢复策略差异：轻度压缩时，只微调 projector 就可能足够；压缩更激进时，必须连 language backbone 一起恢复。

4）恢复训练策略。作者验证了 SFT + hidden-state distillation（L2）是最稳的组合，优于单独 SFT，也优于只做 logits distillation。这个结果符合多模态模型的特点：输出 logits 只能约束最终 token 分布，但 hidden-state 蒸馏能更直接地拉回被剪枝扰乱的中间表示与对齐空间。

5）数据效率。文章给出的一个实用结论是，calibration 对数据量并不敏感，所需数据很少；恢复训练在只用原始训练数据 5% 的情况下，仍能取得有效结果。这个结论对部署侧很重要，因为它意味着压缩现有 LVLM 并不一定需要重新拿到全量训练语料做高成本恢复。

由于给定全文片段没有完整表格数字，这里不硬填具体百分点。但从作者总结可明确把握三点：widthwise 在多数设定下更优；SFT+hidden-state distillation 是最佳恢复组合；5% 数据即可完成相当有效的 recovery。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更像一篇系统实验手册，适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction 末尾列出的四条发现，再看 Methodology，弄清 layerwise 与 widthwise 的具体实现，以及 recovery 里 SFT、logit KD、hidden-state KD 的组合方式。然后重点看三类结果：一是不同 pruning ratio 下两种剪枝范式的性能曲线；二是 alignment vs language degradation 的分析图；三是 recovery data size 的敏感性实验。

如果你只关心结论，优先看 Fig.1 和主结果表，再看关于 reasoning benchmark 的分解结果，因为那部分最能说明为什么 layerwise 更伤。若你在做多模态模型压缩、蒸馏或边缘部署，建议把 projector-only recovery 与 full-model recovery 的对比也看完。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；若要复现实验或迁移到自家 LVLM，可能需要连附录中的剪枝细节和训练超参一起读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical alternative to rebuilding compact LVLMs from small language models: structurally pruning an existing LVLM’s language backbone and then recovering performance with lightweight retraining. The core questions are threefold. Which structured pruning paradigm works better for LVLMs—removing layers or shrinking width? After pruning, is the main damage in language capability or in vision-language alignment? And during recovery, which combination of supervised finetuning, logit distillation, hidden-state distillation, and data budget gives the best trade-off?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense; it is mainly about compression and recovery. Still, it has useful implications for multimodal foundation models. The most valuable part is the diagnosis of where pruning hurts first. The paper argues that under mild compression, multimodal alignment degrades before the language backbone collapses, which means recovery can be targeted rather than fully retrained. That is relevant for multimodal continual pretraining, mid-training compression, distillation, and deployment-oriented model adaptation. The contribution is best viewed as a systematic empirical study rather than a new pruning algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study covers three representative LVLM families: LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B. All share the standard decomposition into a vision encoder, a multimodal projector, and a language backbone, so the compression focus is placed on the language model, which dominates parameter count.

Two structured pruning paradigms are compared. The first is layerwise pruning, which removes entire transformer blocks. This follows prior LLM work that treats some layers as redundant. It is simple and hardware-friendly, but it is also coarse and may disrupt the pathways through which multimodal information is integrated at deeper layers. The second is widthwise pruning, which reduces internal width by pruning attention heads and MLP neurons while preserving depth. This is a finer-grained structural change and is hypothesized to preserve multimodal processing better.

After pruning, the authors evaluate several recovery strategies. The base recovery method is supervised finetuning. On top of that, they add knowledge distillation at two levels: output logits and hidden states, with hidden-state distillation implemented via an L2 objective. The paper’s main conclusion is that SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the most reliable combination. That makes sense for LVLMs, where pruning perturbs not only the final token distribution but also the intermediate representation space that supports vision-language alignment.

A particularly useful part of the paper is the degradation analysis. The authors separate performance loss into multimodal alignment degradation and language capability degradation. Their claim is that at low compression ratios, the main issue is alignment damage, so projector-only recovery can already help a lot. At higher compression ratios, both alignment and language capability degrade, so broader recovery becomes necessary. The paper also studies data efficiency by varying both calibration data size and recovery-training data size, addressing the practical question of whether one needs access to the full original multimodal corpus for effective recovery.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the experimental story is clear even if not every table value is visible.

First, the evaluation spans three LVLM families—LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B—and includes not only standard multimodal benchmarks but also more reasoning-heavy ones such as AI2D, MathVista, and DocVQA. This matters because pruning often hurts structured reasoning before it hurts simple perception.

Second, the main pruning comparison shows that widthwise pruning consistently outperforms layerwise pruning in low-resource recovery settings. The paper emphasizes that the gap is especially visible on reasoning-oriented benchmarks. The interpretation is that removing whole layers damages deep reasoning paths and cross-modal integration more severely than shrinking width while preserving depth.

Third, the degradation-dynamics analysis is one of the most informative parts. At mild compression levels, the dominant failure mode is multimodal alignment degradation rather than a full collapse of the language backbone. At higher compression levels, both alignment and language capability deteriorate. This directly motivates different recovery strategies: projector-only finetuning can be sufficient under mild pruning, but more aggressive pruning requires broader recovery of the language backbone as well.

Fourth, among recovery methods, SFT combined with hidden-state distillation gives the best and most consistent recovery, outperforming plain SFT and SFT with only logit distillation. This result is plausible because hidden-state matching can restore internal representation geometry and cross-modal alignment more directly than output-level supervision alone.

Fifth, the data-efficiency study yields a practical result: calibration is highly data-efficient, and recovery training remains effective with as little as 5% of the original training data. That makes the pruning-and-recover route much more attractive for deployment scenarios where full retraining is too expensive.

The visible text does not include all exact benchmark numbers, so it would be misleading to invent deltas. But the qualitative findings are clear and central: widthwise pruning is generally the better structural choice, SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the strongest recovery recipe, and useful recovery is possible with a surprisingly small data budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a systems paper rather than a single-method paper. Start with the end of the Introduction, where the authors summarize the four main findings. Then go to the Methodology section to understand exactly how layerwise and widthwise pruning are instantiated and how SFT, logit KD, and hidden-state KD are combined.

For the results, focus on three parts. First, the performance curves across pruning ratios for the two pruning paradigms. Second, the analysis that separates alignment degradation from language degradation; that is where the paper becomes more than a benchmark table. Third, the sensitivity study on recovery data size, which is the most deployment-relevant section. If you only want the main conclusions, start with Fig. 1 and the main result tables, then read the breakdown on reasoning-heavy benchmarks because that section best explains why layerwise pruning is more damaging. Expect about 30–45 minutes for a solid skim; more if you want to reproduce the setup or transfer the recipe to another LVLM.

recommendation.zh: 对 VLM 剪枝的系统性实证研究，结论是 widthwise 剪枝在 low-data regime 下优于 layerwise，对做模型压缩的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A systematic empirical study on VLM pruning, concluding that widthwise pruning outperforms layerwise in low-data regimes; valuable reference for model compression practitioners.

paper.title: Efficient Video Diffusion Models: Advancements and Challenges
paper.abstract: Video diffusion models have rapidly become the dominant paradigm for high-fidelity generative video synthesis, but their practical deployment remains constrained by severe inference costs. Compared with image generation, video synthesis compounds computation across spatial-temporal token growth and iterative denoising, making attention and memory traffic major bottlenecks in real-world settings. This survey provides a systematic and deployment-oriented review of efficient video diffusion models.

summary.core_problem: 梳理视频扩散模型在部署时的高推理成本问题，并总结现有加速路线的共性与局限。
summary.importance: 这是一篇综述，不是新方法。价值在于把视频扩散推理效率问题拆成两个核心目标：减少 function evaluations 与降低单步开销。对做高效推理、系统优化或生成模型 serving 的研究员有参考意义，但对 LLM 预训练方法论帮助有限。
summary.technical_approach: 文章将高效视频扩散方法归纳为四类：step distillation、efficient attention、model compression、cache/trajectory optimization，并从部署视角分析这些设计如何作用于时空 token 增长、注意力和内存流量瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，重点应是方法谱系、复杂度来源和开放问题，而非统一新实验。若你做推理系统，可把它当文献地图；若你做基座预训练，只需了解其问题分解框架，不必深读。

summary_en.core_problem: It surveys the severe inference cost of video diffusion models and organizes the main acceleration strategies and their limitations.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method. Its value lies in reducing the efficiency problem to two objectives: fewer function evaluations and lower per-step overhead. Useful for inference/system researchers, but only loosely relevant to LLM pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper categorizes efficient video diffusion methods into four groups: step distillation, efficient attention, model compression, and cache/trajectory optimization, then analyzes how each addresses spatiotemporal token growth, attention cost, and memory traffic.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the emphasis is likely on taxonomy, bottleneck analysis, and open challenges rather than new empirical results. For pretraining researchers, it is more of a literature map than a paper to study in depth.

recommendation.zh: 综述写给视频扩散部署，不是给 LLM 预训练的；只需借它的效率分解框架，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This survey is for video-diffusion deployment, not LLM pretraining; borrow its efficiency decomposition and skip the rest.

paper.title: MOONSHOT : A Framework for Multi-Objective Pruning of Vision and Large Language Models

summary.core_problem: 在无需再训练的post-training one-shot场景下，对大模型剪枝时如何同时兼顾不同目标（重构误差 vs. 训练损失近似）以获得更稳健的稀疏化效果。
summary.importance: 效率/压缩方向的通用方法贡献：指出单一目标在不同架构/稀疏率下不稳定，并给出可扩展到十亿参数模型的多目标剪枝框架；对大模型部署与压缩有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: MOONSHOT作为wrapper将任意单目标剪枝扩展为多目标优化：联合优化层级重构误差与二阶Taylor训练损失近似；并通过可扩展的建模与高效求解流程，使其适配大模型的一次性剪枝。
summary.experiments: 覆盖视觉模型与LLM的一次性剪枝设置，在不同稀疏率/架构下对比现有one-shot剪枝基线，展示更一致的性能保持（摘要未给出具体模型族、稀疏率区间与数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make post-training one-shot pruning robust across architectures and sparsity levels by balancing competing objectives (reconstruction vs. loss approximation).
summary_en.importance: A generally useful efficiency/compression contribution: argues single-objective one-shot pruning is brittle and proposes a scalable multi-objective framework applicable to billion-parameter models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOONSHOT is a wrapper that turns existing single-objective pruning into a multi-objective formulation, jointly optimizing layer-wise reconstruction error and a second-order Taylor approximation of the training loss, with scalable design/solvers for large models.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on vision models and LLMs in the one-shot (no retraining) setting across sparsity levels and architectures, outperforming/being more consistent than prior one-shot pruning baselines (abstract omits exact models and numbers).

recommendation.zh: 当作one-shot剪枝的稳健配方看：多目标比单一重构/损失近似更不挑架构与稀疏率，但结论主要服务部署，预训练侧可忽略。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a robust recipe for one-shot pruning: multi-objective scoring is less brittle across architectures/sparsities than single proxies, but it’s mostly deployment-facing, not pretraining.

paper.title: OFA-Diffusion Compression: Compressing Diffusion Model in One-Shot Manner

summary.core_problem: 如何在一次训练中得到可适配不同算力/延迟约束的扩散模型压缩子网，避免为不同设备重复做多轮压缩训练。
summary.importance: 属于扩散生成模型的部署效率方向：将Once-for-All思想引入扩散模型压缩，降低多目标部署的训练与工程成本；对LLM基座预训练本身启发有限，但对“单次训练、多档推理配置”的通用效率范式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OFA-Diffusion Compression：通过一次性训练覆盖多个计算/参数规模的子网络；为避免候选子网空间过大导致优化变慢，限制子网参数规模集合（离散档位）以缩小搜索/训练空间，并在统一框架下导出不同计算预算的子模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、指标与对比方法的完整细节；仅能确认其目标是扩散图像生成模型的压缩与多档位子网导出，效果与开销对比需以论文正文为准。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain diffusion-model subnetworks for multiple device constraints via one-shot training, avoiding repeated compression runs per deployment target.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an efficiency/deployment contribution for diffusion generative models: adapts the once-for-all paradigm to diffusion compression to reduce training/engineering overhead across multiple inference budgets. Limited direct relevance to LLM pretraining, but the “train once, serve many” efficiency pattern may transfer conceptually.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OFA-Diffusion Compression: one-shot training over a family of subnetworks with different compute/parameter budgets; to mitigate the huge candidate space typical in OFA, it restricts the subnetwork sizes to a discrete set of parameter budgets to speed up optimization and selection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, metrics, or full baselines; details of quality-vs-cost tradeoffs and comparisons must be checked in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: OFA 思路搬到扩散压缩但更像工程拼装，结论对预训练 prior 影响弱；只当“一训多档”部署范式备查，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering port of Once-for-All to diffusion compression; weak impact on pretraining priors—keep as a reference for “train once, serve many configs,” no deep read.
